🔥 Koitalel’s Last Walk — The Betrayal That Changed Kenya

On the morning of 19 October 1905, the Nandi hills were silent.
Too silent.
Even the wind felt like it was holding its breath.

Koitalel arap Samoei — the Orkoiyot, the prophet, the defender of the Nandi — stood outside his hut, watching the sun rise slowly over the valleys he had protected for more than ten years.

His warriors circled around him.
They begged him not to go.
The British had requested a “peace meeting,” but something felt wrong… painfully wrong.

Koitalel looked at his people and said quietly,
“If I fear death, then I have no right to lead you.”

And so he walked.
Down the familiar paths.
Past the river where he once played as a child.
Toward the forest clearing where history waited with a loaded gun.

When he arrived, he found the British officer, Colonel Meinertzhagen, smiling.
A fake smile.
Behind the trees, a hidden rifleman waited.
Koitalel didn’t know — or maybe he knew, and still chose courage over fear.

As he stepped forward to greet the officer, a shot cracked through the air.
One shot.
The shot that ended a decade of resistance…
and broke the heart of a nation.

Koitalel fell, but the forest didn’t stay silent.
The wind rose.
The birds scattered.
And every Nandi elder swore that the earth itself shook in anger.

To his people, Koitalel did not die that day.
He simply crossed into the world of the ancestors…
to continue watching over the land he fought for.

Maksud Kafir dalam Islam

Dalam bahasa Arab, kāfir (كَافِر) berasal daripada perkataan kafara, yang bermaksud menutup atau menyembunyikan.

Dalam konteks Islam, istilah kafir digunakan untuk merujuk kepada:

Seseorang yang tidak beriman kepada Allah dan ajaran Islam

Iaitu orang yang menolak, tidak percaya, atau menutup hati daripada menerima kebenaran ajaran islam.

Istilah umum bagi sesiapa yang tidak beriman kepada Allah, Rasul, dan ajaran Islam — sama ada dia menolak, meragu, atau tidak mahu menerima Islam.

⸻

Jenis-jenis Kafir (Mengikut ulama)

Ulama membahagikan “kafir” kepada beberapa kategori berdasarkan sikap atau tindakan:
1. Kafir Harbi
Orang yang memerangi umat Islam.

2. Kafir Zimmi
Orang bukan Islam yang tinggal dalam negara Islam dan dilindungi.

3. Kafir Musta’min
Bukan Islam yang masuk sementara ke negara Islam (pelancong, peniaga) dengan jaminan keselamatan.

4. Kafir Mu’ahid
Bukan Islam yang ada perjanjian damai dengan umat Islam.

5. Kafir Kitabi
Penganut agama Samawi seperti Kristian dan Yahudi (Ahli Kitab).

⸻

Penting untuk difahami

> Perkataan “kafir” bukan penghinaan, tetapi istilah teologi (agama).
- Ia merujuk kepada status akidah, bukan menghakimi karakter seseorang.
- Islam tetap memerintahkan untuk berbuat baik, berlaku adil dan menghormati orang bukan Islam.

Contoh ayat arahan dalam Al-Quran:

“Allah tidak melarang kamu berbuat baik dan berlaku adil kepada orang-orang yang tidak memerangi kamu…”
— Surah Al-Mumtahanah: 8

“Dalam Islam, istilah ‘kafir’ bukan penghinaan. Ia hanya istilah agama yang bermaksud seseorang yang belum menerima ajaran Islam. Sama seperti istilah ‘non-Muslim’. Islam tetap ajar kita hormat, berlaku adil dan berbuat baik kepada semua.”

🌱 Wrapping Up Phase II: Supporting the Mental Health of Children in De-Occupied Regions of Ukraine 🇺🇦💛💙

Over the past two years, our collaboration with NGO Community Self-Help (CSH) has strengthened the ability of frontline workers to recognize and respond to the mental health needs of children and families living through the impacts of war.

In Phase I, we built the foundation by training 100+ frontline workers across 5 regions in basic MHPSS principles. These sessions not only developed skills—they also helped reduce isolation among responders and highlighted the need for further, locally tailored training.

Phase II advanced this work by adapting the Global MHPSS curriculum for Ukraine and launching a Training of Trainers (ТoT) pathway. Through two 5-day trainings and four ToTs, we reached 112 workers from 28 institutions and supported the first graduate-led trainings in two cities close to the frontline, reaching 30 additional responders.

A new network of local trainers, guided by Ukrainian psychologists and supported remotely by CSH, is now helping shape a more sustainable, locally led training model.

We’re excited to carry this momentum forward as we move into Phase III, continuing to build a strong, resilient system of MHPSS training in Ukraine. 🇺🇦✨

Dalam pandangan tasawuf, istilah “kafir” tidak selalu dimaknai sekadar tidak beriman seperti dalam hukum fikih formal, tetapi sering dipahami lebih halus: penutupan hati dari cahaya kebenaran (kufr berasal dari akar kata Arab “kafara” = menutupi).

Seorang sufi melihat kekafiran sebagai kondisi batin, bukan hanya label sosial atau hukum. Berikut beberapa ciri manusia kafir dalam jalan sufi:

---

1. Menutup Hati dari Cahaya Allah

Hatinya tidak mau menerima petunjuk, walau kebenaran sudah jelas di depan mata.
Seperti disebut dalam Al-Qur’an:

“Sesungguhnya bukan mata itu yang buta, tetapi yang buta ialah hati yang di dalam dada.”
(QS. Al-Hajj: 46)

---

2. Mendewakan Ego dan Dunia

Lebih percaya pada kekuatan diri, harta, atau kedudukan daripada pada Allah.
Dalam bahasa sufi, ini disebut syirik khafi (syirik yang tersembunyi).

---

3. Menolak Cermin Diri

Tidak mau introspeksi (muhasabah) dan menolak nasihat yang membawa kepada perbaikan diri.

Orang seperti ini dianggap menutup pintu tazkiyatun nafs (penyucian jiwa).

---

4. Memutus Hubungan Rasa dengan Pencipta

Shalat, zikir, atau ibadah lain dilakukan sekadar gerakan, tanpa menghadirkan hati.
Dalam sufisme, ini disebut ghaflah (lalai) — bentuk kekafiran rasa.

---

5. Menjadikan Ilmu Hanya Teori

Mengetahui ayat dan hadis, tapi tidak mengamalkannya.

Imam al-Ghazali menyebut ini sebagai “ulama su’” — orang berilmu tapi menutup kebenaran dengan perilaku.

---

6. Tidak Mengenal Diri

Tasawuf menegaskan: “Barang siapa mengenal dirinya, ia akan mengenal Tuhannya.”

Jika seseorang menolak untuk mengenal diri dan hakikat hidupnya, maka ia menutup jalan menuju ma’rifatullah.

---

📚 Catatan Sufi:
Bagi para arif billah, kafir bukan sekadar “orang luar Islam”, tapi setiap hati yang menolak cahaya Allah, bahkan jika secara lahir dia muslim. Karena itu, seorang sufi lebih sibuk membersihkan “kekafiran” di dalam dirinya daripada menuding orang lain.

Allah Mtukufu amesema:  
"Wanakuuliza kuhusu ngawira (malipo ya vita), sema: ngawira ni ya Allah na Mtume."  (Surah Al-Anfal: 1)

Je, unajua maana ya  "al-anfāl" (ngawira)? Na ilikuwa katika vita gani?

 (Ni swali la kukuuliza ujifunze).

Surah: Al-Anfaal, Ayat: 1
> يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْأَنْفَالِ ۖ قُلِ الْأَنْفَالُ لِلَّهِ وَالرَّسُولِ ۖ فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَصْلِحُوا ذَاتَ بَيْنِكُمْ ۖ وَأَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ
Meaning :  Wanakuuliza juu ya Ngawira. Sema: Ngawira ni ya Mwenyezi Mungu na Mtume. 

Basi mcheni Mwenyezi Mungu na suluhisheni mambo baina yenu, na mt'iini Mwenyezi Mungu na Mtume wake ikiwa nyinyi ni Waumini.

1. Muktadha wa Aya:
Aya hii iliteremka baada ya vita vya Badr, ambapo Masahaba walipata ngawira nyingi (maghaniim), lakini kulizuka tofauti kuhusu mgawanyo. Kila kundi lilihisi linastahili zaidi.

2. Mafunzo Makuu ya Aya:
a. Umiliki wa kweli wa ngawira ni wa Allah na Mtume:
- Si mali binafsi ya askari au kikundi. Mtume ndiye hupokea amri kutoka kwa Allah kuhusu mgawanyo.

b. Kukataza ugomvi na malumbano:
- Aya inakataza tofauti, chuki, na migogoro ya mali.  

- Inasisitiza kuleta suluhu na umoja wa Waislamu.

c. Kuitikia amri ya Allah na Mtume ni dalili ya Imani:
- Utii kwa Allah na Mtume unatajwa kuwa kipimo cha imani ya kweli.

3. Ujumbe wa Kina:
- Ngawira ni mtihani wa moyo: Hata baada ya ushindi, moyo wa mtu hujaribiwa kwa mali.  

- Imani ya kweli huonekana katika mitihani: Sio tu wakati wa ibada, bali hata wakati wa mivutano ya dunia.  

- Kiongozi wa Kiislamu ana wajibu wa kusimamia haki:* Mtume anapewa mamlaka ya mgawanyo, si kwa upendeleo, bali kwa amri ya Allah.

Hitimisho la Tafakari:
Aya hii ni somo la kina kuhusu uongozi wa Kiislamu, udugu, na nidhamu ya mali.

 Inatufundisha kutanguliza taqwa (kumcha Allah) badala ya matamanio ya mali, na kwamba umoja wa Waislamu ni bora kuliko mgawanyo wa dunia.

Koitalel Arap Samoei (c. 1860–1905) was the Orkoiyot, or supreme spiritual and military leader, of the Nandi people in Kenya from 1890 until his death. Born at Samitui in Aldai, he was the son of Kimnyole arap Turukat, who was also an Orkoiyot. Koitalel was noted for his ability to understand prophetic signs and was chosen as the successor to his father, who had reportedly predicted the coming of the Europeans. As the Orkoiyot, Koitalel was a sacred and special figure, holding the authority to make decisions regarding security matters, including waging war and negotiating peace.
Koitalel is best known for leading the protracted Nandi resistance against British colonial rule, which is considered one of the longest and fiercest resistance movements in Kenyan history, lasting for over a decade. The resistance began around 1896 in response to the construction of the Kenya-Uganda Railway, which was set to cut through Nandi territory. Koitalel viewed this as an intrusion and led his warriors in a campaign that utilized strategic guerrilla warfare, including numerous ambushes, sabotage of the railway tracks, and attacks on British personnel. The Nandi fighters, known for their prowess, frequently disrupted the railway construction, stealing materials to make weapons and ornaments.
The resistance effectively ended with the assassination of Koitalel Arap Samoei on October 19, 1905, in an act of treachery by the British. British intelligence officer Colonel Richard Meinertzhagen arranged a meeting under the guise of negotiating a peace treaty to end the conflict. Despite sensing danger, Koitalel attended the meeting at Ketbarak (now the Nandi Bears Club), accompanied by his aides. Meinertzhagen, who had hidden numerous armed soldiers nearby, shot Koitalel at point-blank range, killing him and his entire entourage. Following this, the British forces decapitated Koitalel, taking his skull and some of his artifacts to Britain. The loss of their supreme leader effectively broke the Nandi's will to continue the full-scale resistance, allowing the British to bring the territory under control.

“Yahu, böyle Müslümanlık mı olur? Müslüman yalan söyler mi, hırsızlık yapar mı, rüşvet alır mı, hak yer mi? Eğer bunlar Müslümansa, ben değilim!”

Bu cümleler; bilinci köleleştiren bir zihinsel esaretin göstergesidir.

Bu şablon kırılmadıkça, bireyler insanlığın, bilimin ve aklın gerçek ölçüsünü göremez. 

İnsan, en büyük yanılgısını doğru sanarak yaşadığı sürece özgürleşemez.

Çünkü ahlakın kaynağı olarak dinin öğretilmesine koşullanmış bir toplum, iyi bir insan gördüğünde bunu “Müslümanlık”la ölçer.

Bir birey, insan olmanın ön koşulunun Müslüman olmak olarak düşündüğünde, öyle inandığı için, gerçek bir dürüst insanla karşılaşsa bile onun bu dürüstlüğü, Müslüman olmadığı gerekçesiyle hak ettiği değeri göremez.

Müslüman bir kişi, dünyanın en dürüst insanı olsa bile onunla dost olamaz, kızını vermez, oğluna gelin almaz; istisnalar yok denecek kadar azdır ve bireysel olarak kalır, yani İslam’a indirgenemez.

Bunun nedeni Kur’an’ın kendi ifadeleridir:

Tevbe 23: “Ey inananlar! Babalarınızı, kardeşlerinizi küfrü imana tercih ediyorlarsa dost edinmeyin. Sizden onları kim dost edinirse doğrusu kendine yazık etmiş olurlar.”

Teğabün 14: “Ey iman edenler! Eşlerinizden ve çocuklarınızdan size düşman olabilecekler vardır.”

Mücâdele 22: Allah’a ve Ahiret gününe inanan bir toplum, babaları, oğulları, kardeşleri ya da akrabaları da olsa, Allah’a ve Resûlüne düşman olanlarla dostluk edemez.

Maide 51: “Ey iman edenler, Yahudi ve Hristiyanları dostlar (veliler) edinmeyin; onlar birbirlerinin dostudurlar. Sizden onları kim dost edinirse, kuşkusuz onlardandır.”

Kur’an perspektifinde, Müslüman kendisinden olmayanlara karşı temel olarak tahammülsüzdür.

Atatürk’ün dediği gibi: "Türkiye Cumhuriyeti şeyhler, dervişler, müritler, mensuplar memleketi olamaz. En doğru, en hakiki tarikat, medeniyet tarikatıdır."

İnsan olmak için gerekli olan, bilince, akla, vicdana ve uygarlığın emirlerine uymaktır; dini bir kimlik değildir.

İnsan olmak "Islam" tekelinde değildir.

İnsanlığı, inanç belirlemez; doğruluk, erdem, adalet, akıl ve vicdan belirler.

İyi insan görünce “Gavur ama bizden daha Müslüman” denir. 

Bu cümle masum değildir; ahlakı İslam’a bağlayan köle bir bilinç kodudur.

Bu kod çözülmedikçe gerçek görülemez. 

İslam’ın yapısal sorunları anlaşılamaz; insanın insan oluşunun kaynağı görülemez.

KÂFİR NEDİR? İSLAM’A GÖRE KİM “İNSAN DEĞİLDİR”?

İslamcı iddia şudur:

“İnsan olmanın şartı Müslüman olmaktır. Müslüman olmayan asla gerçek insan olamaz.”

Bu iddia yalnızca yanlış değildir; bizzat gerçeği ters yüz eden bir propaganda aracıdır.

Kur’an’a göre kâfir yalnızca “inanmayan kişi” değildir; aynı zamanda:

yalancıdır

sapkındır

akılsızdır

kördür

sağırdır

kalbi mühürlüdür

vicdansızdır

anlamaz

bilmez

düzen bozucudur

hayvan gibidir, hatta onlardan daha aşağıdır

Ayetler bunu açıkça söyler:

“Cehalet içinde gaflete dalmış yalancılar kahrolsun.” (Zâriyât 11)

“Allah’ın indirdiğiyle hükmetmeyenler kâfirlerin ta kendileridir.” (Maide 44)

“Yalanı ancak Allah’ın ayetlerine inanmayanlar uydurur.” (Nahl 105)

“Onlar yalancıların ta kendileridir.” (Tevbe 107)

GERÇEKTE KÂFİR KİM? Bilimsel tanım

Bilimsel, felsefi ve etik düzlemde “kâfir” diye bir kategori yoktur. 

Sadece inanç/ideoloji farkı vardır.

Gerçek şudur:

Bir insanın Müslüman olmaması onun yalancı olduğunu göstermez.

İnançsızlık, ahlaksızlık değildir.

Ahlak, imanla değil empati, toplumsal sözleşme ve vicdan ile oluşur.

Bilgi vahiyden değil gözlem, deney, akıl yürütme ile oluşur.

Bilimsel dünyada kategori şudur:

“İnanan – inanmayan” değil; “kanıtlayan – kanıtlamayan”, “doğru – yanlış”, “ahlaklı – ahlaksız”.

Hiçbiri dine göre belirlenmez.

YALANI VE GERÇEĞİ NASIL AYIRT EDERİZ?

Bilimsel ölçütler:

Doğrulanabilirlik (ölçülür, test edilir)

Tekrar edilebilirlik (herkes aynı sonuca ulaşır)

Nedensellik (sebep-sonuç ilişkisi)

Çelişmezlik

Kanıt

İslam’ın vahiy modeli bu kriterlerin hiçbiriyle uyumlu değildir:

Kanıt yok

Test yok

Deney yok

Tekrar yok

Gözlem yok

Dolayısıyla “vahiy gerçektir” iddiası bilgi değil, iddiadır.

Gerçek yalancı kimdir?
İddiasını kanıtlamayan.

İftira kimdir?
Bir kişiye kanıtsız suç yükleyen.

İslam’ın “kâfir yalancıdır” demesi bir kanıt değil, inanç içi hakaret kategorisidir.

İSLAM’DA AKIL VE BİLGİ VAR MIDIR?

Hayır, Kur’an’ın bilgi anlayışı rasyonel-empirik bilgi değildir.

“Akletmiyor musunuz?” denirken kastedilen: “Kur’an’ın Allah’tan geldiğini anlamıyorsanız akılsızsınız.”

Kur’an’ın epistemolojisi tek kaynaklıdır:

“Sizin için bu kitapta hiçbir şeyi eksik bırakmadık.”

Kur’an dışı hiçbir otorite tanınmaz. 

Bilgi yalnızca vahiydir.

Eğer İslam gerçek anlamda akıl ve özgür düşünceyi kabul etseydi:

Müslüman toplumlar toplu iğne üretemeyecek kadar geri kalır mıydı?

Bilime yönelen tüm Müslüman filozoflar “zındık/kâfir” ilan edilir miydi?

Tarihsel gerçek şudur:

İslam dünyasında bilim yapan herkes Yunan felsefesinden beslenmiştir. 

Müslüman bilim insanı, “Kur’an bana bilimsel yol gösterdi” dememiştir.

İNSAN HAKLARI NEDİR? İSLAM HAKLARI NEDİR?

İnsan hakları:

İnanç özgürlüğü

Vicdan özgürlüğü

Yaşam hakkı

Beden dokunulmazlığı

Cinsiyet eşitliği

Hukuk önünde eşitlik

Eleştiri hakkı

İslam hakları:

İnanç özgürlüğü yok (“inkâr edene ağır azap”)

Din değiştirene ölüm

Erkek kadının velisi

Kölelik meşru

Kadının mirası yarım

Kâfir hukuken eşit değil

Peygamber eleştirilemez

Kur’an eleştirilemez

İnsan hakları insan merkezlidir; İslam hakları Allah merkezlidir.

İnsan hakları evrenseldir; İslam hakları Müslümana özeldir.

Vicdan ve ahlak:

Vicdan: Empati, acı duyma, haksızlık karşısında tepki verme kapasitesi.

Ahlak: Toplumsal sözleşme / rasyonel karşılıklılık.

Dürüst bir ateist, ahlaksız bir Müslümandan daha değerlidir; çünkü ahlaksız Müslüman davranışının kaynağı korku veya çıkar; ateist için ise tamamen insanlık ve vicdandır.

İnsan olmanın şartı Müslümanlık değildir.

Ahlakın kaynağı din değildir.

Vicdanın kaynağı iman değildir.

Bilginin kaynağı vahiy değildir.

İnancı insanlık ölçüsüymüş gibi sunmak.

Kâfiri aşağılayarak Müslümanı üstün göstermek.

Bilgiyi vahye indirgemek.

Ahlakı dine bağlamak.

Bilimi metafizikle karıştırmak.

YALANIN ta kendisidir. 

Gerçek insanlık dinle değil, akılla, vicdanla, doğrulukla ve kanıtla başlar.

Ve asıl yalan, tüm bu gerçekleri yok sayıp:

“Müslüman olmayan insan olamaz” demektir.

"Bu Duvarı Aşan Gerçeğe Ulaşır, Yalandan Kurtulur”

Surah Al Kaaferoon, a chapter in the Quran so short in lines yet vast in meaning, descends like a gentle lesson of boundaries, respect and clarity. Allah says:

قل يا أيها الكافرون
لا أعبد ما تعبدون
ولا أنتم عابدون ما أعبد
ولا أنا عابد ما عبدتم
ولا أنتم عابدون ما أعبد
لكم دينكم ولي دين

Translation:
Say, O disbelievers
I do not worship what you worship
Nor are you worshippers of what I worship
And I will not worship what you worship
Nor will you worship what I worship
For you is your religion, and for me is mine

It is not merely a declaration of difference; it is a proclamation of peace. A separation without hostility. A firmness without hatred. It teaches us that coexistence does not require compromise in belief. That we may live among others, trade with them, speak kindly with them, yet faith remains pure, unbent.

The word كافرون comes from the root ك ف ر. Linguistically, the verb كفر means to cover, to conceal. In Arabic they say kafara al-zar' when a farmer covers the seed beneath the soil. So the kafir is the one who covers the truth, not one who never knew, but one who knew enough to hide it. It is a veil drawn over the heart, even when the signs shine like sunlight.

Yet look at the mercy: Allah did not command aggression. He did not say fight them for their disbelief. He said, to you your way, to me mine. A sentence that teaches dignity. We do not water down Islam for acceptance, but neither do we force belief upon any soul. Faith grows by light, not pressure.

This Surah is daleel that Islam recognizes the diversity of belief around us. We may disagree completely, yet we may live peacefully. Our worship is exclusively for Allah, undiluted by trends or compromises. And still, justice, kindness, good conduct remain commanded.

In this Surah is a mirror for our hearts: do I worship only Allah, or does the world slip into my devotion unnoticed? As disbelievers cover the truth, do we sometimes cover gratitude, cover obedience, cover the remembrance of Allah that softens the soul?

So let this Surah steady the believer's spine and soften the believer's gaze. Stand firm in tawheed (Oneness of Allah). Respect others without imitating. Live with people, but live for Allah.

لكم دينكم ولي دين
“To you your way, and to me mine”
Not as a wall of hatred
but as a line of clarity
drawn by wisdom
lit by mercy.

Koitalel Arap Samoei (c. 1860–1905) was the Orkoiyot, or supreme spiritual and military leader, of the Nandi people in Kenya from 1890 until his death. Born at Samitui in Aldai, he was the son of Kimnyole arap Turukat, who was also an Orkoiyot. Koitalel was noted for his ability to understand prophetic signs and was chosen as the successor to his father, who had reportedly predicted the coming of the Europeans. As the Orkoiyot, Koitalel was a sacred and special figure, holding the authority to make decisions regarding security matters, including waging war and negotiating peace.
Koitalel is best known for leading the protracted Nandi resistance against British colonial rule, which is considered one of the longest and fiercest resistance movements in Kenyan history, lasting for over a decade. The resistance began around 1896 in response to the construction of the Kenya-Uganda Railway, which was set to cut through Nandi territory. Koitalel viewed this as an intrusion and led his warriors in a campaign that utilized strategic guerrilla warfare, including numerous ambushes, sabotage of the railway tracks, and attacks on British personnel. The Nandi fighters, known for their prowess, frequently disrupted the railway construction, stealing materials to make weapons and ornaments.
The resistance effectively ended with the assassination of Koitalel Arap Samoei on October 19, 1905, in an act of treachery by the British. British intelligence officer Colonel Richard Meinertzhagen arranged a meeting under the guise of negotiating a peace treaty to end the conflict. Despite sensing danger, Koitalel attended the meeting at Ketbarak (now the Nandi Bears Club), accompanied by his aides. Meinertzhagen, who had hidden numerous armed soldiers nearby, shot Koitalel at point-blank range, killing him and his entire entourage. Following this, the British forces decapitated Koitalel, taking his skull and some of his artifacts to Britain. The loss of their supreme leader effectively broke the Nandi's will to continue the full-scale resistance, allowing the British to bring the territory under control.

Topik kafir ni selalu buat orang panas. Baru buka mulut sikit, dah ada orang rasa dituduh. Tak dan nak faham cerita, topik dah close. Al Quran tak suruh kita cop siapa kafir. Al Quran suruh kita kenal apa itu kekafiran. Sebab bahaya sebenar bukan orang lain kafir. Bahaya sebenar bila kita sendiri ada sifat kafir, tapi rasa diri selamat dan okay sahaja.
.
.
.
Penulisan ni kita nak sembang santai pasal,

"salah tanggapan tentang kafir", 

Oleh itu, kita kena mula faham satu perkara;
.
"Kafir bukan sekadar, dah tak jadi orang Islam". 
.
Ramai yang ingat kafir itu hanya untuk orang bukan Islam sahaja, tapi hakikatnya, dalam kalangan orang Islam sendiri pun ramai yang sebenarnya jatuh dalam kekafiran tanpa sedar.  

Cuma masalahnya, bila cakap pasal ni, terus ada yang kata 
.
“Eh, ko ni jangan suka-suka kafirkan orang!”. 
.
.
.  
Betul, memang kita tak boleh mengkafirkan orang sembarangan, tapi kita juga kena faham yang Allah dah tetapkan ciri-ciri kafir dalam Al Quran.  

Maknanya, kalau seseorang menepati ciri-ciri yang Allah sebut sebagai kafir, maka secara automatik dia memang tergolong dalam kategori tu. 

Tak perlu pun kita nak tuduh atau cop dia kafir, sebab hukum Allah berjalan  automatik apabila kondisinya ditepati.
.
.
.    
.
Saya simple sahaja pandangan saya dan ini contoh ke"simple"lan saya;
.
"Dalam Al Quran Allah suruh wanita tutup aurat"

"Tak tutup itu ingkar lah. Ingkar tu kafir lah pada ayat itu".
.
.
Kita diam ke, kita kafirkan dia ke, ia tak mengubah apa-apa kenyataan tentang dirinya yang enggan tutup aurat.

Kafir ni bukan sebab kita yang tentukan, tapi Allah yang tetapkan. 

Kalau orang buat perkara yang terang-terang disebut dalam Al Quran sebagai kekafiran, maka dia dah masuk dalam kategori tu, sama ada kita sebut atau tak sebut, kita tuduh atau kita diam.  

Dan inilah sebabnya ramai yang tanpa sedar termasuk dalam 72 golongan daripada 73 yang ke neraka. Nampak macam beriman, tapi mengingkari.

Percaya pada sebahagian, tolak sebahagian. Buat baik dalam banyak perkara, tapi dalam satu dua perkara penting, lawan keterangan ayat Allah. Kafir la tu.  

Jadi, daripada sibuk nak cop orang lain kafir atau tak, lebih baik kita tengok diri sendiri dulu. 

Ada tak ciri-ciri kekafiran yang Allah sebut tu dalam diri kita tanpa sedar? 

Sebabnya, benda paling bahaya bukan orang lain kafir, tapi bila kita sendiri ada sifat kafir tapi tak nampak! Sebab kafir tak nampak kat cermin.

Sebab itu dalam ebook, saya amalkan secara sukarela syahadah pada permulaan wirid selepas solat.

Setidak-tidaknya saya renew syahadah saya segera, jika tanpa sedar saya kafir pada mana-mana ayat Allah swt.
.
.
.
.  
Kekafiran Dalam Al Quran 

Kalau kita nak faham apa itu kafir dalam Al Quran, kita kena tengok apa maksud asal perkataan ini.  

Dalam bahasa Arab, "kafir" (كَافِرٌ) ini berasal dari perkataan "kafara" (كَفَرَ) yang maksudnya adalah menutup atau mengingkari. 

Jadi, dalam konteks agama, kafir merujuk kepada seseorang yang menutup atau mengingkari kebenaran yang Allah tunjukkan.  

Tapi, 
.
jangan terus fikir kafir = bukan Islam,
.
sebab Al Quran sebenarnya guna perkataan ini dalam beberapa makna yang berbeza. 

Mari kita tengok satu per satu. 
.
.
.
1.  Kafir = Orang yang Tolak Kebenaran

Ini definisi yang paling jelas dalam Al Quran. Kafir ialah orang yang dah tahu kebenaran tapi tetap tolak.
  
Allah sebut dalam Al Quran:  

"Dan sesiapa yang kufur kepada Allah setelah dia beriman, kecuali orang yang dipaksa (kufur) sedangkan hatinya tetap tenang dengan iman, tetapi sesiapa yang melapangkan dadanya untuk kufur, maka atas mereka kemurkaan Allah dan bagi mereka azab yang besar."

(Surah An-Nahl 16:106)
.
.
Jadi, kalau seseorang dah tahu Islam itu benar, tapi tetap menolak, dia termasuk dalam kategori ini.  
.
.
. 
2.  Kafir = Menyekutukan Allah
 
Ada juga yang disebut kafir sebab menyamakan Allah dengan sesuatu yang lain.

Contohnya menyembah berhala atau menganggap ada Tuhan lain selain Allah.  

Allah tegaskan dalam Al Quran:  

"Sesungguhnya telah kafirlah orang-orang yang berkata: ‘Sesungguhnya Allah itu ialah al-Masih putera Maryam’."
 
(Surah Al-Ma'idah 5:72)  
.
Maksudnya, sesiapa yang syirik iaitu menyekutukan Allah, dia juga termasuk dalam kategori kafir menurut Al Quran.  
. 
.
.
3.  Kafir = Orang yang Tolak Nabi dan Wahyu
  
Al Quran juga guna istilah kafir untuk mereka yang menolak kenabian dan wahyu Allah.  

Allah sebut begini:  

"Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang kafir kepada Allah dan rasul-rasul Nya, dan (bermaksud) hendak membezakan antara (keimanan kepada) Allah dan rasul-rasul-Nya serta berkata, 'Kami beriman kepada sebahagian dan kami kafir terhadap sebahagian (yang lain),' serta bermaksud mengambil jalan tengah (di antara iman dan kafir), merekalah orang-orang kafir yang sebenar."_  

(Surah An-Nisa’ 4:150-151) 

Jadi, kalau seseorang percaya pada sebahagian ajaran Allah tapi sengaja tolak sebahagian lain walau sedikit, dia boleh termasuk dalam kategori ini.  
.
.
.
4.  Kafir = Kufur Nikmat (Tak Bersyukur)
  
Ini yang ramai orang tak perasan. Kafir bukan hanya soal akidah, tapi juga digunakan untuk orang yang tak bersyukur dengan nikmat Allah.  

Allah pesan dalam Al-Quran:  

"Maka ingatlah kepada-Ku, Aku pun akan ingat kepadamu. Bersyukurlah kepada-Ku dan janganlah kamu kufur (kafir) terhadap nikmat-Ku."  

(Surah Al-Baqarah 2:152)  

Maksudnya, kalau kita dapat rezeki tapi tak hargai atau gunakan ke jalan yang salah, itu juga satu bentuk kufur.  
.
.
.
.
.
Ini kesimpulan saya tapi rujuklah pada yang pakar

Jangan cepat melabel dan jangan pula rasa selesa. Kita kena berhati-hati dalam guna perkataan ini. 

Bila kita baca Al Quran, kita akan nampak kafir ini bukan satu maksud sahaja. 

Ada kafir akidah, kafir penolakan dan kafir nikmat.  

Orang nak gelar apa kisah, yang penting kita.

Satu ayat kita ingkar pada Al Quran, kita akan kafir penolakan kepada wahyu Allah walau pada akidahnya kita masih beriman.

Kita fokus pada menyampaikan kebenaran, bukan menjatuhkan hukuman.
.
. 
. 
.
Bagaimana Kafir Terjadi?

Berdasarkan pemerhatian saya kepada Al Quran, saya melihat kekafiran berlaku pada salah satu tempat ini.
.
1️⃣ Perbuatan keingkaran dengan hati

✔ Ini merujuk kepada sikap dalaman seseorang yang menolak atau ragu-ragu terhadap kebenaran. Dia tak zahirkan pun tapi Rabb tahu dia ingkar.

✔ Contohnya, seseorang dalam hati tidak mahu menerima Islam walaupun tahu ia benar atau seseorang yang tidak yakin dengan hukum Allah tetapi tidak menzahirkannya.
  
✔ Dalam AlQuran, ini boleh dikaitkan dengan kafir yang menolak dengan hati tetapi berpura-pura beriman (seperti golongan munafik). 
 
"Dalam hati mereka ada penyakit, lalu Allah tambahkan penyakit itu; dan bagi mereka azab yang pedih disebabkan mereka berdusta."
  
(Surah Al-Baqarah 2:10) 

So, salah satu bentuk keingkaran adalah iman bermula dari qalbu, jadi kalau qalbu sendiri sudah menolak kebenaran, itu adalah tahap pertama kekufuran.  
.
.
.
2️⃣ Perbuatan keingkaran dengan lisan  

✔ Ini pula merujuk kepada orang yang menyatakan penolakan terhadap kebenaran melalui penzahiran kata-kata mereka.
  
✔ Contohnya, seseorang yang berkata "Islam itu mana boleh pakai zaman sekarang" atau "Aku tidak percaya lah Al Quran ada semua perkara", walaupun mungkin dalam hatinya dia ada sedikit kepercayaan.
  
✔ Al Quran banyak sebutkan tentang orang yang mengingkari kebenaran secara lisan ini, contohnya kaum yang menolak Nabi dan wahyu Allah.  

"Dan mereka berkata: ‘Hati kami tertutup dari apa yang kamu seru kami kepadanya, dan pada telinga kami ada sumbatan, dan di antara kami dan kamu ada dinding, maka beramallah kamu, sesungguhnya kami juga beramal.’"

(Surah Fussilat 41:5)  

Jadi memang betul bahawa keingkaran yang dinyatakan secara lisan adalah lebih jelas daripada yang hanya tersimpan dalam hati. Ini tahap kedua. Dalam Islam, ucapan boleh membawa seseorang kepada kekufuran jika ia jelas menolak kebenaran. 
.
.
.
3️⃣ Perbuatan keingkaran dengan fizikal
 
✔ Ini adalah tahap keingkaran yang paling nyata, iaitu apabila seseorang melakukan tindakan yang membuktikan penolakannya terhadap Islam dan kebenaran. 

✔ Contohnya:  

   - Sujud kepada berhala dengan sengaja.  

   - Membakar atau mencemarkan Al Quran dengan niat menolak Islam.
  
   - Menyerang Islam secara fizikal (seperti menindas orang beriman atau memerangi umat Islam). 
 
   - Percaya kepada pakar mengatasi kepercayaan isi Al Quran.

✔ Allah menyebut tentang orang yang bukan sekadar menolak Islam, tetapi juga melawan dan menghalang orang lain daripada beriman:  

"Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang kafir dan menghalangi (orang lain) dari jalan Allah serta menentang Rasul setelah jelas bagi mereka petunjuk, mereka tidak akan dapat memberi mudarat kepada Allah sedikit pun, dan Allah akan menghapuskan segala amal mereka."
 
(Surah Muhammad 47:32) 

Jadi ini tahap ketiga dan tertinggi dalam keingkaran kerana ia bukan sekadar di hati atau lisan, tetapi sudah menjadi tindakan nyata yang menolak atau memerangi Islam.
.
.
.
.
So, saya harap lepas ini masing-masing sudah memahami apa itu kekafiran.
.
Jadi selepas ini, biarlah kita kurang sibuk mencari siapa kafir. Jadilah lebih jujur bertanya pada diri sendiri. Di bahagian mana dalam hidup ini kita sedang ingkar tanpa sedar.
.
.
.

For many victims, the harm is not only reputational. Anxiety, sleeplessness, and isolation follow. Some withdraw from public life. Others change jobs or move cities. The burden falls hardest on women and young people, but anyone with a public photo can be targeted. This is not a niche problem. It is a scale problem.

The most chilling part is how ordinary the tools have become. A single image pulled from a profile can be enough. There's no need for any prior relationship. Just access, intent, and time. The line between reality and fabrication blurs, while accountability lags behind.

This is why we need clearer laws, faster takedowns, and better literacy. Platforms must treat non-consensual synthetic intimate content as an urgent abuse issue. Schools and workplaces must teach what this is and how to respond. And we must stop treating it as gossip or shock content.

 Could you talk about this, please? Share resources. Support policies that protect consent and identity. If you see explicit content shared without permission, please don't share it. Please report it. Believe victims. Silence is what allows this to grow.

Swahaba mtukufu Usāmah bin Zayd (r.a) alikuwa mtoto wa wazazi wawili Waislamu wakarimu, miongoni mwa waliotangulia kuingia katika Uislamu. Baba yake ni Zayd bin Hārithah, na mama yake ni Bibi Ummu Ayman, mlezi na mlelewa wa Mtume Muhammad (s.a.w).

Usāmah alikuwa mweusi sana wa ngozi, mchangamfu, jasiri, na mwenye roho nyepesi. Alilelewa na Mtume (s.a.w) na alimpenda sana, kama alivyompenda baba yake. Kwa sababu hiyo aliitwa “mpenzi wa mpenzi” (al-ḥibb bin al-ḥibb). Mtume (s.a.w) alikuwa akimchukua Usāmah pamoja na Hasan, na kusema:
“Ewe Allah, wapende hawa wawili, kwani mimi nawapenda.”
(Hadithi hii imepokelewa na Ahmad na Bukhari).

Usāmah alikuwa mnyenyekevu sana, mwenye akili kali, na alijitolea kwa nguvu zake zote kwa ajili ya dini yake na itikadi yake.

Mwaka wa kufunguliwa kwa Makka, (Fat'hu Makkah) Usāmah (r.a) alitoka pamoja na Mtume (s.a.w) akiwa amepanda nyuma yake juu ya nyumbu wake. Mtume (s.a.w) aliingia ndani ya Kaaba kuswali rakaa mbili, akiwa pamoja na Usāmah na Bilal (r.a). Usāmah alianguka chini na kipaji chake cha uso kikajeruhiwa. Mtume (s.a.w) alisimama haraka na kufunga damu iliyokuwa ikitiririka hadi ikasimama.

Siku moja, Usāmah (r.a) alipokea funzo kubwa kutoka kwa Mtume (s.a.w) ambalo hakulisahau kamwe. Usāmah anasimulia:
“Mtume (s.a.w) alitutuma kwenda Al-Ḥuraqah. Tulishambulia watu asubuhi na tukawashinda. Mimi na mtu mmoja wa Ansar tukamfuata mtu mmoja wao. Tulipomzingira, alisema: ‘La ilaha illa Allah.’ Yule Ansari akajizuia, lakini mimi nikamdunga kwa mkuki hadi nikamuua. Tuliporudi, habari zikamfikia Mtume (s.a.w), naye akasema:
‘Ewe Usāmah, ulimuua baada ya kusema La ilaha illa Allah?’
Nikajibu: ‘Alikuwa anajilinda tu.’
Mtume (s.a.w) akaendelea kurudia maneno hayo mpaka nikatamani lau sikuwa nimeingia Uislamu kabla ya siku ile. Kisha nikamwambia Mtume (s.a.w): ‘Ninampa Allah ahadi kwamba sitamuua tena mtu yeyote anayesema La ilaha illa Allah.’ Mtume (s.a.w) akasema: ‘Baada yangu, ewe Usāmah?’ Nikasema: ‘Ndiyo, baada yako.’”
(Imepokelewa na Bukhari).

Usāmah (r.a) alikuwa na sifa zote za kiongozi shujaa, jambo lililoongeza mapenzi na heshima ya Mtume (s.a.w) kwake. Hivyo Mtume (s.a.w) akamteua kuwa kamanda wa jeshi la Waislamu kwenda kupigana na Warumi, licha ya kuwa katika jeshi hilo walikuwapo masahaba wakubwa kama Abu Bakr na Umar (r.a). Baadhi ya Waislamu waliona jambo hilo ni kubwa kwa Usāmah na wakaanza kuzungumza. Mtume (s.a.w) alipopata habari hiyo, alipanda mimbari, akamhimidi Allah na kumsifu, kisha akasema:
“Mkikosoa uongozi wake, basi mlilikosoa pia uongozi wa baba yake hapo kabla. Naapa kwa Allah, alikuwa anastahili uongozi na anaufaa. Na alikuwa miongoni mwa watu niliowapenda zaidi, na huyu (Usāmah) ni miongoni mwa ninaowapenda zaidi baada yake.”
(Hadithi hii imekubaliwa na Bukhari na Muslim).

Mtume (s.a.w) alifariki kabla jeshi la Usāmah (r.a) halijaondoka kuelekea lengo aliloliweka, yaani kupigana na Warumi. Kabla ya kufariki, Mtume (s.a.w) aliwausia masahaba wake wasisite kulipeleka jeshi la Usāmah, akisema:
“Tekelezeni msafara wa Usāmah, tekelezeni msafara wa Usāmah.”

Abu Bakr (r.a) alipokuwa khalifa baada ya Mtume (s.a.w), alisisitiza kutekeleza wasia huo. Umar (r.a) akamwambia: “Ansar wanaona afadhali aongoze jeshi mtu mwenye umri mkubwa zaidi kuliko Usāmah.” Abu Bakr (r.a) akakasirika na kusema:
“Umefiwa na mama yako ewe Ibn al-Khattab! Mtume (s.a.w) alimchagua, je, unaniamuru nimvue? Naapa kwa Yule ambaye nafsi yangu iko mkononi Mwake, hata kama ningedhani wanyama wakali wangeninyakua, bado ningepeleka jeshi la Usāmah.”

Usāmah (r.a) akaondoka Madina na jeshi lake, na Abu Bakr (r.a) akatoka kuagana nao. Usāmah akiwa juu ya farasi wake, akamwona Abu Bakr akitembea kwa miguu. Akaona haya na kusema:
“Ewe Khalifa wa Mtume (s.a.w), ama upande au nishuke.”
Abu Bakr akasema:
“Naapa kwa Allah sitashuka wala sitapanda. Si vibaya kwangu miguu yangu ichafuliwe na vumbi kwa saa moja katika njia ya Allah.”
Kisha Abu Bakr akaomba ruhusa kwa Usāmah amuache Umar abaki Madina kumsaidia katika mambo ya utawala, akatoa mfano mkubwa wa kuomba idhini kwa kamanda, hata kama ni mdogo kwa umri.

Jeshi la Usāmah (r.a) likafika Balqā’, likashambulia vijiji alivyobainisha Mtume (s.a.w) na Abu Bakr (r.a). Wakawashinda maadui, wakateka nyara, wakakusanya ngawira, kisha wakarudi Madina wakiwa washindi bila kupoteza hata askari mmoja. Waislamu wakasema siku hiyo:
“Hatukuwahi kuona jeshi salama kama jeshi la Usāmah.”

Umar bin al-Khattab (r.a) alipokuwa akigawa mali ya Baytul-Māl, alimpa Usāmah (r.a) sehemu ya dirham 3,500, ilhali alimpa mwanawe Abdullah dirham 3,000. Abdullah bin Umar akamwambia baba yake:
“Umempa Usāmah zaidi yangu, ilhali mimi nilishuhudia pamoja na Mtume (s.a.w) mambo ambayo yeye hakuyashuhudia.”
Umar (r.a) akamjibu:
“Haikutoshitu kuwa Usāmah alikuwa mpendwa zaidi kwa Mtume (s.a.w) kuliko wewe, na baba yake alikuwa mpendwa zaidi kwa Mtume (s.a.w) kuliko baba yako.”

Wakati fitna ilipotokea kati ya Ali na Mu‘āwiyah (r.a), Usāmah alisimama upande wa kutoegemea, licha ya mapenzi yake makubwa kwa Ali. Alimtumia Ali ujumbe akisema:
“Ewe Aba al-Hasan, naapa kwa Allah, kama ungelishika mdomo wa simba, ningeushika upande mwingine pamoja nawe hadi tuangamie wote au tuokoke wote. Lakini katika jambo hili ulilomo, naapa kwa Allah sitaingia kamwe.”
Hivyo Usāmah (r.a) alikaa nyumbani kwake kipindi cha fitna ili asimuue Muislamu yeyote.

Usāmah (r.a) alikuwa mwingi wa ibada, na alikuwa akidumisha kufunga siku za Jumatatu na Alhamisi licha ya uzee wake na udhaifu wa mwili, kwa kumuiga Mtume (s.a.w). Alifariki katika ukhalifa wa Mu‘āwiyah bin Abi Sufyan mwaka 54 Hijria, na akazikwa katika makaburi ya Baqī‘.

Ukimaliza kusoma ujumbe huu, mswalie Mtume Muhammad (s.a.w). Na andika angalau jina moja miongoni mwa majina matukufu 99 ya Allah Subhaanahu wataala ☝️ ♥️

Ahmad Baba al-Timbukti (1556–1627) remains one of the most prominent African intellectuals to legally challenge the racialization of slavery in the 16th century. His most significant work on this subject is the treatise Mi’raj al-Su’ud (The Ladder of Ascent), written in response to a merchant's inquiry about the legality of enslaving "Sudanese" (West African) captives.
1. Rejection of Skin Color as Legal Status
Ahmad Baba argued that unbelief (kufr), not skin color or race, was the only lawful justification for enslavement under Islamic law. He explicitly stated that there was no inherent difference between "blacks and whites" regarding their human rights; religious status was the sole criterion.
2. Critique of the "Hamitic Myth"
He was one of the first scholars to actively dismantle the "Curse of Ham" narrative in the Islamic world—a Biblical interpretation used by some contemporary Arab and North African slave traders to claim that Black Africans were divinely destined for servitude. He identified this as a distortion lacking valid theological basis in the Quran.
3. Burden of Proof on the Enslaver
Ahmad Baba established a "presumption of freedom," arguing that because major West African kingdoms (like Borno, Gao, Kano, and Katsina) had embraced Islam of their own free will, their people were inherently free. He insisted that the burden of proof fell on the slave trader to prove that an individual was captured as a non-Muslim during a legitimate war, rather than simply assuming their status based on their African origin.
4. Limits of the Argument
While Ahmad Baba's rulings were revolutionary for their rejection of racial essentialism, they were not abolitionist in the modern sense:
Religion-Based Enslavement: He maintained that slavery remained "legitimate" for non-Muslims captured in war.
The "Shallow Belief" Exception: He noted that if a population's adherence to Islam was deemed "shallow" or if they were conquered as non-believers, their enslavement could still be legally justified under the standards of his time.

WANENE SHEHIN MALAMI IBN RUSHUD?
Ali Àbubakar Sadiq

Shekaru 825 kenan a wannan wata na December da rasuwar Shehin Malami ABU AL-WALID MUHAMMAD IBN AHMAD (IBN RUSHDI), Allah ya rahama masa. Ibn Rushud ya kasance masanin falsafa wanda ba ma a duniyar musulunci kadai ba, a fannin falsafanci ya kasance tauraro a duniya wanda nazarce nazarcensa cikin littafai da ya wallafa ba shi da na biyu. 

Wannan gwarzo tunaninsa ya wuce na zamaninsa, kai har ma da na zamunnan da su ka biyo bayansa. Za ku iya yarda da ni domin duk wanda ya karanta littafinsa "DAIDAITO TSAKANIN FALSAFA DA ADDINI" wanda a yanzu sama da shekaru 800 da su ka wuce kenan da rubuta shi, a yau a arewacin Najeriya idan mu ka yi nazarin abubuwan da ke faruwa, sai ka ce tamkar mu ya rubutawa wannan littafi, ganin yadda kungiyoyin sufaye su ka shiga rudani sakamakon wadanda ba su cancanta ba an bude musu kofar fassarori na badini wanda maimakon ya inganta imaninsu da musulunci, sai su ka kama hanyar tabewa da yin sabo yadda zaka ga mutane na kiran kansu Alloli, su kira shaihunnansu Alloli, wasu kuma su rika kiran kansu annabawa duk da cewa Allah ya ce mana Manzon Allah shine “Khatamun Nabiy”.

Ibn Rushid likita ne kuma alkali, fannoni biyu da ya yi shura, yadda a zamaninsa ba kamarsa a kowanne bangaren guda biyu, domin littafinsa a kan likitanci KITAB AL KULYAT FI AL-TIBB ya kasance abinda ake kira “encyclopedia” wanda ya zama magaryar-tukewa ga likitocin musulmi, kiristoci da yahudawa, tsawon shekaru daruruwa bayan rasuwarsa, baya ga sharhi da yayi na littafan Ibn Sina da na Galen a kan likitanci. Haka abin ya ke a bangaren alkalanci inda har sai da ya zama babban Alkalin-Alkalan Cordova kuma ya yi rubuce rubuce da dama a fannin. 

Amma a inda Ibn Rushid ya fi shahara kuma aka fi saninsa shine bangaren falsafanci kuma a cikin littafan da ya rubuta a bangaren falsafanci akwai wanda na fassara zuwa Hausa "KITAB FASL AL MAQAL" (Daidaito tsakanin falsafa da addini) wanda a ciki ya yi bayanin alakar falsafanci da addini wajen fassara ayoyin Kur’ani, sannan da littafinsa "TAHAFUT AL TAHAFUT" (Shirmen mai shirme) raddi ne da ya yi kai tsaye akan littafin Ghazali mai suna TAHAFUT AL-FALSIFA (Shirmen masana falsafa). Akwai kuma littafinsa "KITAB AL JADAL" wanda sharhi ne akan falsafar Girkawa musamman Aristotle, sai kuma "BIDAYAT AL-MUJTAHID" littafi ne da ya nuna yadda alkali zai yi nazari a shari’a tare da fitar da hukunci ta bin tsarinsa na zurfin tunani da bincike, shi kuma littafin  "MANAHIJ AL-ADILLA", ya yi amfani da tsarin falsafanci wajen tabbatar da samuwar Allah a hankalce da a kimiyance sannan ya nuna yadda wasu darikoki ke da nakasu a wajen bayyana lamarin. Littafin "MABADI‘L FALASIFA" littafi ne wanda ya bayyana yadda masanin falsafa zai kasance a tsarinsa.

Tsawon shekarun rayuwarsa a wannan duniya 72, ya rubuta littafai sama da guda 100 a fannoni da suka hada da falsafa, likitanci, ilimin sararin samaniya, lissafi, aikin alkalanci, halayyar dan Adam, kimiyya, shari'a da luggar larabci.

Ibn Rushid ya sha gwagwarmaya a rayuwarsa yadda wasu malamai su ka yi gungu su ka kai kararsa gaban Khalifa Al-Mansur da zarginsa da kafirci. Halifan ya sa an tattaro duk littafansa an sa malamai sun yi nazarinsu da tantance su, wanda a karshe su ka yi musu mummunar fassara tare da bada fatawar cewa malamin ya zama “Mariq” wato "karamin kafiri" wanda ya cancanci a tsinewa. An tube shi daga alkalanci kuma aka kore shi daga garin Cordoba tare da kona duk littafansa da aka samu da hana shi yin wani rubutu. 
A lokacin da al’ummarsa su ka kasa fahimtarsa, kuma su ka ware shi tare da tsangwamarsa, sai ga shi turawa sun karbi tunaninsa wanda ya zama dan ba, ko mu ce ginshikin da ya fara samar da falsafar yamma (western philosophy), abinda ya yi tasiri a falsafancin kirista da yahudawa na turai. Mafi shaharar masana falsafa a kiristanci da yahudanci, wato Thomas Aquinas da kuma Mesmoinades, dukkansu turbar Ibn Rushid su ka bi kuma su ne su ka assassa falsafanci a kasashen yamma. Ibn Rushid ya wuce da falsafanci a duniyar musulmi, saboda daga kansa ba’a sake samun wani gagarumin masanin falsafa musulmi ba, amma kuma duk hanyoyin nazari da tunani mai zurfi (rationality) da ya gina, sai ya yi kaura zuwa turai. Ibn Rushid ya gina akidarsa a kan  cewa “Gaskiya daya ce, kuma gaskiya ba ta yaki da gaskiya duk da cewa akwai hanyoyi da dama na isa ga gaskiya: wato ta hanyar falsafanci ko ta hanyar addini. Don haka babu dalilin yaki tsakaninsu kuma nasarar guda, ta dayan ce”. 

To amma tsarin Ibn Rushid ya sami nakasu a hannun turawa domin bayan gina falsafancin a tsarinsa na zuzzurfan tunani (rationality) da kuma aure tsakanin falsafa da addini (yadda Thomas Aquinas da Mesmonaides su ka kwaikwaye shi) amma kash! daga baya sai wannan tsari na falsafanci ya dauki sabon salo a hannun turawa yadda aka sami karkasuwar falsafancin yamma zuwa wadanda su ka dauki abubuwa na zahiri (realism) a matsayin hanya kadai ta kaiwa ga gaskiya, sannan kuma wasu su ka dauki fannin badini (idealism) a matsayin hanyar gane gaskiya. 

Bangaren falsafanci na ‘yan badini ya samo asali tun daga Plato sannan a baya-baya Emmanuel Kant ya zama jagora sannan akwai irinsu Schopenhauer, Goerge Berkeley da Hegel wadanda ke bin wannan darika. Shi kuma falsafanci na ‘yan zahiri ya faro tun daga Aristotle inda a baya-baya muka ga irinsu Rene Descartes, Baruch Spinoza, John Locke da Betrand Russell.

Ibn Rushid ya zama daban a fannin falsafanci domin shine na farko da ya yarda cewa dole a dubi falsafanci tun daga inda ya samo asali wajen Girkawa, duk da cewa yawancinsu ana musu kallon ba ruwansu da addini (face kalilan irinsu Socrates wanda duk sharuddan annabta ya cika su). Ibn Rushud ya assasa cewa babu yadda za’a raba addini da falsafanci kuma wannan akida tasa ta samo asali idan muka lura da yadda a kullum Allah ke kiran mu da yin nazari, duba, kallo da sauran ire-iren wadannan kalmomi a cikin Kur’ani. Alal hakika ko kira ga imani da Allah, bai kai yawan kiran da Allah ke wa mutane zuwa ga falsafanci ba, e falsafanci, domin menene falsafanci idan ba nazari domin cimma gaskiya ba? Irin wannan kira ya zo a wurare sama da 800 cikin Kur’ani fiye da kiran a yi sallah da zakkah. Sannan kuma yaren Kur’ani a kullum ya na fifita masu ilimi, wadanda ya kira da Uli al-bab. Dadin dadawa ya nuna mana cewa a duniya ba wani matsayi a wajen mumini wanda ya wuce ya kai ga samun Yakini. Babu yadda zaka iya kaiwa ga yakini sai ka zarce yin imani kawai, ta hanyar pin tafakkari da akan ababen halitta, kamar yadda Babanmu Annabi Ibrahim ya nemi Allah ya nuna masa yadda ya ke fitar da matacce zuwa rayayye. Allah ya tambayi Ibrahimu shin ko bai yi imani ba ne? ya ce ya yi imani amma domin ya sami yakini, wanda shi ke ba zuciya nu thetsuwa. Wannan shine falsafanci.

Da a ce musulmi sun rungumi falsafanci yadda Ibn Rushid ya gina tsarinsa, hakika da musulmi sun kai gacin da Allah ke nufinsu a duniya, amma sdai malamai irinsu Ghazali su ka taimaka wajen murkushe falsafanci a duniyar musulunci.  Su kuma turawa da su ka dauka, sai su ka raba auren falsafanci da addini, amma duk da haka, rungumar falsafanci a tsarin rayuwarsu, ya basu damar mamayewa da mulkar duniya da kuma kyautata rayuwarsu.
 
Ibn Rushid, a doron kafadarsa ci gaban zamani ya samu, domin ayyukansa (da ire-irensa) su ka sa nazarin kimiyya ya kafu a daular Andalusiya. Turawa sun hango yadda wannan daula a cikin nahiyar turai ta zo ta kawo canji da ba’a taba ganin irinsa ba, yadda a garuruwan Cordoba da Toledo (Tamkar ka ce London da New York ne a yanzu) an kafa jami’o’i da madabba’u na buga littafai da dakunan binciken kimiyya, da dakunan nazari da benayen nazarin taurari da tituna maka-maka irin wadanda a yanzu ake kira boulevard wadanda ake kunnawa fitulun a-ci-balbal tsawon dare tun kafin dan Adam ya gano lantarki a manyan garuruwan Andalusiya irinsu Cordoba da Toledo. A wannan lokaci musulmi a Cordoba su ka gina gidajen wanka na jama’a sama da dari biyar a cikin garin a daidai lokacin da idan ka fito kofar gidanka a Paris, kwata ce za ta kama ka har idon kafa. Kuma ko sarauniyar Ingila a wancan lokacin ba ta wanka sai idan mai magani ne ya ce sai ta yi wanka don samun saukin wata larura. A lokacin da turawa ba sa wanka kuma su ke jefo bola kan titi a kofar gidajensu, a Cordoba da Toledo, magidanta sun fara amfani da labulen silki da kamfai da singileti farare na silki saboda tsafta. Hakika malamai irinsu Ibn Rushid su ne su ka gina wannan al’umma saboda yarda a yi amfani da tunani kafada da kafada da nassi domin kyautata rayuwar duniya da ta lahira. 

A yau idan ka tara Malamai Dari a kasar Hausa da wahala ka sami guda biyar wadanda su ka taba karanta littafin Ibn Rushid, saboda an toshewa mutane kafafe na yadda zasu bude tunaninsu domin su amfanawa al’umma su amfani kansu, saboda wasu sun gindaya cewa sai dai kawai a bi wasu kebabbun malamai (Salaf), babu ikon nazari da yin sabon ijtihadi.

Tarihi ya tabbatar mana da cewa babu wata al'umma da ta mulki duniya face ta yi fice a kan ilimin zamaninta. Ko a yau Turawa na mulkin duniya saboda sun zarce kowa ilimi, kuma a gaban idonmu mu na ganin yadda China ta yunkoro domin a dama da ita sakamakon fifita ilimi da ta yi. Amma mu a nan mun wayi gari Malamai sun kuntata tunaninsu kuma maimakon ilimintar da al'umma su tafi da zamani, sun jahiltar da mabiya da maishe su gidadawa, sannan kuma sun bige da fada da junansu a kan banbancin Akida, yadda suka kulle kawunansu a cikin akwati,  yadda ba su san me ke wanzuwa a wajen akwatin ba. Shin zamu iya kiran Malaman mu a yau magada Annabi? Ko shi Annabi kuna zato zai alfahari da malamanmu na yau?

History of Luanda Magere

Folklore of the Luo peoples of Kenya speaks of a mighty warrior known as Lwanda Magere. He was born in the year 1720 to Abonyo Wuod Omolo and his mother, Nyabera. After his mother died during his birth, he was taken into the care of his grandmother, Rapondi. His father died in one of the numerous wars with their Nandi neighbors when Magere was barely a teenager. He belonged to the Sidho clan in Kano, on the shores of Lake Victoria. The Sidho clan occupies the present-day sugar belt at the foot of the Nandi escarpment. He possessed unearthly powers, and his flesh was made of stone. He deflected arrows, spears and clubs, making him invincible during war. He was famously known for his capability to tear an entire army apart on his own.

Story The traditional Luo enemies at the time were the jo Lang'o, the Luo name for the Kalenjin community. The Lang'o, tired of being defeated in war by the Luo, sat down with Nandi elders to discuss the issue and came to the conclusion that they would give Lwanda Magere the woman taputany to marry, claiming it was a gesture of peace. Chepkirui's real role was to find out how to defeat him. Though the Luo elders advised him not to marry her, Luanda Magere did not heed their advice.

After many attempts, Taputany was successful when, one day, he fell ill and called for taputany to take care of him. Luanda instructed her to cut his shadow with a knife and administer the medicine. She was surprised when she saw his shadow bleed. That night, she crept out of Lwanda's home, ran back to her people and told them her husband's weakness.

They then attacked the Luo. The Luo fought fiercely and Lwanda killed so many Nandi warriors that they decided to retreat. As they were running, one Nandi warrior remembered that Lwanda's strength was in his shadow. He stood at a hill and threw his spear at Lwanda's shadow. Luanda Magere fell down and died, and his body turned to stone.

As is the case with many myths, the story comes with several variations depending on the source material.

A quiet, dazzling masterpiece that still shines brighter than any jewel🚩
Step into the Vasantha Mantapa of Bhoga Nandeeshwara Temple, and time melts away.
Four gleaming black soapstone pillars rise like frozen music, each one lathe-turned to mirror perfection in the 8th–9th century, when such precision seemed impossible. They catch the slanting sunlight and throw it back as liquid gold.
But look closer: every centimetre is alive with microscopic carvings, thousands of miniature gods, goddesses, celestial dancers, warriors, elephants, and flowering creepers, all carved so finely you’d swear they were embroidered rather than chiselled. Shiva dances, Parvati smiles, Ganesha blesses, and yalis roar, all in a space smaller than your fingertip.
This open-air “Spring Pavilion” was built for fragrant vasantha festivals: once its centre held a lotus-filled tank reflecting these very pillars under the full moon. Even today, the breeze still moves between the columns as it did twelve centuries ago.
Crafted under the early Rashtrakutas and Gangas at the foot of Nandi Hills, it remains one of India’s most breathtaking works of stone, where engineering meets devotion and leaves you speechless.

FOOD FOR THOUGHT (MEXICO): On Nov. 25 (25N), the International Day for the Elimination of Violence Against Women, organisations highlight that digital abuse in Mexico is rising, from deepfake pornography and online harassment to political attacks. Recent cases affecting hundreds of students highlight the urgent need for stronger legal, technical, and organizational responses.

AI has expanded the capabilities, and risks, of digital violence, making abuse easier to execute and harder to trace. Experts highlight the need for legal updates, digital literacy, and preventive measures alongside investigative improvements. But new AI tools demonstrate how AI can also support prevention by analysing risk patterns and guiding organisational responses.

Preventing digital violence requires coordinated action across legal, technical, and cultural domains. Evidence shows that punitive measures alone are insufficient. Strengthening investigative capacity, promoting digital literacy with a gender perspective, and supporting advocacy networks are crucial.

▶️ Step into the Vasantha Maṇṭapa of the Bhoga Nandeeshwara Temple, and time itself seems to dissolve.

▶️ Four gleaming pillars of deep black soapstone rise like frozen music. Lathe turned to mirror-like perfection in the 8th-9th century CE, they reflect slanting sunlight as if the stone itself were molten gold an achievement of precision that feels astonishing even today.

▶️ Look closer, and the true marvel reveals itself. Every inch of these pillars is alive with microscopic carvings thousands of miniature gods and goddesses, celestial dancers, warriors, elephants, yalis, and flowering creepers. The detailing is so delicate it feels less like stonework and more like fine embroidery. Shiva dances, Parvati smiles, Ganesha blesses entire worlds unfold within spaces smaller than a fingertip.

▶️ This open air “Spring Pavilion” was created for the sacred Vasantha festivals. At its heart once lay a lotus-filled water tank, mirroring the pillars under moonlight. Even today, the breeze flows gently between the columns, just as it did over twelve centuries ago.

▶️ Crafted under the early Rashtrakuta and Ganga dynasties, at the foothills of Nandi Hills, the Vasantha Mantapa stands as one of India most breathtaking achievements where engineering meets devotion, and stone is transformed into poetry.

KIMBUNDU 

Victor Mateus Kiala mulongexi wa madimi ni mubhangi wa Xikola Milongi, ilonga o madimi metu a uvwalukilu wa ixi ya Ngola. A muvwalela ku Luwanda, mu mbonge ya Maianga, mu kizuwa kya 3 kya mbeji ya kavwa wa muvu 1997, anga wa kulu ku mwiji mukwa bakongo, a zwela o dizwi dya Kikongo.

Tunde ku undenge we wa mateka kubhana valolo ku madimi metu a uvwalukilu. Ku muvu wa 2012, wa mateka kudilonga Kimbundu bhu kaxi ka minangu ya jimbangi ja Jihova. Tunde ku muvu wa 2016, wa mateka kudilonga Kimbundu ubheka we, wa tenene kutanga, kusoneka ni kuzwela mu ukexilu wambote. 

Tunde ku muvu wa 2017, wene mu kalakala kala mulongexi wa Kimbundu, wala ni kwijiya ni uhete wa kulonga pholo ni pholo ni bhu kaxi ka internete. Mu muvu wa 2020, wa mateka kulonga bhu kaxi ka internete mu jirede socias. 

Ku muvu wa 2022 wa jikula o xikola ya Milongi, wene mu longa mu ukexilu wambote ni bhu kaxi ka kudizwelesa o madimi a uvwalukilu wa ixi ya Ngola, mu ku kukwatekesa kubhana valolo ku madimi a xyetu. 

PORTUGUÊS 

Vítor Mateus Kiala é educador linguístico e fundador da Escola Milongi, dedicada ao ensino das línguas nacionais angolanas. Nasceu em Luanda, no município da Maianga, a 3 de junho de 1997, e cresceu numa família bakongo, onde o kikongo é a língua predominante.
Desde cedo desenvolveu interesse pelas línguas nacionais. Em 2012, iniciou o aprendizado da língua nacional kimbundu por meio de um programa das Testemunhas de Jeová. A partir de 2016, passou a estudar kimbundu de forma autônoma e autodidata, alcançando competências funcionais de leitura, escrita e comunicação oral.
Desde 2017, atua como professor de língua nacional kimbundu, com experiência no ensino presencial e online. Em 2020, iniciou aulas virtuais por meio das redes sociais. Em 2022, fundou a Escola Milongi, com foco no ensino comunicativo e prático das línguas nacionais, contribuindo para a valorização do património linguístico angolano.

#misteriDajjaldalameskatologiIslam

Dajjal kerap muncul sebagai salah satu sosok yang paling misterius dan penuh kontroversi dalam lintasan eskatologi Islam. Dajjal yang sering digambarkan sebagai pembohong ulung menjadi simbol dari puncak fitnah dan kekacauan menjelang akhir zaman.
Dalam Eskatologi Islam, Dajjal bersumber dari kata bahasa Arab yang berakar dari 'Dajala', yang berarti berbohong atau menipu. (Ibnu Manzur Al-Anshari, Lisanul 'Arab, [Beirut: Dar Shadr, 1994], halaman 236).
Dalam Al-Qur’an sendiri tidak ada penyebutan eksplisit perihal Dajjal, namun beberapa detail banyak disebutkan dalam hadits. Dengan demikian, penting bagi kita untuk mengimani perkara yang gaib, atau dalam ilmu tauhid disebut dengan sam’iyyat, yaitu di mana segala sesuatunya tidak bisa dijangkau dengan akal manusia, melainkan melalui keterangan yang disediakan oleh Allah Yang Maha Tahu.

Para ulama memiliki ragam pendapat terkait Dajjal, apakah nama tersebut menunjukkan sosok individu, atau hanya ungkapan metafora yang melambangkan fitnah, kebohongan, dusta dan keburukan yang akan tersebar di akhir zaman? Berikut salah satu hadits populer terkait dengan Dajjal :

عن سفينة مولى رسول الله ﷺ قال: خطبنا رسول الله ﷺ فقال: ” ألا إنه لم يكن نبي قبلي إلا قد حذر الدجال أمته، هو أعور عينه اليسرى، بعينه اليمنى ظفرة غليظة، مكتوب بين عينيه: كافر، يخرج معه واديان; أحدهما جنة والآخر نار، فناره جنة، وجنته نار، معه ملكان من الملائكة يشبهان نبيين من الأنبياء، ولو شئت سميتهما بأسمائهما وأسماء آبائهما، أحدهما عن يمينه، والآخر عن شماله، وذلك فتنة، فيقول الدجال: ألست بربكم؟ ألست أحيي وأميت؟ فيقول له أحد الملكين: كذبت. ما يسمعه أحد من الناس إلا صاحبه، فيقول له: صدقت. فيسمعه الناس فيظنون أنما يصدق الدجال، وذلك فتنة، ثم يسير حتى يأتي المدينة، فلا يؤذن له فيها؟ فيقول: هذه قرية ذلك الرجل. ثم يسير حتى يأتي الشام، فيهلكه الله عند  عقبة أفيق.

Artinya : 
“Diriwayatkan dari Safinah pelayan Rasulullah saw, ia berkata; Rasulullah Saw menyampaikan khutbah kepada kami lalu beliau bersabda, 'Ingatlah, sesungguhnya tidak ada seorang Nabi pun sebelumku melainkan telah memperingatkan bahaya Dajjal terhadap umatnya. Ia bermata satu sebelah kiri, di mata kanannya terdapat kulit tebal, di antara kedua matanya tertulis 'kafir'. Dua lembah keluar bersamanya, salah satunya syurga dan yang lainnya neraka. Nerakanya adalah syurga dan syurganya adalah neraka. Ada dua malaikat bersamanya yang mirip dengan Nabi, andai aku mau pasti nama mereka berdua aku sebutkan dan nama-nama ayah-ayah mereka berdua. Salah satunya berada di sebelah kanan sementara yang lain berada di sebelah kiri. Itu adalah ujian. Kemudian Dajjal berkata. "Bukankah aku Rabb kalian, bukankah aku bisa menghidupkan dan mematikan?" Kemudian salah seorang malaikat menjawab, "Kau dusta." Tidak ada seorang pun mendengarnya selain temannya. Kemudian yang lain menjawab, "Kau benar." Orang-orang mendengarnya dan mengira malaikat itu membenarkan Dajjal. Itu adalah ujian. Kemudian Dajjal berjalan hingga tiba di Madinah tapi tidak diizinkan memasukinya. Ia berkata, "Ini adalah tempat orang itu." Selanjutnya Dajjal berjalan hingga tiba di Syam kemudian Allah membinasakannya di 'Aqabah Afiq'." (Hadits riwayat Ahmad Ibnu Hanbal, Musnad Ahmad bin Hanbal, [Beirut: Darul Fikr, 1991], jilid VIII, halaman 216).

Hadits tersebut berkualitas shahih, meskipun sebagian kritikus hadits memiliki penilaian yang berbeda terhadap satu perawi yang ada pada sanad hadits di atas, yaitu Hasraj bin Nubatah.
Mayoritas ulama menilainya sebagai perawi yang kredibel (tsiqah) dan layak (shalih), sedangkan as-Saji berpendapat dha'if (lemah), dan Ibnu Hajar al-'Asqalani menyebutnya kurang teliti, namun kepribadiannya baik sehingga hadits cenderung diterima dengan catatan. (Ibnu Hajar al-'Asqalani, Tahdzibut Tahdzib, [Beirut: Darul Fikr, 1995], halaman 120). 
Imam an-Nawawi berpendapat bahwa hadits-hadits Dajjal seperti di atas adalah dalil dari Allah untuk menguji keimanan hamba-hamba-Nya, apakah percaya dengan eksistensi Dajjal atau tidak.
Adapun mazhab Ahlussunnah wal Jama’ah, para ahli hadits, dan ahli fiqih meyakini kebenarannya. Berbeda dengan orang-orang Khawarij maupun Mu’tazilah yang mengingkarinya. (An-Nawawi, Al-Minhaj Syarh Shahih Muslim, [Beirut: Dar Ihya at-Turats 'Arabi, 1972], halaman 58).

Dajjal Sebagai Sosok Individu
Beberapa hadits menyebut karakteristik Dajjal secara spesifik, yaitu wujudnya yang berasal dari kalangan manusia, berambut keriting, keningnya lebar, badannya gemuk, pundaknya bidang, berkulit merah dan salah satu matanya seperti buah anggur. 
Dajjal juga diberikan oleh Allah kemampuan luar biasa untuk menguji ketakwaan manusia. Ia mampu mengeluarkan sihir, menghidupkan orang mati, menurunkan hujan dan menyuburkan tanah, dan bergerak dengan cepat di muka bumi.
Imam an-Nawawi juga menyebutkan bahwa tanda 'Kafara' atau bermakna kafir pada dahi Dajjal adalah petunjuk yang kuat atas kedustaan dan kekafirannya. Allah akan menampakkannya kepada orang Islam, dan menyembunyikannya dari orang akan terperdaya oleh sosok tersebut.

Mayoritas riwayat yang menggambarkan Dajjal adalah dengan menyebut ciri-ciri fisik yang jelas, hingga tanda-tanda kehidupannya. Maka berdasarkan keterangan ini, Dajjal akan datang dengan wujud manusia yang hakiki, bukan metafora. 
Salah satu ulama kontemporer yang juga mewakili pandangan ulama klasik dalam memandang hadits tersebut secara tekstual adalah Syekh Muhammad Sa’id Ramadhan al-Buthi dari Damaskus, Suriah. (Pipin Armita dan Jani Arni, Dinamika Pemahaman Ulama Tentang Hadis Dajjāl, [Jurnal Ushuluddin Vol.25 No.2. Juli-Desember 2017], halaman 215).

Dajjal Sebagai Sifat atau Simbol
Berbeda dengan pandangan di atas, beberapa ulama memiliki pandangan dan pemahaman kontekstual terhadap hadits-hadits Dajjal. Beberapa ulama kontemporer bahkan cenderung merelevansikan beberapa matan hadits tersebut dengan keadaan umat manusia dan perkembangannya di zaman modern terkini. Biasanya kelompok ini menghadirkan takwil dan ta’thil (memberikan pemahaman tidak sebagaimana yang tersurat) dalam metode interpretasi yang digunakan. 

Imam an-Nawawi dalam Syarah Shahih Muslim pernah memberi penjelasan terkait kutipan hadits yang berbunyi “Puncak kekufuran terdapat pada arah timur”. Sabda tersebut menurutnya adalah pertanda kemunculan Dajjal dari timur. Kemunculan tersebut diiringi dengan maraknya kezaliman, kekafiran, kesombongan, dan fitnah-fitnah yang besar. (Imam An-Nawawi, Syarah Shahih Muslim, [Jakarta: Pustaka Azzam, 2010], jilid I, halaman 627).  
Dalam pemaknaan Imam an-Nawawi di atas, terdapat kesimpulan bahwa Dajjal adalah sosok yang akan muncul dari suatu tempat. Namun di sisi lain, tidak menafikan juga bahwa Dajjal yang dimaksud bermakna metafora, yaitu sebuah ungkapan yang menunjukkan huru-hara kekacauan yang akan terjadi di akhir zaman.
Selanjutnya, Imam Ibnu Hajar pernah menyimpulkan keterangan hadits perihal peperangan antara Dajjal dan Nabi Isa. Hadits tersebut berisi tentang 7000 orang Yahudi di belakang Dajjal dan deskripsi kejadian menjelang hari kiamat.
Salah satunya benda-benda mati yang dapat berbicara. Ia menyebut kemungkinan kondisi tersebut diungkapkan dengan majaz, bahwa tidak ada sedikit pun tempat bersembunyi yang aman nantinya. (Ibn Hajar Al-'Asqalani, Fathul Bari, [Jakarta: Pustaka Azzam, 2008], jilid XVIII, halaman 278).
Beberapa deskripsi metafora di atas sangat beriringan dengan aspek ketauhidan. Artinya, pada misi penyebaran fitnah yang dibawa oleh Dajjal ada misi teologis yang bertujuan mengguncang keimanan.
Keterangan tersebut dapat dilihat dalam hadits riwayat Al-Bukhari dan yang lainnya, bahwa Dajjal menyebut dirinya sebagai nabi hingga mengaku sebagai Tuhan, seraya menghasut manusia dengan kekuatannya dan berjalan ke penjuru bumi.

Terlepas dari perbedaan interpretasi perihal Dajjal sebagai wujud fisik maupun sifat (simbolis), poin pentingnya adalah untuk menyadarkan kembali umat muslim agar berlindung kepada Allah swt. Terutama meyakini bahwa apa saja yang terkandung dalam Al-Qur’an dan hadits Nabi saw adalah sesuatu yang valid dan akan terjadi.
Selain itu, sebagai bentuk kewaspadaan dalam menghadapi datangnya fitnah akhir zaman, kita perlu banyak berdoa meminta perlindungan kepada Allah. Nabi Muhammad saw pernah mengajarkan doa khusus dalam menghadapi fitnah Dajjal :

اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ، وَمِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ

Allâhumma innî a‘ûdzu bika min ‘adzâbi jahannama, wa min ‘adzâbil qabr, wa min fitnatil mahyâ wal mamât, wa min syarri fitnatil masîḥid dajjâl.

Remembering: LUANDA MAGERE- The legendary Luo hero whose humanity lied on his shadow 

Luanda Magere is a legendary warrior hero of the Luo community of Kenya, celebrated  for his supernatural strength and invincibility.
Magere who lived during the pre-colonial era was presumed to have had a body which could not have been injured in battle. When he went to battle, spears and arrows could not penetrate his stone-like body.

He is said to have been born in Sidho village, near the  wider Kano Plains, within present day Kisumu County. 
Magere was a family man two wives and several children. His first wife was from his Luo community.  This was before his fame grew and long before the conflict with the Nandi community. 

After a temporary peace treaty between the Luo and the Nandi, the Nandi offered him a woman to marry as a symbol of the truce. It was later discovered that this was a ploy by the Nandi to investigate his mysterious strenghth and power. 

According to legend, his humane side was replicated in his shadow. This implied that no one could have hurt him directly and instead, he could only be inured by attacking his shadow. Spears, arrows, and swords bounced off him without leaving a mark. He felt no pain from physical attacks. Besides, he could not only fight entire armies alone but could kill enemies with simple weapons or bare hands. 
 Eventually, the Nandi, through the woman they have offered him  managed to learn his secret. The woman had conducted her investigated, discovered the secret and leaked it to her people. 
The Nandi, having learnt of this, organized an improptu  war. One of their warriors  targeted his shadow with a spear; Magere fell and turned into a literal stone, which still exist in Sidho, Nyanza.
Magere was not just a strong warrior; he possessed several supernatural powers that made him feared, respected, and almost god-like.

Among the Luo and other communities in Kenya, the story and life of Luanda Magere represents courage, loyalty to ones community, the tragic cost of betrayal, and the idea that even the greatest heroes have the greatest vulnerability.

Here is an image of Nandi warriors captured in 1906 by Charles Hobley, an administrator in Eastern Uganda. Take a moment to observe their natural locks unmistakable, proud, and deeply rooted in our Kalenjin identity.

A fellow Asiisian here shared a moving story that resonates with this image and our heritage:

"I learned from my grandfather that many Kipsigis elders once wore their hair in locks, a tradition that symbolized strength and connection to our roots. Years ago, after spending some time overseas, I returned home wearing my hair in locks, only to face humiliation from my own people. The rejection stung deeply until my grandfather appeared.

When he saw me, he knelt as the sun began to set, rose to his feet, and lifted his hands toward the cosmos. He thanked Asiis, his Creator, for keeping him alive long enough to witness what he called 'a rebirth of his younger days.' That moment was nothing short of transcendent, I was very happy."

This story reminds us of who we are and the beauty of embracing our heritage. Let us remember that our traditions, like the locks worn by these warriors, carry the wisdom and strength of generations past. To honor them is to honor ourselves.

NANDI COMMUNITY BEFORE BEING CONVERTED TO CHRISTIANITY ,THEY HAD THEIR OWN COMMANDMENTS OF DOS AND DONTS 
Ancient Nandi culture was governed by strict social norms and age-set systems that emphasized community welfare, respect for elders, and individual responsibility. The core "dos and don'ts" revolved around maintaining social order, respecting kin and clan structures, and adhering to gender and age-specific roles. 
Dos (Encouraged Practices)
●Respect Elders Elders held significant political and judicial authority and their counsel was highly valued and followed.
●Adhere to Age-Sets All male members of the community belonged to a specific age-set (ibinda) from birth, advancing through grades from boy to warrior to elder, each with defined responsibilities.
●Show Bravery During Initiation Both male and female initiates were expected to undergo their respective circumcision ceremonies without flinching, crying, or showing fear, as this was a sign of courage and readiness for adulthood.
●Be Hospitable and Kind Virtues such as sharing, kindness, and honesty were encouraged within the community.
●Perform Gender-Specific Duties Men were primarily responsible for providing food (herding/cultivation) and protection, while women handled childcare and household chores.
●Follow Clan Rules Marriage outside one's own clan and specific subclans was a strict rule to avoid incest.
●Consult Spiritual Leaders The Orkoiyot (spiritual and military leader) and other ritual experts were consulted for important decisions, security, and war matters.
●Sustain Family Lineage Practices like woman-to-woman marriage were socially approved ways to ensure the continuation of a family line in the absence of male heirs.
●Build Huts Facing Mt. Elgon All Nandi people traditionally built their huts with front doors facing Mt. Elgon (Sabaot), as they believed they originated from that area. 

●Do Not Marry within the Same Clan or Age-Set Sexual relations or marriage between members of the same oreet (clan), ibinda (age-set), or kindred group were considered incestuous and strictly forbidden.
●Do Not Disobey Elders Disregarding the counsel of elders or the Orkoiyot could lead to severe misfortune or community sanctions.
●Do Not Commit Incest Incest was viewed as a serious offense, and such unions were dissolved.
●Do Not Engage in Premarital Pregnancy While sexual relations between young, uncircumcised girls and warriors in their communal house were permitted, a resultant pregnancy was considered shameful, and the child illegitimate.
●Do Not Eat Prohibited Meats Clan-specific taboos existed, such as members of the Talai clan not eating meat from an animal killed by a lion, or women not eating certain animal parts (e.g., sheep's head during pregnancy to avoid nasal problems for the baby).
●Do Not Display Anger, Theft, or Lying Vices such as anger, theft, and lying were discouraged as they were seen as potentially breaking communitynorms.

●Avoid Contact with a Widow in Mourning After a man's death, no warrior was allowed to enter the house of his widow while she was in mourning.
●Do Not Use a Dead Man's Personal Effects Stools, cups, and weapons belonging to a deceased man were traditionally chipped or broken after death, as no warrior could sit on or drink out of them.

ORIGIN OF SAWEYEK AB MARAR-MÄT AB KIPSOBOI AK KOBUJOI

The episode took place in the 1850s, when the SAWE were warriors. Arabs (Swahilis from the coast) who were traders must have been present in considerable numbers, because stockaded posts were established at KIMATKE, along the track between KIBIGORI and CHEMELIL; at KIPSOBOI, on the south escarpment overlooking CHEMASE; and at KOBUJOI.

The Arabs sometimes lived among the Nandi, bartering beads, cloth, and ornaments for ivory, sheep, and goats. All went well until the Arabs became overconfident, believing they were firmly established in the fortified encampment at KIPSOBOI, unaware that they were being closely watched by a no-nonsense tribe. They then began to act provocatively and show contempt for the local people: donkeys were let loose to trample crops (WIMBI and MTAMA), and attempts were made to imprison some Nandi youths and to interfere with women and girls.

When these needlessly foolish acts—characteristic of the conduct of coastal caravans toward tribes they despised—produced the inevitable reaction from the NANDI, the Arabs placed four shields against a tree and ordered the Nandi to shoot at them with arrows. When the arrows failed to penetrate, the Arabs fired through the shields with their muzzle-loaders, much to the chagrin of the Nandi spectators.

After the Arabs further insulted the warriors (MURENIK AB SAWEYEK) by pouring gruel over their heads and shaving off their cherished pigtails, the NANDI became so furious with their guests that they sought permission from the KAPTALAM, the Orkoiyot, to kill them.

He agreed, and the NANDI stormed the post. The little-known Orkoiyot Kaptalam was believed to have the power to make the defenders’ ammunition disappear. Some sources also state that when the surprise attack was launched, the Arab gunmen had their weapons on parade but no ammunition. The assault was successful, and the entire garrison was speared on the spot, with the exception of one man who escaped down the escarpment toward CHEMASE but was killed before he could reach his comrades at KIMATKE.

To anticipate reprisals, the NANDI marched on to KOBUJOI, sacked the post, and killed all its inhabitants, with the exception of one young man who reached CHEMURSOI and eventually escaped. When the party at KIMATKE heard of the massacres, they dismantled the post and left the NANDI area, which by then was known as a country. They left the country.

The Betrayal of a King: The Story of Koitalel Arap Samoei. 🇰🇪🏹

In 1895, the British thought they could simply walk through Nandi land to build their "Lunatic Express" railway. They didn't count on Koitalel Arap Samoei.

Koitalel was the Orkoiyot—the supreme spiritual and military leader of the Nandi. He had prophesied the coming of the "Black Snake" (the train) and knew it meant the end of their way of life. For 12 years, he led one of the most successful guerrilla wars in African history. His warriors were so effective they stole the very tracks the British were laying, using the steel to make better weapons.

The British were so humiliated they eventually realized they couldn't win a fair fight. On October 19, 1905, Colonel Richard Meinertzhagen invited Koitalel to a truce. Both sides agreed to come unarmed with only 5 companions.

Koitalel honored the truce. The British didn't. As Koitalel stretched out his hand for a greeting, Meinertzhagen drew a hidden gun and shot him dead. The British then beheaded him and sent his head to England.

His body fell, but the Nandi resistance became the blueprint for Kenyan freedom. We remember the man who saw the snake and chose to fight it.

3. Allergic Reactions and Asthma Triggers:
Pest droppings, shed skins, and saliva can trigger severe allergic reactions and asthma attacks, especially in children and individuals with respiratory conditions. Cockroach allergens, for instance, are a common cause of asthma symptoms. Fumigation removes these irritants, making your home a safer space for those sensitive to allergens.

4. Food Contamination:
Pests like ants, cockroaches, and rodents are constantly searching for food sources. They can contaminate your stored food, pantry items, and kitchen surfaces with bacteria and pathogens, leading to foodborne illnesses. Fumigation ensures your food remains safe and free from contamination.

5. Peace of Mind and Comfort:
Living in a pest-infested home can be incredibly stressful and uncomfortable. The constant worry about creepy crawlies, the unpleasant odors, and the fear of bites can disrupt your daily life. Fumigation provides peace of mind, allowing you to relax and enjoy your home without unwanted intrusions

The Iraqi White-cheeked Bulbul serves as a vital safeguard for Mesopotamia's ecosystem, performing essential roles in pest control, seed dispersal, and natural reforestation across the region. This necessitates strict monitoring of local markets and borders to prevent illegal trade and ensure the species' survival in the wild.
