Bu kelimeler arasında ne evcil hayvanların isimleri, ne ekili bitkilerin isimleri, ne de genel olarak tarım veya sığır yetiştiriciliği ile bağlantılı olarak ortaya çıkan kavramlar yoktur. Kil kapların isimleri de yoktur. Sadece avcılık ve balıkçılıkla ilgili terimler var.

Eski avcının hayvan anatomisi konusundaki bilgisi, hayvanın ekonomik önemi olan organları ve dokuları ile sınırlıydı. Bu kelimelerden bizi ilgilendiren "kiapIA" (kafa tası) "kiaap I - kiarab" (Lezgin'de 'kemik'), "maxA" (kemik iliği ve karaciğer), "mak" (Kafkas-Albanyası dilinde 'um') ve "lek" (Lezgi dilinde 'karaciğer'), "kiola" (balık) ve "k1azri" (Pelasg dilinde 'balık') kelimelere yakın olanlardır. Avlanma ve balıkçılığa ek olarak, eski insan yenilebilir bitkiler toplamakla meşguldü. Bu bitkiler arasında eski insan "marA" (çilek, böğürtlen; Lezgin'de "mara", "böğürtlen", Yunanca'da "moren"), "dzukE" (yabani hasat, darı - "chiukI" veya "tsiukI" - Lezgin'de 'darı').
Herhangi bir eski etnos hakkında güvenilir bilgi edinmenin en doğru yolu, yazısını doğru bir şekilde deşifre etmek, yani orijinalinden bilgi almaktır. Lezgi dilinin antik liği, yazılı anıtları dünya pratiğinde ilk kez bu dilin yardımıyla deşifre edilen en eski dillerle olan akrabalığı ile tartışılmaz bir şekilde kanıtlanmıştır. Bu tür eski diller arasında Kafkas-Albanyası, Urartu, Hurri, Hattik, Pelasg ve Etrüsk dilleri bulunur.

1937 yılına kadar Arnavut yazılı anıtları hakkında hiçbir şey bilinmiyordu. Eylül 1937'de Gürcü bilim adamı I. Abuladze, Matenadaran Arşivi'nde (Erivan, Ermenis tan) Kafkas Albanlarının 52 harften oluşan alfabesini keşfetti. Daha sonra, Kafkas-Albanyası yazısının birkaç parçalı örneği ortaya çıktı:

Mingeçevir yazıtları, Balushen, Derbent, Gunib ve Alban alfabesinin varlığında bile çözülemeyen diğer yazıtlar. Sadece Lezgi dilinin anahtar bir dil şeklinde kullanılması, sadece bu kısa yazıtların değil, aynı zamanda yukarıda belirtildiği gibi 50 sayfalık bir kitabın ("Alupan Kitabı") deşifre edilmesinde tatmin edici sonuçlar vermiştir. Matena daran alfabesinin harflerinin kökeni üzerine yapılan araştırmalar, bu alfabenin milat tan çok önce akrofoni ilkesi üzerine oluşturulduğunu ve işaret harflerinin yaklaşık% 56'sının isimlerinin Lezgi dili temeline sahip olduğunu göstermiştir.

Urartu anıtlarının deşifre edilmesine ilişkin literatürde mevcut olan materyallerin ön incelemesi, bu yazıtların içeriğinin Lezgi dilinin yardımıyla daha ikna edici bir şekilde yorumlandığını göstermiştir. Örneğin, Urartu yazıtlarından şu cümlenin yorumunu alıntılayabiliriz: "... Menuashe Ishpuinihinishe ini pili aguni..."
Cümle Rusça'ya '... Ishpuin'in oğlu Menua bu kanalı yönetti...' Hiç şüphe yok ki, "Menuashe Ishpuinihinishe" ('Menua, Ishpuin'in oğlu') kelimeleri, Tsakhur dilindeki ergatif durumun "-she" ekinin (Lezgi dilinde "x(w)a" 'oğlu' kelimesinden "-hi-") kanıt landığı gibi, ergatif durumda yer almaktadır. "İni" kelimesi Lezgi "içinde" 'bu' veya 'ini(n)' 'bu, burada' anlamına gelir. "Pili" kelimesi 'kanal' olarak çevrilir. Bu kelimenin Lezg dilinin Kurakh lehçesinin Gelkhen karışık lehçesinde korunduğu anlam budur. Gelkhen'de "pili", toprak heyelanlarını önlemek için bir kanalın yapımında kullanılan taşların zikzak bir düzenlemesidir. Cümlenin son kelimesi olan "aguni", modern şifre çözücüler tarafından kullanıldığı şekliyle, Kafkasya telaffuzunu neredeyse yitirmiştir: Lezgi dilinde "eg'uni(y)" 'vkapal, harcamak' şeklinde okunmalıdır ki bu cümlenin çevi risiyle tamamen uyumludur.

Urartu dilindeki "mankali" kelimesini ele alalım. Urartu dilinin sözlüklerinde, bir tür tereyağının (?) tanımı olarak çevrilir. Bu kelime ev eşyaları listesinde bulunur ve bu kelimeden önce "Sharru" 'kral' veya XX '20' anlamına gelen bir işaret gelir ve bu keli meden sonra "ni" veya "shamnu" hecesini gösteren bir işaret gelir. Buradan birkaç transkripsiyon alıyoruz: "Sharru mankali shamnu", "XX mancalini", vb. Mankali Shamnu", uzmanların onları "mankali yağı" (çeşitlilik, yağ türü) olarak çevirmesine izin verdi. Bununla birlikte, bu ifade Lezgi dilinde iyi okunur: "XX man kali(n) chchem", burada "adam" eski bir Lezgi ağırlık ölçüsüdür (küçük adam - 0,5 kg, büyük adam - 3 kg), "kali(n)" Lezgi dilinde 'inekler, inekler', 'chchem', 'ch1em' 😊 'sham') 'tereyağı'. Tercüme: "20 adam yağı" veya modern terimlerle: "60 kg yağı".

Literatürde geçen Hatti kelimelerinden şu Hatto-Lezgi paralellikleri gösterilebilir: "takkehal" (Hititçe, kahraman) — "kyegyal" (lezg., mely, cesur), "zari" (hatt., adam) — "zari" (Kav.-Alb., yazar, şair), "kaşt" (Hititçe, açlık) — "kaş" (lezg., açlık), "yatar" (hatt., su) — "yidar" (Hitt., su — çoğul) — "yad" (lezg., su), "kir" (Hitt., kalp) — "rikI" (lezg., kalp), "yar" (hatt., yanık) — "yar" (lezg., şafak, kızıl, sevgili), "akun" (hatt., görmek) — "akun" (lezg., görmek), "akhkun" ve "khkun" (hatt., bu kelimelerin anlamı literatürde bilinmemektedir) — "ahkun" veya "khkun" (lezg., yeniden görmek, buluşmak), "hku-vya" (hatt., kapmak) — "hkun" (lezg., kapmak), "piviel" (hatt., ev) — "kiviel" (lezg., ev), "ka" (hatt., vermek) — "cha" (lezg., vermek; Çocukların dilinde Gelkhen'de "ke" 'dai"), "hyanvya-" (hatt., taht veya taht tanrıçası) — "gya-na" (Kav.-Alb., taht), "Ashtan" (hatt., Güneş tanrısı) — "Al-pan" (lezg., ateş tanrısı), "ur(a/i)" (hatt., peki) — "ur" (lezg., göl; edebi Lezg dilinde "vir"), vb.

Pelasg yazılı anıtlarının Lezgin dilinin anahtarı yardımıyla deşifre edilmesiyle şaşırtıcı sonuçlar elde edilir. Minos (Pelasg) yazısının yayılma zamanı, M.Ö. II. Binyılın nere deyse tamamını kapsar. Linear A yazısından hemen önce gelen hiyeroglif (resimsel-heceli) yazı, Girit'te yaklaşık 2000 ila 1700 yılları arasında vardı. Bu piktografik yazı dan, yaklaşık 1800'den 1400'e kadar neredeyse yalnızca Girit'te kullanılan doğrusal A yazısı geliştirildi.  

Doğrusal "B" yazısı ve Siprominoik. Bunlardan ilki on beşinci yüzyılda Knossos'ta ve M.Ö. on üçüncü yüzyıldan on ikinci yüzyıla kadar Yunanistan anakarasının bazı mer kezlerinde kullanıldı, ikincisi ise 1500'den 1150'ye kadar Kıbrıs'ta vardı ve M.Ö. ye dinci yüzyıldan itibaren Kıbrıs hecesi şeklinde yeniden canlandırıldı ve bu daha sonra Knossos ve Pylos metinlerinin deşifre edilmesine büyük ölçüde yardımcı oldu. Ayrıca ünlü "Phaistos Diski" - Girit hiyeroglifi - eski Avrupa'daki tek damgalı yazı var! Pelasg yazısının tüm bu biçimleri - "Phaistos Diski", yaklaşık 50 hiyeroglif yazı örneği, yakla şık 40 Doğrusal "A" örneği, 50 Doğrusal "B" örneği ve Sipronomi yazısının mevcut tüm örnekleri (sadece üçü var) aynı Lezgi dilinin yardımıyla tamamen deşifre edilir ve yorumlanır. Elde edilen sonuçlar "Yaraliev, Y.A., Osmanov, N.O. Girit yazısının deşif re edilmesi. Pelasg-Lezgin dili. Lezginlerin Tarihçesi. Cilt 2. Moskova, 2009".

Yazıyla birlikte birçok Pelasg kelimesi Akhalar (eski Yunanlılar) tarafından ödünç alındı ve bu nedenle eski Yunanca'da yüzlerce Yunanca-Lezgi paralelliği bulunabilir.

Etrüsk epigrafik anıtları hem nispeten büyük metinlerden hem de 10 binden fazla kı sa kitabe, tabletler üzerindeki yazıtlar ve diğer malzemelerden oluşur. Başlıca metinle rin en kapsamlısı, Zagreb mumyasının kundak giysileri üzerindeki yaklaşık 1500 keli me içeren el yazmasıdır. İkinci en büyük Etrüsk anıtı, antik Capua bölgesinde keşfedi len pişmiş toprak fayanslar üzerine bir yazıttır (160'tan fazla farklı kelime hayatta kal mıştır). Aynı dini amaçlı metinler grubu, Magliano'da bulunan ve yaklaşık 70 kelime içeren merceksi bir kurşun levha üzerinde bir yazıt içerir. Ayrıca, Perusia'dan gelen ve 130 kelimelik sütundaki yazıtın tek yasal belge olduğu varsayılmaktadır - iki Etrüsk ailesinin temsilcileri arasında bazı mülklerin satışı veya devri konusunda bir anlaşma.
En önemli Etrüsk epigrafik anıtları arasında, şüphesiz, Pyrgae'de bulunan, ikisi Et rüsk'te ve biri Fenike'de olmak üzere altın folyolar üzerine üç ithaf yazıtı bulunmaktadır.

Neredeyse 500 yıldır hem ciddi bilim adamları hem de sayısız amatör Etrüsk dilinin gizemini çözmek için mücadele ediyor. Etrüsk yazısının yorumlanması için dünyanın hemen hemen tüm dilleri ve bilinen tüm deşifre yöntemleri denenmiş ve tatmin edici bir sonuç elde edilememiştir. Lezgi dilinin yardımıyla, bilinen tüm büyük Etrüsk me tinleri ve 320 kısa yazıt deşifre edildi (bkz.: "Yaraliev, Y.A., Osmanov, N.O., Lezgilerin Tarihi. Etrüskler. I binyıl M.Ö. Cilt 3. Moskova, 2012" ve "Yaraliev Y.A., Osmanov N.O. Etrüsk Yazısının Deşifre Edilmesi. Etrüsk-Lezgin dili. Lezginlerin Tarihçesi. Cilt 4 (Kitap 1 ve 2), Moskova, 2012").

Birçok Etrüsk kelimesi Latince'ye geçmiştir, bu nedenle Latince'de yüzlerce Latince-Lezgi paralelliğinin bulunması şaşırtıcı değildir.
Aynı şey Kafkas Arnavutlarının yazılı anıtları için de söylenebilir. Ünlü Lezgi şairi Zabit Rizvanov'un kişisel arşivinde bulunan bir Arnavutça kitabın ("Alupan Kitabı") fotokopileri ve Kafkasya Albanyası'nın literatüründe bilinen tüm epigrafik materyal leri Lezgi dilinin yardımıyla başarılı bir şekilde deşifre edilmiş ve "Yaraliyev Y.A. Alu pan (Kafkas-Albanyası) Yazısı ve Lezgi Dili" adlı kitapta özetlenmiştir. Mahaçkale, 1995". B

u kitap, dünya Alban araştırmalarında bilinmeyen "Mesrop" Alban alfabesiyle (37 harf) yazılmıştır.

Geçen yüzyılın 90'lı yıllarının başında, Sina Manastırı'nda (Mısır) palimpsestler keşfedildi ve burada silinen Arnavutça metin üzerinde eski Gürcü dilinde yeni bir metin üretildi. 

Gürcistan Bilimler Akademisi El Yazması Fonu müdürü Z.N. Aleksidze, Sina palimpsestlerinde silinen Arnavutça metni tamamen restore etmeyi başardı. 2009 yılında, Albanca metin (yaklaşık 250 sayfa) Belçika'da İngilizce olarak yayınlandı. Yazarlar, uygun bir disiplin olmadan, metnin Udi dilinde yorumlandığını ve İncil'in Alban dşllerine çevirisi olduğunu iddia ediyorlar. Sina palimpsestlerindeki Arnavutça metni Lezgi dillerinin yardımıyla deşifre etme girişimimiz çarpıcı sonuçlar verdi: metin İncil'in bir çevirisi değil. Şaşırtıcı bir antik Lezgi dili ortaya çıkar. Diintan ma garanayso kala saarid u dhaxaysa caqiidada, cibaadada iyo shareecada (xeerka). Laakiin waxaa jira dhaqdhaqaaqyo tababaran oo si qarsoodi ah uga shaqaynaya sidii loo fogeyn lahaa arrinta xukunka Ilaahay, ilaa ay ka dhigeen arrin aan muhiim ahayn oo muuqaalka ka baxsan.
Jiritaanka diintan wuxuu ku xidhan yahay jiritaanka xukunka Ilaahay. Haddii uu baaba’o asalkaa (xukunka Ilaahay), wuu baaba’ay jiritaanka diintan.
Kuwa ku xukuma cibaadada sanamka inay shirk tahay, laakiin aan ku xukumin shirki ka qayb galka xeerarka dhaaquudka (xukunka ilaahay ka baxsan ), kuwaasi Qur’aanka ma akhriyaan oo ma yaqaanaan dabeecadda diintan. Haddaba ha akhriyaan Qur’aanka sidii uu Ilaahay u soo dejiyey, oo ha qaataan hadalka Ilaahay si dhab ah: "Haddii aad u hoggaansantaanna (xeerar iyo amaro aan kii Ilaahay ahayn), waxaad tihiin mushrikiin."

Nadaafaddu waa waajib ka saaran maamulka degmada, sababtoo ah canshuurta dadku bixiyaan ayaa loogu talagalay adeegyada nadaafadda. 

Nadaafaddu waa tiir muhiim ah oo ka mid ah adeegyada bulshada, waxayna ka dhigtaa magaalooyinka kuwo caafimaad qaba, qurux badan, oo u diyaarsan horumar. Laakiin waxaa cad in magaalada iyo xaafadaha gobolka Banaadir ay wali wajahaan caqabado nadaafadeed. Maxaa keenay? Sababta ugu weyn waa in maamulka degmooyinka uu shaqadiisii gabay, halka dhalinyarada ay qaateen dadaal iskaa wax u qabso ah si ay u nadiifiyaan xaafadaha iyo wadooyinka.

Nadaafadda waa waajib ka saaran maamulka degmada, sababtoo ah:
 • Canshuurta dadka degan ayaa loogu talagalay in lagu bixiyo adeegyada aasaasiga ah sida ururinta qashinka, dayactirka waddooyinka, iyo ilaalinta goobaha bulshada.
 • Haddii maamulka degmada uu shaqadiisa si hufan u fuliyo, bulshada oo dhan waxay ka faa’iideysanaysaa magaalooyin nadiif ah oo caafimaad qaba.

Laakiin dhalinyarada ayaa qaadatay kaalinta muhiimka ah ee nadaafadda iyagoo iskaa wax u qabso ah sameynaya. Waxay muujinayaan:
1️⃣ Mas’uuliyadda bulshada: Dhalinyarada waxay tusaale u yihiin sida loo daryeelo deegaanka iyo xaafadda.
2️⃣ Wacyigelinta bulshada: Waxay dadka kale ku boorinayaan inay qashinka dhigaan meelaha loogu talagalay, taas oo yaraynaysa wasakhnimada iyo cudurada.
3️⃣ Ka hortagga wasakhnimada: Nadaafad joogto ah waxay ka hortagtaa faafitaanka cudurada, waxayna magaalooyinka ka dhigtaa kuwo caafimaad leh oo ammaan ah.

❌ Laakiin waa muhiim in la xasuusto:
 • Dhalinyarada waa kaaliye iyo wacyigelin bulsho, laakiin ma aha mas’uuliyadda kaliya.
 • Nadaafadda joogtada ah waa waajib ka saaran maamulka degmada, oo ay tahay in la fuliyo si joogto ah oo hufan.
 • Dhalinyarada uma baahna inay qaataan halis iyo hawl culus haddii maamulka degmada uu shaqadiisa si buuxda u qabto.

🏛 Mas’uuliyadda maamulka degmada waxaa ka mid ah:
 • Ururinta qashinka iyo ilaalinta nadaafadda guud 🗑️
 • Dayactirka waddooyinka iyo goobaha bulshada 🛣️🏥
 • Ka qayb qaadashada wacyigelinta iyo barnaamijyada bulshada 📢

Sababaha Horumar la’aanta Deegaannada Hirshabeelle.

Haddii aynu nahay dadka kasoo jeeda maamul goboleedka Hirshabeelle, waa in aynu is weydiinnaa su’aal adag oo runta taabanaysa:

maxaa hor istaagay horumarka deegaankeena? Ma cadow shisheeye baa naga hor istaagay mise annaga ayaaba isu diidnay?

Dhibaatada ugu weyn ee Hirshabeelle haysata ma aha kheyraad la’aan, ma aha dhul beereed la’aan, mana aha awood dadnimo la’aan. Waa isku dirka qabyaaladeed iyo faham xumada la xiriirta xilalka iyo hoggaanka.

Mar kasta oo xil qaran ama mid maamul goboleed la magacaabayo, ama qof xil laga qaadayo, halkii la eegi lahaa kartida, waxqabadka, iyo mas’uuliyadda, waxa lagu beddelaa qabiil. 

Qabiil walba wuxuu u arkaa kan kale cadow hor istaagaya xuquuqdiisa, taas oo keentay in horumar kasta la isku hortaago.

Haddii dhowr qabiil ay hal deegaan ka wada dhasheen, halkii ay iskaashi iyo wadajir u adeegsan lahaayeen, mid walba kan kale ayuu edenaa, wuu ka shakisan yahay, wuuna ka hor istaagaa fursad kasta oo horumar keeni karta. Taasi waxay dhalisay:

● In la diido mashaariic horumarineed haddii uusan “qabiilkeena” hoggaamin.
● In hoggaamiyihii shaqeyn lahaa la rido, kaliya sababtoo ah “reer hebel ma aha”.
● In dadkii kartida lahaa la niyad jabiyo ama la aamusiiyo.

Natiijadu waxay noqotay in Hirshabeelle:
● Ka dib dhacdo maamul-goboleedyada kale
● Lumiso codkeedii siyaasadeed
● Noqoto deegaan ay mar walba ka taagan tahay xiisad iyo kala shaki.

Runta qaraar waa tan horumarka Hirshabeelle kama hor istaagin cid kale ee annaga ayaa isu diidnay. Inta aanan ka gudbin fikirka ah qabiilkayga ha guuleysto xitaa haddii deegaanka khasaaro, horumar ma imaanayo.

Haddii aan rabno mustaqbal ka duwan kan maanta, waa in aan:
● Ka hormarinaa danta guud tan qabiil.
● Aqbalnaa in xilku yahay adeeg, uusan ahayn hanti qabiil.
● Taageernaa qof kasta oo waxqabad leh, xitaa haddii uusan naga dhalan.

Hirshabeelle horumar ma gaari doonto ilaa dadka Hirshabeelle ay ka heshiiyaan naftooda.

DIFAACA QARANKA: Ballan Qaran oo Ka Sarreeya Hadal Iyo Siyaasad.

Marna kama gabaneyno gudashada waajibaadka difaaca Qarankeena. Tani ma aha weedh lagu buuxiyo hadal-siyaasadeed, mana aha eray lagu raadiyo sacab ama taageero ku-meel-gaar ah. Waa ballan qaran oo ka weyn qof, ka weyn xukun, kana sarreeya dano gaar ah, xisbi iyo isbahaysiyo ku dhisan waqti iyo dano isbeddela.

Burburka qaran inta badan kama yimaado cadow dibadeed oo keliya, balse wuxuu ka dhashaa dayaca difaaca gudaha, kala-qaybsanaan siyaasadeed, iyo hoggaan aan fahamsanayn in qarannimadu tahay masuuliyad dhiig, damiir iyo naf-hurnimo lagu ilaaliyo. Taariikhda adduunka ayaa marar badan caddeysay in qaran aan lahayn difaac mideysan uu noqdo goob lagu tartamo, lagu gorgortamo, laguna kala iibsado danaha shisheeye.

Difaaca Qaranku waa dhaar ku qotonta dhiig daatay, damiir nool iyo dal-jacayl aan la iibin karin. Waa ballan ay qaadeen wiilal iyo gabdho aan sugin abaal-marin, mansab ama magac, balse doortay inay noqdaan darbiga ugu dambeeya ee u dhexeeya jiritaanka ummadda iyo baabi’inteeda. Waa masuuliyad aan ku xirnayn cidda xukunka haysa, balse ku xiran jiritaanka calan, dhul iyo sharaf qaran.

Siyaasad kasta oo aan salka ku hayn difaaca qaranka waa siyaasad marin-habaab ah. Dowlad kasta oo ku fashilanta dhismaha ciidan qaran oo mideysan, daacad ah, kana sarreeya qabiil, xisbi iyo dano gaar ah, waxay si dadban u furaysaa albaabka faragelin shisheeye iyo burbur gudaha ah. Qaran lama dhisi karo iyadoo ciidankiisu kala amar, kala aragti, kana madhan yahay damiir qaran.

Difaaca Qaranku ma aha oo keliya hub iyo rasaas ee waa fikir, waa midnimo, waa kalsoonida ay ummaddu ku qabto hay’adaha amniga. Waa marka askarigu garto inuu difaacayo dad iyo dal qiimo leh, oo aysan jirin gacan hoos u dhigaysa, kana iibinaysa dhiiggiisa dan siyaasadeed.

Tusaale: Aragtidii hoggaamineed ee Madaxweyne Farmaajo  waxay si cad u muujisay in qarannimada lagu ilaaliyo ciidan qaran oo ka sarreeya qabiil, xisbi iyo dano gaar ah. Askarigu ma aha aalad siyaasadeed; waa astaan qaran, waa gaashaan ay ummaddu ku badbaado, waa calan nool oo lugaynaya. Difaaca qaranku waa dhaar aan jabin, dhaar ay isku dhaarsadeen dhiigga askariga, damiirka hoggaanka iyo jacaylka dhulka hooyo.

Haddaba, difaaca Qaranku waa waajib ka saaran muwaadin kasta, hoggaamiye kasta iyo jiil kasta. Waa in laga ilaaliyaa siyaasadda wasakhaysan, lana siiyo sharaf, daryeel iyo maqaam u qalma. Maxaa yeelay qaran aan difaac lahayn waa magac uun, halka qaran leh difaac damiir leh uu yahay jiritaan, karaamo iyo mustaqbal la hubo.

Marna kama gabaneyno difaaca Qarankeena waayo waa ballan ka weyn hadal, waa dhaar ku qotonta dhiig, damiir iyo dal-jacayl.

itu peringatan keras yg dibungkus kasih sayang 🌿

Di luar sana, kata kafir sering dipakai seperti peluru. 🎯
Bukan utk refleksi diri,
tapi utk menandai musuh.

👉Siapa yg beda → ditempelin label.
👉Siapa yg bertanya → dicurigai.
👉Siapa yg kritis → dianggap ancaman.

Padahal…
kata itu lahir dari bahasa,
dipelihara oleh kelompok,
dan sering dipakai sbg alat intimidasi 🌀

Nenekku gk pernah kuliah teologi.
Gk hafal dalil.
Tapi beliau paham satu hal sederhana:

👉 kata yg paling berbahaya itu bukan yg kasar,
tapi yg dipakai tanpa sadar.

———

Iya, mungkin nasehat ini pahit ya 😌
👉 Kadang org lebih sibuk menjaga label
daripada menjaga laku.

Lebih rajin ngitung siapa kafir,
daripada ngaca:
“aku sdh jujur blm hari ini?” 🪞

Lebih cepat menuding,
daripada nanya pelan ke diri sendiri:
“jangan² yg gelap itu egoku?” ✨

Yg sering luput dipahami:
kafir itu bukan senjata sosial,
bukan stempel moral,
apalagi lisensi utk merendahkan manusia lain.

Dalam banyak ajaran luhur—apa pun jalurnya—
yg pertama kali diingatkan justru ini:

🌿 jaga hatimu
sebelum jaga keyakinanmu

🪞

“Sing ati-ati nganggo ilat,
krn ilat iku luwih landhep tinimbang blati.”

Banyak konflik besar
lahir bukan krn iman,
tapi krn mulut yg gatal nunjuk orang lain 🔥

——————————————

🌿

❓ Apa sih arti kata kafir sebenarnya?
👉 Secara bahasa (Arab), kafara artinya menutup.
Contoh klasiknya bahkan ada di Al-Qur’an:

“Seperti hujan yg tanamannya mengagumkan para petani (kuffār).”
(QS. Al-Hadid: 20)

📌 Kuffār di sini petani, krn mereka menutup benih dgn tanah.
Bukan makian.
Bukan label moral.

Jadi sejak awal, kafir itu istilah deskriptif, bukan hinaan 🌀

———

❓ Lalu kenapa sekarang jadi kasar & menyakitkan?
👉 Krn makna teologis dipindahkan ke alat sosial.

Padahal Rasulullah ﷺ sendiri sangat berhati-hati dgn kata ini.

Hadits sahih:

“Siapa yg memanggil saudaranya ‘wahai kafir’,
maka tuduhan itu akan kembali kepada salah satu dari keduanya.”
(HR. Bukhari & Muslim)

🌀 Artinya:
— Kalau yg dituduh tidak seperti itu,
— yg berdosa justru yg menuduh.

Ini peringatan keras.
Bukan main-main.

———

❓ Bukankah Al-Qur’an memang menyebut kafir?
👉 Benar.
Tapi Al-Qur’an menyebut kategori,
bukan memberi izin manusia utk menunjuk sembarangan.

Allah berfirman:

“Sesungguhnya Allah Maha Mengetahui apa yg tersembunyi di dalam hati.”
(QS. Al-Mulk: 13)

📌 Hati = wilayah Tuhan.
Manusia hanya menilai laku lahir, itu pun terbatas 🌱

———

❓ Jadi kita gk boleh bilang kafir sama sekali?
👉 Bukan begitu.

❌ Yang dilarang:
– Menjadikan kata itu alat intimidasi
– Dipakai utk merendahkan & memusuhi

✔️ Yang diperbolehkan:
– Dibahas dlm konteks ilmu
– Sebagai kategori teologis, bukan senjata sosial

Imam Al-Ghazali mengingatkan:

“Lebih baik salah menganggap seribu orang beriman
daripada salah mengkafirkan satu orang.” ✨

———

❓ Siapa yg berhak menentukan iman seseorang?
👉 Jawaban pendeknya: Allah.

“Bukanlah kewajibanmu menjadikan mereka beriman.”
(QS. Yunus: 99)

“Tugasmu hanyalah menyampaikan,
bukan menguasai hati mereka.”
(QS. Al-Ghashiyah: 21–22)

🌀 Jadi tugas manusia:
menyampaikan dgn akhlak,
bukan mengontrol keyakinan org lain.

❓ Pesan inti nasihat nenek itu apa?
👉 Sederhana tapi dalam:

🌿 Kalau km mudah menyebut org lain kafir,
mungkin yg belum km pahami
bukan iman mereka,

Kata boleh lahir dr wahyu,

tetap diuji oleh akhlak ✨

1️⃣ Qabyaaladdu waa xaaraan
Rasuulka ﷺ wuxuu yiri:
“Ma aha mid naga mid ah qofka u yeera qabyaalad, u dagaallama qabyaalad ama u dhinta qabyaalad.”
(Abuu Daawuud)
Taasi waxay caddeyneysaa in qabyaaladdu ka hor imaanayso diinta.
2️⃣ Dadka waxaa lagu kala sarreeyaa cabsida Alle (Taqwada)
Alle wuxuu yiri:
“Kan idinku sharafta badan Alle agtiisa waa kan idinku cabsida badan.”
(Qur’aan 49:13)
Ma ahan qabiil, midab, ama dhalasho—ee waa taqwo.
3️⃣ Qabyaaladdu waxay burburisaa ummadda
Qabyaaladdu waxay keentaa:
Cadaalad darro
Is nacayb
Colaado iyo dhiig daata
In la iska indha tiro xaqa
Islaamkuna wuxuu ku dhisan yahay cadaalad, walaaltinimo iyo midnimo

Markii Nabi Maxamed ﷺ yimid Madiina
Madiina waxaa ku noolaa:
Muslimiin
Yuhuud
Mushrikiin
Nabi Maxamed ﷺ wuxuu sameeyay heshiis taariikhi ah oo la yiraahdo:
Heshiiska Madiina (Constitution of Medina)
Heshiiskaas wuxuu dhigay:
✅ Muslim iyo Yuhuud waa dad wada nool
✅ Qof walba diintiisa waa xor
✅ Qofna lama dulmin karo
✅ Wadajir ayay isu difaacayaan haddii la soo weeraro
✅ Caddaalad waa la wada siman yahay
Tani waxay muujinaysaa: ➡️ Nabi Maxamed ﷺ ma uusan necbayn Yuhuudda
Wuxuu ula dhaqmay si muwaadinimo & sharaf leh
2️⃣ Nabi Maxamed ﷺ marnaba ma uusan cunsuriyadeyn
Nabi Maxamed ﷺ wuxuu yiri:
“Qofna kama fiicna qof kale midab, qoomiyad ama nasab awgiis.”
Marka: ❌ Yuhuudnimo = ma ahayn sabab nacayb
❌ Qoomiyad = ma ahayn sabab dulmi
3️⃣ Nabi Maxamed ﷺ Yuhuud buu wax ka iibsan jiray
Xitaa markii uu dhimanayay:
➡️ Gaashaankiisii wuxuu ku reebay nin Yuhuud ah oo uu wax ka soo qaatay.
Tani waxay muujinaysaa:
Kalsooni
Nabad ku wada noolaan
Is ixtiraam
4️⃣ Goorma ayuu dagaal la galay Yuhuud?
Wuxuu dagaal la galay qabiilo Yuhuud ah, ma ahayn Yuhuud dhan.
Sababta: ❗ Waxay jebiyeen heshiis
❗ Waxay la safteen cadaw
❗ Waxay qorsheeyeen in la dilo ama la khaarajiyo Muslimiinta
Markaa: ➡️ Dagaalku wuxuu ahaa mid siyaasadeed & amni
➡️ Ma ahayn mid diin ama qoomiyad
5️⃣ Nabi Maxamed ﷺ ma oggolaan jirin dulmi
Xitaa haddii Yuhuud qaldamaan, Nabi Maxamed ﷺ:
Ma uusan laayey dad aan waxba galabsan
Ma uusan cunsuriyadeyn
Ma uusan xasuuqin
Mar walba wuxuu raacay: ➡️ Caddaalad
➡️ Sharci
➡️ Naxariis
6️⃣ Qur’aanku sidee buu uga hadlay Banii Israa’iil?
Qur’aanku wuxuu ka hadlay:
A) Wanaaggooda:
Nabiyaal badan ayay ka yimaadeen
Ilaahay wuu sharfay
Wuxuu siiyay nimcooyin
B) Khaladaadkooda:
Markay xadgudbeen
Markay ballan jebiyeen
Markay nabiyaal diideen
Laakiin: ➡️ Qur’aanku mar walba wuxuu kala saaraa qofka wanaagga sameeya iyo qofka xumaanta sameeya

Leelkase, Harti, Carab Saalax, Dir, Marreexaan, Awrtable, Jambeel, Tumaal, Jareer, Geri, Absame, Raxanweyn iyo intii aan ka tegayba dadka reer Puntland waa ay milgeysan yahiin. 

Bal qoladaan Majeerteen(haddaad doontid Saleebaan Maxammed dheh) ee weli moodaya in joogo 1960kii—markii ay Jawhar, Buuloburde, Balcad, Luuq, Baraawe iyo Koonfur oo dhan baarlamaanka ka soo gali jireen ee ay reer Koonfurka iska badowsan jireen, yaa fahansiin kara in aan waqtigu kii ahayn ee ay meel iska dhigaan sheekadaan Soomaaliyeed, dabeed ay ilaa 50 sano oo dib-isu-habayn ah qaataan, si ay iyaga oo xoog leh mar kale u maamulaan Geeska Afrika. 

Hadda ogaada kuwaa oran doona Soomaalidu waa hal qawmiyad. Dee Turkidaan ka hadlayo waa reer Cusmaan Ardugal ee Turkidu ma aha keliya dadka deggan Turkiga. 

Run ahaan reerkaa aan sheegayow in aad ilaalisaan calanka iyo magaca Soomaaliya waxa idiinka aayo-roon Soomaalidana u wanaagsan idinka oo dalka Puntland ku soo noqda, isaga dhisa, dadkiinna mideeya, waaga aad dhaqaale iyo awood yeelataanna haddaad doontaan sida Turkida ku fekera inaad Soomaaliweyn ama wax kale midaysaan. 

Sidaani waa idiin dayac, Soomaalina wax kaga ag noqon maysaan.

السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُه

اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آل سَيِّدِنَا مُحمَّـــدْ

Sahabat muslimku yang di Rahmati Allah 

Dalam ajaran Islam, iman merupakan aspek fundamental dalam kehidupan seorang mukmin. Demikian pula amal saleh. Keduanya bukan entitas yang berdiri sendiri, melainkan memiliki keterkaitan erat, layaknya dua sisi dari sekeping mata uang yang apabila salah satu diantara keduanya tidak ada, maka sama dengan ketiadaan keduanya. Maka, dapatkah kita mengatakan bahwa iman dan amal adalah dua hal yang berbeda? Padahal, menurut Imam al-Ghazali, salah satu makna iman justru mencakup perbuatan nyata (amal) melalui anggota tubuh.

Imam al-Ghazali mendefinisikan iman sebagai pembenaran dalam hati, pengakuan dengan lisan, dan pembuktian melalui perbuatan. Definisi ini tampak logis karena iman yang hanya tertanam di dalam hati tidak dapat diketahui oleh orang lain, sehingga ekspresi lahiriyah berupa ucapan dan perbuatan menjadi bentuk konkret dari keimanan.

Namun demikian, apabila kita merujuk langsung pada Al-Qur’an, definisi ini perlu ditinjau ulang. Dalam banyak ayat, Al-Qur’an membedakan antara iman dan amal saleh, meskipun keduanya sering disandingkan. Misalnya dalam QS. Al-‘Asr ayat 3:

اِلَّا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالْحَقِّ ەۙ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالصَّبْرِ ࣖ ٣ ( العصر/103: 3)

Artinya: “Kecuali orang-orang yang beriman dan mengerjakan amal saleh serta saling menasihati dalam kebenaran dan kesabaran.” (QS. Al-‘Asr: 3)

Atau dalam QS. Al-Baqarah ayat 25:

وَبَشِّرِ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ اَنَّ لَهُمْ جَنّٰتٍ تَجْرِيْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ ۗ كُلَّمَا رُزِقُوْا مِنْهَا مِنْ ثَمَرَةٍ رِّزْقًا ۙ قَالُوْا هٰذَا الَّذِيْ رُزِقْنَا مِنْ قَبْلُ وَاُتُوْا بِهٖ مُتَشَابِهًا ۗوَلَهُمْ فِيْهَآ اَزْوَاجٌ مُّطَهَّرَةٌ وَّهُمْ فِيْهَا خٰلِدُوْنَ ٢٥ ( البقرة/2: 25)

Artinya: Sampaikanlah kabar gembira kepada orang-orang yang beriman dan beramal saleh bahwa untuk mereka (disediakan) surga-surga yang di bawahnya mengalir sungai-sungai. Setiap kali diberi rezeki buah-buahan darinya, mereka berkata, “Inilah rezeki yang diberikan kepada kami sebelumnya.” Mereka telah diberi (buah-buahan) yang serupa dan di sana mereka (memperoleh) pasangan-pasangan yang disucikan. Mereka kekal di dalamnya. (Al-Baqarah/2:25)

Sahabat muslimku 

Apabila salah satu definisi iman mencakup perbuatan lahiriah (beramal dengan anggota badan), maka secara logika, seharusnya cukup bagi Al-Qur’an hanya menyebutkan “allażīna āmanụ” (orang-orang yang beriman) tanpa perlu mengulang dengan frasa “wa ‘amiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti” (dan beramal saleh). Akan tetapi, kenyataannya Al-Qur’an secara konsisten menyandingkan kedua istilah ini dalam banyak ayat. Hal ini menandakan bahwa amal saleh tidak sepenuhnya melekat dalam definisi iman, tetapi berdiri sebagai konsekuensi atau ekspresi dari iman.

Lebih jauh, Al-Qur’an memberikan ilustrasi naratif untuk menegaskan pembedaan antara keduanya. Salah satunya adalah kisah Iblis dalam Surah Al-Baqarah. Ketika Allah memerintahkan para malaikat untuk bersujud kepada Adam, Iblis menolak perintah tersebut dan akibatnya mendapat hukuman dari Allah. Dalam tafsir Ibnu Arabi, penolakan Iblis bukanlah karena keangkuhan belaka, tetapi karena bentuk tauhidnya yang ekstrem—ia merasa bahwa bersujud hanya layak ditujukan kepada Allah.

Menariknya, dialog antara Allah dan Iblis mengindikasikan bahwa Iblis mengakui eksistensi dan keesaan Tuhan, bahkan berbicara langsung dengan-Nya. Ini secara konseptual menunjukkan bahwa Iblis memiliki pengakuan intelektual terhadap Tuhan, atau dalam pengertian tertentu, memiliki aspek iman. Bahkan dalam Injil (Yakobus 2:19), dikatakan: “Setan pun percaya bahwa Allah itu satu, dan ia gemetar.” Maka, Iblis bukan ateis; ia percaya kepada Allah.

Namun, iman Iblis tidak disertai ketaatan. Ia menolak untuk melaksanakan perintah Allah. Dalam konteks Islam, ini berarti Iblis tidak bertakwa, karena takwa mencakup kepatuhan kepada perintah Allah baik dalam aspek ibadah (ubudiyyah) maupun amal (amaliyyah). Oleh sebab itu, Iblis menjadi contoh nyata dari makhluk yang beriman (dalam aspek pengakuan) namun tidak beramal saleh, dan karenanya tetap tergolong sebagai makhluk yang celaka.

Sahabat muslimku 

Sebaliknya, terdapat pula makhluk yang beramal saleh tetapi tidak beriman. Ini merujuk kepada orang-orang yang telah mendapatkan petunjuk tetapi memilih untuk menutupinya, yang dalam istilah Al-Qur’an disebut kafir. Kata “kafir” berasal dari akar kata kafara, yang berarti “menutupi”. Kata ini diserap ke dalam bahasa Inggris menjadi cover, sebagaimana istilah book cover—penutup buku yang menyembunyikan isinya.

Dalam perspektif Islam, amal saleh tanpa iman tidak memiliki bobot spiritual. Al-Qur’an mengibaratkan amal orang kafir seperti sesuatu yang dikalikan dengan angka nol. Iman adalah variabel pengali utama. Tanpa iman, amal apa pun, sebanyak apa pun, tetap akan bernilai nol di sisi Allah. Mereka digolongkan sebagai orang-orang yang sia-sia perbuatannya dan merugi di akhirat, sebagaimana ditegaskan dalam QS. Al-Kahf:

قُلْ هَلْ نُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِالْاَخْسَرِيْنَ اَعْمَالًا ۗ ١٠٣ اَلَّذِيْنَ ضَلَّ سَعْيُهُمْ فِى الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ يَحْسَبُوْنَ اَنَّهُمْ يُحْسِنُوْنَ صُنْعًا ١٠٤ اُولٰۤىِٕكَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَلِقَاۤىِٕهٖ فَحَبِطَتْ اَعْمَالُهُمْ فَلَا نُقِيْمُ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ وَزْنًا ١٠٥ ( الكهف/18: 103-105)

Artinya: Katakanlah (Nabi Muhammad), “Apakah perlu kami beri tahukan orang-orang yang paling rugi perbuatannya kepadamu?” (Yaitu) orang-orang yang sia-sia usahanya dalam kehidupan dunia, sedangkan mereka mengira bahwa mereka berbuat sebaik-baiknya. Mereka itu adalah orang-orang yang kufur terhadap ayat-ayat Tuhannya dan (kufur pula terhadap) pertemuan dengan-Nya.458) Maka, amal mereka sia-sia dan Kami tidak memberikan penimbangan terhadap (amal) mereka pada hari Kiamat. (Al-Kahf/18:103-105)

Sahabat muslimku 

Fenomena lain yang sering menjadi bahan diskusi dalam teologi Islam adalah mengenai orang-orang non-Muslim yang secara konsisten melakukan amal kebaikan dan kontribusi sosial yang luar biasa, bahkan melampaui sebagian umat Islam dalam aspek moralitas dan kemanusiaan. Salah satu contoh paling terkenal adalah Bill Gates dan Melinda Gates, yang mendirikan The Giving Pledge—gerakan global yang mengajak para miliarder dunia menyumbangkan sebagian besar kekayaannya untuk amal.

Mereka juga mendirikan Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, yang telah menyumbangkan dana besar untuk meningkatkan kesehatan global, pendidikan, dan mengurangi kemiskinan. Jika dilihat secara kasat mata, tindakan mereka adalah bentuk nyata dari amal saleh dalam pengertian sosial.

Namun, dalam perspektif Al-Qur’an, nilai amal tidak hanya ditentukan oleh besarnya manfaat duniawi, tetapi juga oleh fondasi keimanan yang mendasarinya. Dalam Surah Al-Mu’minun ayat 117, Allah berfirman:

وَمَنْ يَّدْعُ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَ لَا بُرْهَانَ لَهٗ بِهٖۙ فَاِنَّمَا حِسَابُهٗ عِنْدَ رَبِّهٖۗ اِنَّهٗ لَا يُفْلِحُ الْكٰفِرُوْنَ ١١٧ ( المؤمنون/23: 117)

Artinya: Siapa yang menyembah tuhan yang lain bersama Allah, padahal tidak ada suatu bukti pun baginya (yang membenarkan) tentang itu, maka perhitungan (amal)-nya hanya pada Tuhannya. Sesungguhnya orang-orang kafir itu tidak akan beruntung. (Al-Mu’minun/23:117)

Ayat ini menegaskan bahwa kesuksesan akhirat tidak hanya ditentukan oleh jumlah amal, melainkan juga oleh keabsahan akidah. Amal orang kafir yang tidak dibarengi dengan iman digambarkan seperti debu yang tertiup angin (QS. Ibrahim: 18)—indah dipandang, tapi tak membekas.

Dalam kerangka ini, sebanyak apa pun harta dan jasa yang disumbangkan oleh orang-orang non-Muslim, tetap tidak akan memperoleh ganjaran akhirat apabila tidak dibarengi dengan keimanan kepada Allah sebagai inti dari pengabdian dan niat amal.

Bahkan dalam sejarah Islam sendiri, terdapat tokoh besar yang dikenal sangat berjasa dalam membela Rasulullah ﷺ dan dakwah Islam, namun tetap tidak memperoleh keselamatan karena tidak mengucapkan syahadat secara eksplisit. Tokoh tersebut adalah Abu Thalib, paman Nabi Muhammad ﷺ.

Abu Thalib adalah pelindung utama Nabi pada masa awal dakwah di Mekkah. Ia menghadapi tekanan dari kaum Quraisy, menanggung resiko politik dan sosial, serta berjuang menjaga keselamatan keponakannya. Namun, meskipun sangat mencintai dan membela Nabi, Abu Thalib menolak untuk mengucapkan kalimat tauhid hingga akhir hayatnya.

Dalam riwayat sahih disebutkan bahwa Rasulullah terus-menerus mengajak Abu Thalib untuk mengucapkan syahadat, namun ia enggan karena mempertimbangkan tekanan sosial dan takut mencoreng nama leluhur. Maka, sekalipun memiliki jasa besar dalam Islam, ia wafat dalam keadaan belum beriman secara formal, dan menurut hadits Nabi, ia tidak termasuk golongan orang yang selamat di akhirat.

Kisah Abu Thalib mengandung pelajaran penting: amal sosial, dukungan moral, dan keberpihakan kepada Islam tidak cukup menjamin keselamatan jika tidak disertai dengan keimanan kepada Allah secara teologis dan eksplisit.

Sahabat muslimku 

Dari berbagai uraian di atas, dapat disimpulkan bahwa iman dan amal saleh merupakan dua komponen utama dalam sistem nilai Islam, yang tidak bisa dipisahkan, tetapi juga tidak dapat disamakan. Iman adalah pondasi akidah, sedangkan amal saleh adalah manifestasi nyata dari akidah tersebut dalam kehidupan sehari-hari.

Iman tanpa amal adalah keyakinan yang tidak membuahkan hasil. Amal tanpa iman adalah perbuatan yang tidak memiliki nilai spiritual di sisi Allah.

Al-Qur’an mengajarkan bahwa hanya dengan memadukan keduanya, seseorang dapat meraih keselamatan dan keberuntungan, baik di dunia maupun di akhirat. Sebagaimana ditegaskan dalam QS. Al-‘Asr:

اِنَّ الْاِنْسَانَ لَفِيْ خُسْرٍۙ ٣ – اِلَّا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالْحَقِّ ەۙ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالصَّبْرِ

“Sesungguhnya manusia benar-benar dalam kerugian, kecuali orang-orang yang beriman dan mengerjakan amal saleh serta saling menasihati dalam kebenaran dan kesabaran.” (QS. Al-‘Asr: 2–3)

اللَّهُمَّ زِدْنَا إِيْمَانًا وَيَقِيْنًا وَعَمَلًا صَالِحًا

Artinya: "Ya Allah, tambahkanlah bagi kami iman, keyakinan, dan amal yang saleh."

Waa kuma Khubayb bin Cadiy (RC)؟
Khubayb bin Cadiy Al-Ansaari Al-Awsi (RC) wuxuu ka mid ahaa saxaabadii waaweynaa ee Nabi Muxammad ﷺ. Wuxuu ka qayb galay Dagaalkii Badar, wuxuuna ahaa nin geesi ah oo iimaan adag leh.

Dagaalkii Badar ayuu Khubayb ku dilay Al-Xaarith bin Caamir bin Nawfal (waxaa la sheegay inuu dilay mushrikiin kale sidoo kale). Taas awgeed ayay Quraysh u qaadeen nacayb daran, gaar ahaan xaaskii Al-Xaarith, oo ballan qaaday in haddii la qabto Khubayb ay ku aargudan doonto, waxayna bixisay abaal-marin weyn qofkii keena isagoo nool.

Dhacdadii Bi’r Macuuna iyo qabashadii Khubayb
Sanadkii 4-aad ee Hijriga, waxaa dhacday musiibadii Bi’r Macuuna, markaas oo Nabi ﷺ uu diray saxaabo dacwo u baxay, balse qabiillo Carab ah ay si khiyaano ah u dileen intoodii badnayd.

Kuwa la qabtay waxaa ka mid ahaa:
Khubayb bin Cadiy
Zayd bin Dathina
iyo nin kale

Kuwaas ayaa laga iibiyay Quraysh, Khubaybna waxaa loo iibsaday in lagu dilo aargoosi ahaan dadkii Badar lagu dilay. Sidaas ayuu ku galay gacanta Banu Al-Xaarith bin Caamir (qoyskii ninka uu Badar ku dilay).

Xabsigii Khubayb iyo karaamadii canabka 🍇
Khubayb waxaa lagu xiray guri ay lahayd haweeney ka tirsan Banu Al-Xaarith, waxaana lagu xidhay silsilado bir ah.

Haweeneydii waxay tiri (Saxiix Al-Bukhaari):
“Waligay ma arag maxbuus ka khayr badan Khubayb.”
Waxay kaloo tiri:
“Waxaan arkay isagoo gacanta ku haya xirmo canab ah, isagoo silsilado ku xiran, xilli Makka aanay jirin miro, mana ahayn xilli canab.”

✔️ Tani waa karaamo sugan oo sax ah:
Makka lama beero
Mana ahayn xilli miro
Isaguna waa maxbuus bir lagu xiray

➡️ Waa rizqi Alle siiyay addoonkiisa suubban.
Qisadii mindida iyo ilmaha (waa mid sugan)
Khubayb wuxuu ka codsaday haweeneydii mindiyo (muus). Markii ay siisay, ayaa ilmaheedii  yara soo galay oo ku fariistay dhabta Khubayb.

Haweeneydii way baqday, iyadoo u cabsanaysa ilmaheeda.
Khubayb (RC) wuxuu ku yiri:
“Ma ka baqaysaa inaan dilo? Ma sameynaayo arrintaas.”
Riwayad kale:
“Mu’minku ma khiyaaneeyo qof.”

Akhlaaqdiisaas wanaagsan ayaa sabab u noqotay in qaar ka mid ah dadkii arkay ay markii dambe Islaamaan.
Markii loo saaray dilka
Markii ay dhammaadeen bilihii xurmada lahaa, ayay mushrikiintu u kaxeeyeen At-Tan’iim, bannaanka Makka.
Waxaa isugu yimid madaxda Quraysh, waxaana ka mid ahaa:

Abuu Sufyaan
Safwaan bin Umayya
iyo kuwo kale

Su’aashii taariikhiga ahayd ee Abuu Sufyaan
Abuu Sufyaan wuxuu yiri:
“Waxaan ku baryayaa Alle, Khubayb, ma jeclaan lahayd in Muxammad ﷺ uu adiga meeshaada joogo, adiguna aad unoqoto reerkaaga?”

Khubayb wuxuu ku jawaabay:
“Wallahi, ma jecli inaan unoqdo reerkeyga iyo carruurtayda, iyadoo Nabi Muxammad ﷺ xataa qodax lagu mudayo.”
Markaas ayuu Abuu Sufyaan yiri:
“Waligay ma arag dad qof u jecel sida ay asxaabta Muxammad u jecel yihiin Muxammad.”

Sunnadii labada rakcadood (isaga ayaa bilaabay)
Khubayb wuxuu yiri:
“I daaya aan tukado labo rakcadood.”
Wuxuu udukaday si degan, dabadeed wuxuu yiri:
“Haddii aanan ka baqayn inaad u malaysaan inaan ka cabsanayo dhimashada, waan sii dheerayn lahaa.”
✔️ Khubayb waa qofkii ugu horreeyay ee Islaamka ku sunnay labo rakcadood ka hor dilka.

Gabaygiisii taariikhiga ahaa
Markaas ayuu yiri:
Ma daneeyo anoo Muslim ah hadii laigu  dilo
Jid kasta oo Alle dartii laygu dilay
Haddii ay tahay doonista Ilaahay
Wuu barakaynayaa xubnaha la jarjaray

Ducadii iyo shahaadadii
Khubayb wuxuu ku duceystay:
“Ilaahayow, ku tirso tiro ahaan, u dil si kala firdhan, hana reebin mid ka mid ah.”
Kadibna waa la dilay, isagoo shahiid ah, madax kor u haya, iimaan adag leh.

Warkii Nabiga ﷺ iyo aaska malaa’igta
Waxaa la xaqiijiyay in Nabi Muxammad ﷺ loo sheegay shahaadada Khubayb, wuuna u duceeyay.
Sheekada ku saabsan:
in saxaabi loo diray inuu keeno maydka
in maydku baaba’ay
in malaa’igta duugeen

Sababtaas awgeed waxaa loo bixiyay: “Khubayb — shahiidkii ay malaa’igta astureen.”

Calaamad adkaysi iyo sabir

Magaca “qabuuri” ee lagu gaaleysiiyo dariiqooyinka Suufiyada ma aha erey si dabiici ah uga dhashay fahamka diinta Islaamka, balse waa astaan siyaasadeed oo si qorsheysan loo sameeyey, loona adeegsaday burburinta isku-dhafka diineed iyo bulsho ee dalal Islaam ah. Taariikh ahaan, wax walba oo bulsho lagu beddelayo, lagu beegsanayo ama lagu kala dilayo, waxaa ka dambeeya ajande siyaasadeed oo lagu maalgeliyey dhaqaale iyo aragti quburo. Fikradda ah in “Suufiyadu yihiin qabuuriyiin” waxaa si toos ah iyo si dadban u maalgeliyey dalal Carbeed iyo hay’ado caalami ah oo dano gaar ah ka lahaa jihaynta fikirka diineed ee dunida Islaamka iyo qayraadka ku jira dalalkaas. Qofka Suufiga ahna ma caabudo qabuur, ee wuxuu caabudaa Alle Subxaanahu Watacaalaa, sida ay isku waafaqsan yihiin dhammaan culimada Sunniga ah ee taariikhda Islaamka ama ku qoran kutubtooda. In Alle qeyrkiis la caabudaana waa shirki weyn. 

Markii qorshahan la bilaabay hirgelintiisa, ujeeddada dhabta ah waxay ahayd in lagu wiiqo dalalka haysta madhabka Imaam Maxamed ibn Idriis al-Shaafi‘i iyo Imaam Maalik ibn Anas, kuwaas oo ka mid ahaa afarta Imaam ee waaweyn ee Sunniga, isla markaana ahaa fuquho iyo culimo dhisay nidaamka shareecada Islaamka. 

Inta badan dalalka haysta labadan madhab waxay ku yaallaan dhulal istiraatiiji ah oo batwaaqo ah, lehna kheyraad dabiici ah, isla markaana maanta wajahaya xasillooni darro siyaasadeed, dagaallo, iyo faragelin shisheeye. Arrintani ma aha isku-beeg, balse waa natiijo ka dhalatay isku dhafka dano diimeed oo la siyaasadeeyey iyo dano dhaqaale oo la qariyey.

General Julius Karangi: Kenya’s Steadfast Defender and Military Leader.
General Julius Waweru Karangi was born on 28 April 1951 in Nyeri County, in central Kenya, during the final decade of British colonial rule. Growing up in a disciplined rural environment, he developed early values of duty, order, and service that would later define his professional life. Although details of his early schooling are not widely documented in public records, his later career reflects a strong academic and professional foundation shaped by rigorous military training.

Karangi joined the Kenya Air Force in 1973, marking the beginning of a military career that would span more than four decades. He was selected for officer training in the United Kingdom, where he was commissioned in 1974. In October 1975, he qualified as a flight navigator with the Royal Air Force, after which he returned to Kenya and served in the Flying Wing of the Kenya Air Force. These early years established him as a technically skilled and disciplined officer within the air arm of the Kenya Defence Forces.

Throughout the 1980s and 1990s, Karangi steadily rose through the ranks, holding a variety of operational, command, and staff appointments. His career progression reflected confidence from military leadership and consistent professional performance. In 1995, he was appointed Commander of Moi Air Base, a key installation of the Kenya Air Force. Two years later, in 1997, he became Commander of the Kenya Air Force Logistics Command, placing him in charge of planning, supply, and operational readiness.

Between 2000 and 2003, Karangi served as Commandant of the Defence Staff College, an institution responsible for training senior military officers in strategy, leadership, and joint operations. During this period, he was promoted to the rank of Major General. In 2003, he was appointed Commander of the Kenya Air Force, becoming the professional head of the service and overseeing its modernization, training standards, and operational effectiveness. 

His leadership in the Air Force culminated in his promotion to Lieutenant General in 2005, when he was appointed Vice Chief of the Defence Forces, the second-highest military office in Kenya.
On 13 July 2011, President Mwai Kibaki appointed Julius Karangi as Chief of the Defence Forces (CDF) and promoted him to the rank of General. He became the first CDF to serve fully under the 2010 Constitution of Kenya, which restructured and unified command of the armed forces. His tenure as CDF marked a defining chapter in Kenya’s military history.

Later in 2011, under his leadership, the Kenya Defence Forces launched Operation Linda Nchi, deploying troops into Somalia to counter the Al-Shabaab militant group following repeated cross-border security threats. This was Kenya’s first major external combat operation. 

The mission later transitioned into the African Union Mission in Somalia (AMISOM), integrating Kenyan forces into a broader regional and international security framework. Karangi oversaw this complex operation, which involved coordination with foreign militaries, intelligence agencies, and international partners.

Karangi’s term as CDF also coincided with heightened domestic security challenges, including major terrorist attacks on Kenyan soil. While these incidents sparked national debate on intelligence and preparedness, no formal misconduct or criminal responsibility was attributed to him personally. His leadership style remained professional, constitutional, and non-political, reinforcing the principle of civilian oversight of the military.

In recognition of his service, General Karangi received several national and international honors, including the Elder of the Order of the Golden Heart (EGH), the Chief of the Order of the Burning Spear (CBS), and the Distinguished Conduct Order (DCO).

 He was also awarded the Legion of Merit (Degree of Commander) by the United States of America for distinguished service and cooperation with allied forces. Academically, he earned a Master of Science in Security and Risk Management and later received an honorary doctorate, reflecting his contribution to strategic leadership and national security.

General Julius Karangi retired from the Kenya Defence Forces on 5 May 2015, after 42 years of continuous service. His retirement marked the conclusion of one of the longest and most comprehensive military careers in Kenya’s history, spanning operational service, institutional leadership, and historic command responsibilities.
After retirement, Karangi continued to serve the public in civilian leadership roles. 

He was appointed Chairman of the National Social Security Fund (NSSF) Board of Trustees, where he oversaw pension governance. In 2022, he became Chairperson of the National Council for Population and Development (NCPD), a role that was later revoked in October 2025 as part of broader government restructuring.

 In November 2023, he was appointed Chancellor of Dedan Kimathi University of Technology, a position reflecting trust in his leadership, discipline, and national stature.

Today, General (Rtd.) Julius Waweru Karangi is remembered as a career soldier and strategic leader whose service coincided with a transformative period in Kenya’s security history.

 His legacy is defined by professionalism, constitutional loyalty, and steady leadership during both domestic and regional security challenges.

 Qoraallada Kicinaya Colaadda ee Baraha Bulshada
Waxaa jirta odhaah Soomaaliyeed oo tidhaahda: Aamus marka aan dhahaba, Ay Sarar wataan arkaa macnaha marka xaqa la aaso, hadalku waa waajib. 

Muddo ayaan ka aamusnaa waxa ka socda baraha bulshada sababo ii gaar ah awgood. Hase yeeshee, waxa soo baxaya mararka qaarkood waa hadallo aan laga aamusi karin, maxaa yeelay saamayntoodu ma aha mid ku eg qoraa iyo akhriste, balse waxay taabanayaan nabadda, wada noolaanshaha, iyo miyirka bulshada.
Qoraallada ay dadka qaar baraha bulshada ku baahiyeen waxay si khatar ah isugu qaseen diin, qabiil, iyo siyaasad. Isku qasiddaasi ma aha mid ka timid aqoon, cilmi, ama mas’uuliyad, balse waxay u muuqataa mid ku dhisan kicin dareen, kala fogeyn bulsho, iyo sawir qaldan oo laga bixinayo xaalado siyaasadeed oo u baahan degganaan iyo garasho fog.
1. Marka diinta loo adeegsado kicinta colaadda
Diintu waa tiir mideeya ummadde, ma aha aalad lagu kala diro. Marka ereyo diin leh lagu lifaaqo dagaal, qabiil, ama dhinac siyaasadeed, waxaa la abuurayaa sawir ah in Ilaahay dhinac la safan yahay, halka dhinaca kalena laga saarayo xaqnimada. Tani waa qalad culus oo diini ah iyo mid bulsheedba. Diintu ma oggola in lagu gabbado kicin, eedeyn, ama colaad hurin.

2. Marka magaca beel loo adeegsado sawir dagaal
In beel magaceeda si toos ah loogu xidho dagaal, dhiig, ama eedeyn guud waa dhaqan dhaawacaya wada noolaanshaha. Bulsho kasta waxay ka kooban tahay dad kala aragti, kala mowqif, kala dookh siyaasadeed leh. In lagu soo koobo hal beel ama hal magac waa gef ka dhan ah xaqiiqda iyo caddaaladda.

Qoraallada noocan ahi waxay bulshada ku beeraan tuhun, kala shaki, iyo dareen ah “annaga iyo iyaga,” taas oo ah abuuridda jawi colaadeed oo aan cidna dan u ahayn.
3. Marka siyaasad lagu fasirto dareen, ee aan lagu fasirin xaqiiqo
Arrimaha siyaasadeed waxay u baahan yihiin falanqayn ku dhisan xog, taariikh, iyo aragti fog. Marka lagu beddelo hadal dareen kicin ah, waxaa meesha ka baxaya doodii saxda ahayd, waxaana soo haraya sawaxan iyo is eedeyn aan xal keenayn.
Bulshadeennu waxay u baahan tahay dad wax kala caddeeya, ma aha dad wax isku qasa.

4. Mas’uuliyadda qoraaga iyo saamaynta hadalka
Qofka wax qora ama wax baahiya ma aha qof caadi ah. Wuxuu hayaa awood saameyn karta kumannaan qof. Sidaas darteed, hadalku waa inuu noqdaa mid miisaaman, ka fiirsan, oo og cawaaqibka ka dhalan kara.

Hadal kicin ah oo maanta la qoro, berri wuxuu isu beddeli karaa nacayb dhab ah oo dhex mara bulshada.

Me: Yan Xun 🩷

🤙 STORY TIME!!!
#AWoundWrittenInYears

   With the Princess Agents sequel, #Rebirth, coming soon, I just want to share a story connected to one of its characters—an unforgettable experience that left deep marks on my heart, even after all these years.

   Back in 2017, Princess Agents aired in mainland China. Even after it finished airing, it continued to attract more and more viewers once it became available on YouTube, thanks to its gripping storyline. The first few minutes of Episode 1 were more than enough to hook you—and before you knew it, you couldn’t stop watching. One episode was never enough.

   That’s exactly what happened to me. Sleep completely disappeared from my vocabulary as I want to finish all 58 episodes as quickly as possible 😂. But when I finally reached the ending, sleep still wouldn’t come. My mind was full of questions: What happens next? Why did it end like that? How could they do this to us?

   To mend a heart left hanging by a cliffhanger, joining fan groups related to the drama was the solution—just to fish for spoilers, gossip, or even the impossible Episode 59 ☺. 

   And that’s where my story begins.
After finishing all 58 episodes of Princess Agents, I joined a Facebook group in search of Episode 59—but of course, I failed 🥺. In that group, I encountered many fans whose experiences mirrored mine. Some even debated fiercely about whom Chu Qiao should choose—or who truly deserved her: Yuwen Yue or Yan Xun?

Fans from both sides passionately defended their favorites, and I admit—I was one of them 😂. I was young, emotional, and still new to the #CDrama world thats why I was very hyped to debate 🤷‍♀️.
   Then one debate escalated far beyond healthy discussion. The other party’s defense became unbalanced—crossing the line into personal attacks, curses, and insults that had nothing to do with the topic anymore. It was no longer about the characters; it was about winning at all costs.

   Out of frustration, I removed that member from the group—a decision I later regretted once I had calmed down. I wanted to undo it, but it was already too late. In response, she posted about me on her personal account, where her friends joined in and openly attacked me online. I was completely unaware at first that I was being cursed—some comments were shockingly degrading and cruel.
   
   One of our mutual Facebook friends saw the post and sent it to me. That was when I found out. Imagine how shaken I was—this was the first time in my life I had experienced something like that. Seeing such vicious words directed at me was terrifying.

   Knowing that her friends were stalking my account, I posted about the personal attacks I was receiving. Thankfully, some people sympathized with me, and their support eased my stress a little. But in hindsight, that may have been another mistake—because everyone who commented in support of me also became targets of her and her friends’ curses.

   Unbeknownst to me, some group admins had already noticed the below-the-belt attacks. They messaged me privately and advised me not to engage anymore. They told me this wasn’t the first time that "she" had done something like this—that she was known for picking fights online, especially with fans of the characters she disliked or opinions she didn’t agree with. Apparently, I wasn’t her only target.

   Taking their advice, I tried my best to ignore her and avoid further conflict. Still, some persistent friends kept sending me screenshots of her posts, so I remained aware of what was happening 😊. From then on, I made sure to stay away from her online space to avoid further trouble—but her name had already been carved into my memory.

   I was deeply traumatized by the experience. The level of verbal abuse I encountered was something I had never experienced, not even in real life.
That “someone” was a die-hard #YanXun fan (#DouXiao ). And I was firmly on Yuwen Yue’s side (#LinGengxin ).

   Fast forward, a few years—four years later, to be exact. One of our mutual Facebook friend posted a tribute—a grieving post. Curiosity got the better of me, and I clicked the tagged name. That’s when I realized it was her—the same person I had debated with years before.

  On her account was a post from her mother, announcing her sudden passing. I was stunned. When I learned the reason behind her death, everything suddenly made sense. I finally understood why she had been the way she was back then. Perhaps her aggression was a shield—not just online, but also for herself.

   She may have left me with trauma, a scar in my C-drama fangirling journey, but that experience taught me valuable lessons—lessons I still carry with me today. It taught me restraint, empathy, and how to balance emotions, especially when engaging in online discussions.

   Now that #Rebirth is about to air, and Yan Xun’s character is coming back to life through #ZhangKangle, I’ve realized something unexpected. Watching the released clips, I feel that this time, Yan Xun might actually become my favorite character.
And I found myself wondering—if she were still alive today, would she still be supporting Yan Xun?

If yes, then I think… this time, we would finally on the same side.

To that someone:
   Girl, wherever you are now—and if reincarnation truly exists—I wish that whatever caused your early departure from this life will not follow you into the next. 🙏 I hope you never have to endure what you went through again. I hope that in your next life, the world will meet a gentler, happier version of you.

A long life and a contented girl. 🌸

The Gosha people or WaGosha literally meaning “people of the forest” reside along the Shebelle and Jubba River valleys located in southern Somalia. They are commonly known as the “Somali Bantu”, a name deemed offensive to them. They are descendants of enslaved Bantu people from Tanzania, Mozambique, and Malawi brought to Somalia through the Arab slave trade. Since their arrival in Somalia, Gosha people have been subjected to oppression, discrimination, and marginalization. They are an impoverished group of people with no access to government aid or the ability to participate in political decisions in Somalia. Historically and currently, Gosha people residing in Somalia do not have access to education, which is why the majority of them do not have a record of their birthdates and lack reading and writing skills.

Many resettled as refugees in the United States as early as 2003 after the Somali civil war. They still maintain their culture and language. Though many speak in the Maay dialect and some Zigula, some also speak Mahaa, the official Somali language. Others speak both or multiple dialects. The Maay dialect also has sub dialects. The people of Goshaland are sometimes called WaGosha because they belong to sub-clans and may not speak the same language or dialect. However, the majority of Gosha people practice the Islamic faith and are of the Sunni sect.

Gosha or WaGosha people, commonly known as the Somali Bantu were brought to Somalia in the 19th century by Arab slave traders as agricultural laborers. By the beginning of the 20th century Italy, which had colonized country, abolished slavery in Somalia. However, Italy established over 100 plantations in the Jubba and Shebelle River valleys, where Gosha people reside and enforced labor laws that forced Gosha people to work as farm laborers on Italian owned plantations. Due to this, Gosha people were kept enslaved until the 1930s.

Hordhac
Culimada Islaamka waxay taariikh ahaan ku lahaayeen bulshooyinka Muslimiinta doorka ugu sarreeya ee hagidda akhlaaqda, difaaca dulmanaha, iyo ilaalinta mabaadi’da caddaaladda. Islaamka gudaheeda, culimadu waa in ay noqdaan kuwa ka sarreeya qabyaaladda, siyaasadda, iyo danaha kooxeed, iyagoo ku dhaqmaya mabaadi’da caddaaladda , run-sheegidda  iyo dhex-dhexaadnimada .
Haddaba, marka la eego khibradda taariikheed ee dadka reer Somaliland—gaar ahaan beesha Isaaq—tan iyo sideetanaadkii qarnigii 20aad, waxaa soo baxaya su’aal cilmiyeed oo culus: sidee ayay culimada Soomaaliyeed ula macaamileen dulmigii, xasuuqii, iyo go’aannadii siyaasadeed ee dadkaas ku habsaday? 
Maqaalkani wuxuu si nidaamsan u falanqaynayaa mowqifyadaas, isagoo diiradda saaraya aamusnaanta, laba-wejiilaynta, iyo eexda ka muuqata hadallada iyo ficillada culimada koonfureed.

1. Xasuuqii Gobollada Waqooyi (1980-meeyadii): Aamusnaanta Culimada
Intii u dhaxaysay dabayaaqadii sideetanaadkii iyo bilowgii sagaashamaadkii, gobolladii waqooyi ee Soomaaliya—gaar ahaan Hargeysa, Burco, Ceerigaabo, iyo deegaanno kale—waxaa ka dhacay duqaymo, dilal qorshaysan, barakicin ballaadhan, iyo burbur nidaamsan oo lagu beegsaday dad rayid ah. Falalkaasi waxaa fuliyey ciidamadii dawladdii markaas jirtay, iyadoo si cad loo bartilmaameedsaday dad shacab ah oo aan waxba galabsan.
Dhacdooyinkaas, marka loo eego shuruucda caalamiga ah iyo xeerarka Islaamka, waxay ay ahaayeen dulmi weyn , xitaa waxa lagu tilmaamay xasuuq ama dabar-goyn. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxa si muuqata u maqnaa cambaarayn cad oo ka timaadda culimada Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan kuwa aan ka soo jeedin gobollada waqooyi.
Aamusnaantaasi ma ahayn mid ku kooban shaqsiyaad gaar ah, balse waxay noqotay arrin guud oo laga dareemay goobaha diinta, masaajidda, iyo hay’adaha culimada. Tani waxay si weyn uga hor imanaysey kaalintii laga filayay culimada, maadaama Islaamku si cad u farayo in la difaaco dulmanaha, xitaa haddii uu ka soo horjeedo qofka dulmiga geystay.
Qaxootigii reer waqooyi ee u qaxay xeryaha ku yaalla Itoobiya kama helin culimada Soomaaliyeed wax gargaar ah, baaq bani’aadamnimo, ama muujin naxariis diimeed. taasoo ka hor imanaysa mabaadi’da Islaamka ee isu-gurmadka iyo u hiilinta dulmanaha.

2. Xarakooyinka Islaamiga ah iyo Sharciyeynta Dagaalka: Laba Miisaan
Xilligaas, Soomaaliya waxaa si firfircoon uga jiray xarakooyin Islaami ah oo saameyn ku lahaa fikirka diimeed ee bulshada. Waxa si gaar ah loo xasuustaa in qaar ka mid ah xarakooyinkaas:
• Ay xaaraan ku tilmaameen iska caabbintii dadka reer waqooyi, iyagoo sheegay in aanay sharci ahayn in la qaado hub lagu difaacayo nafta, maalka, iyo sharafta.
• Waxay diideen in dulmigaas loo aqoonsado mid xaq u siinaya is-difaacid sharci ah.
Dhanka kale, marka dagaalladu ka dhaceen Muqdisho iyo koonfurta Soomaaliya, isla culimadii iyo xarakooyinkii ayaa:
• Dagaalkaas ku tilmaamay jihaad sharci ah.
• Ku baaqay in laga qayb qaato.
• Qaar badanina ay si toos ah uga mid noqdeen dagaalka.
Isbarbardhiggan wuxuu muujinayaa laba miisaan oo cad: mid loo adeegsaday marka dhibku ku dhaco waqooyiga, mid kalena marka uu ka dhaco koonfurta. Arrintani waxay si toos ah u dhaawacaysaa mabda’a caddaaladda Islaamka, oo aan aqbalayn kala saarid ku dhisan juqraafi ama qabiil.

3. Gooni-isu-taaggii Somaliland iyo Jawaabta Culimada
Kadib burburkii dawladdii dhexe, dadka reer Somaliland waxay 1991 ku dhawaaqeen in ay dib ula soo noqdeen madaxbannaanidoodii, iyagoo tixraacaya midowgii 1960 oo ay u arkeen mid fashilmay, sharciyad iyo xaqsoor la’aanna ku dhammaaday.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, culimo badan iyo xarakooyin diimeed ayaa go’aankaas:
• Ku tilmaamay mid diin ahaan khaldan.
• Ka dhigay arrin mid caqiidada laxidhiidha, halkii ay ka ahaan lahayd go’aan siyaasadeed iyo mid taariikheed.
• Xitaa qaar ka mid ah bayaannadaas waxay gaadheen heer lagu eedeeyo dadka reer Somaliland inay leeyihiin xidhiidho shisheeye oo diimeed iyo kuwo siyaasadeed oo lagu dhibayo umadda soomaliyeed..
Marna lama arag falanqayn cilmiyeed oo culimada koonfureed ay ku eegayaan sababaha taariikheed ee keenay go’aankaas, sida xasuuqii, caddaalad-darradii, iyo burburkii midnimada.

4. Khilaafka Laascaanood: Mawqif Degdeg ah iyo Dhexdhexaad la’aan
Markii uu qarxay khilaafka Laascaanood, jawaabta culimada qaarkood waxay ahayd mid degdeg ah, aan si miisaan leh loo eegin, isla markaana dhinac u janjeedhay. Waxaa si cad loo arkay:
• Bayaanno iyo fatwooyin si toos ah uga soo horjeeda dawladda Somaliland., ilaa ay ku timaameen cadowga umadda
• Taageero dhaqaale iyo mid siyaasadba oo loo fidiyay kooxihii hubaysnaa.
• Waxay ka gaabsadeen in ay sameeyaan dhexdhexaadin, baaritaan, ama raadiyaan xal nabadeed.
Hab-dhaqankan wuxuu muujinayaa in mowqifkaasi uusan ku dhisnayn xaqiiqda dhabta ah ee dhulka ka jirtay, balse uu ku salaysnaa aragti hore loo qaatay.

5. Qirashada Xasuuqa: Farqiga u Dhexeeya Culimada iyo Aqoonyahanka
Waxaa jira aqoonyahanno badan oo Soomaaliyeed, oo aan ahayn culimada, oo si cad u qiray in dadka Isaaq lagu sameeyay xasuuq sideetanaadkii. Ilaa qaar kamid ah madaxdii dalku ay raaligelin kabixiyaan . laakiin ilaa iminka lama hayo culimo soomaaliyeed oo si jamaaci ah ama si khaas ah arintaas uga hadlay oo qiraal kasameeyey
Ka gaabsashada qirashada runta taariikhiga ah waxay dhaawacaysaa sumcadda culimada, waxayna keentaa in diinta loo adeegsado marmarsiiyo siyaasadeed.

6. Xidhiidhka Dibadda iyo Adeegsiga Takfiirka
Markii Somaliland ay shaacisay xidhiidh dibadeed oo ay la yeelatay Israa’iil, culimo badan ayaa adeegsaday hadallo aad ugu dhow takfiir, iyagoo:
• Ku tilmaamay bulshada reer Somaliland kuwo ka baxsan diinta. Sidii ka muuqatay kuwii ka mudaharaadayey muqdisho
• Ku baaqay dagaal ama jihaad ka dhan ah.
Arrintani waxay si cad u muujinaysaa khalad ku jira fahamka diinta, maadaama xiriir dibadeed uu yahay arrin siyaasadeed, ee uusan ahayn qodob caqiido.
Haddaba, culimada reer soomaaliya mawqifkooda ku saabsan reer waqooyi-(Somaliland) waxay ka turjumaysaa in uu lamid yahay ka kuwii geystay dulmiga iyo kala irdhaynta umadda soomaaliyeed. Waxynu ku tilmaami karnaa kuwo u adeegga aragtiyo cadaawadi kujirto oo lala beegsanayo dadka reer waqooyi. 
Waxaan filayaa arinkoodu waa sidii maahmaahdii ahayd –Fiqi Tolkii kama janno tago.

1. Waa maxay Amniga Dalka?

Amniga dalka waa ilaalinta nolosha, hantida, sharafka, midnimada iyo madaxbannaanida qaranka. Waxa uu ka kooban yahay amniga gudaha, kan xuduudaha, kan maskaxda (fikradaha), kan dhaqaalaha iyo kan bulsho.
2. Muhiimadda Amniga Dalka
Amnigu waa tiirka ugu weyn ee dawladnimo. Dal aan amni lahayn:

Ma horumaro 
Ma helaan dadkiisu caddaalad
Ma jiri karto maalgashi, waxbarasho iyo caafimaad
Midnimadiisu way burburtaa

#Amni la’aan = Nolol la’aan qaran

3. Sidee loo Ilaaliyaa Amniga Dalka?
Amniga laguma ilaaliyo ciidan keliya, balse waa masuuliyad wadareed:
Xeerarka iyo sharciga: u hoggaansamid iyo dhowrid
Wacyigelin bulsho: la dagaallanka xagjirnimada iyo colaad beeleedka
Midnimo qaran: ka fogaanshaha hadal kala fogeeya bulshada
War-ogaalnimo: ka digtoonaan wararka been-abuurka ah
Is-kaashi bulsho & dowlad 
4. Doorka Dhalinyarada
Dhalinyaradu waa laf-dhabarta amniga dalka. Doorkoodu waa mid ballaaran:
✔️ Wacyigelin iyo tusaale wanaag
Dhalinyarada ha noqdaan kuwa bulshada ku hogaamiya nabad, anshax iyo waddaniyad.
✔️Ka fogaanshaha falalka lidka ku ah amniga
Sida daroogo, burcadnimo, xagjirnimo iyo rabshado.
✔️ Ka qaybqaadashada horumarka
Qof shaqeeya, wax barta, fikir dhisa — waa askari aan qori sidin 
✔️Ilaalinta baraha bulshada
Ha noqon kuwo faafiya nacayb, been iyo fitno; balse noqda kuwa mideeya.
✔️Taageeridda hay’adaha amniga
La shaqayn, la talin, lana garab istaag hay’adaha sharciga.

5. Gunaanad

Amniga dalka ma aha shaqo ciidan oo keliya, waa waajib saaran muwaadin kasta, gaar ahaan dhalinyarada. Dhalinyaro miyir leh = Dal ammaan ah.

The Somali Bantu 🇸🇴

are a Bantu-speaking people living mainly in southern Somalia, especially along the Juba and Shabelle river valleys (Lower Juba, Middle Juba, Lower Shabelle, Middle Shabelle). They are not Cushitic Somalis; they are part of the wider Bantu world of East and Central Africa, with deep roots that long predate modern Somali statehood

Origins & Migration

The ancestors of the Somali Bantu came from East and Southeast Africa, particularly areas that are today Tanzania, Mozambique, Malawi, and eastern Congo. Groups such as the Wazigua (Zigua), Yao, Makua, Nyasa, and others migrated naturally over centuries, especially between the 1600s and early 1700s, searching for fertile land and water.

A small portion of the Somali Bantu population can still be found in Southern Somali while a huge population fled and saught refuge in Tanzania and the USA .

.Suspended the constitution
.Banned political parties
.Centralized all power in the presidency
.Publicly preached “scientific socialism” and anti-clanism

In reality, he ruled through clans and repression.

2. Clan favoritism and repression (1970s–1980s)

.Barre favored his own clan coalition (MOD alliance) and marginalized others.
.Loyal clans dominated the military and government
.Opposing clans were excluded, harassed, or attacked
.Dissent was met with arrests, torture, and executions
.This created deep resentment across the country.

3. Defeat in the Ogaden War (1977–78)

Somalia’s loss to Ethiopia was a turning point.

.This Shattered Barre’s image as a strong leader
.Triggered attempted coups
.Flooded Somalia with weapons and refugees
.Weakened the economy
.Opposition hardened after this defeat

4. Emergence of armed rebel movements

.Disgruntled groups formed armed resistance movements, mostly along clan lines:

•SSDF (Majerteen)
•SNM (Isaaq)
•USC (Hawiye)
These groups fought government forces, turning political opposition into civil conflict

.The regime responded with extreme force.
.Bombing of Hargeisa and Burao
.Mass civilian killings
.Forced displacement of entire communities

This pushed many Somalis to support rebel groups openly.

6. Fall of Siad Barre (January 1991)

In January 1991, rebel forces entered Mogadishu and overthrew Barre

But:
.There was no transition plan
.Rebel groups disagreed on leadership
.Armed factions turned on each other

This marked the official start of the civil war

7. Total collapse and warlordism

.Armed groups fought for territory
.Looting of state assets followed
.Famine spread

Hordhac.

Dawladaha Hoose waa hay’adaha ugu dhow bulshada, kuwaas oo door weyn ka qaata qorsheynta, maareynta, iyo horumarinta magaalooyinka. Iyaga ayaa si toos ah ula falgala baahiyaha nololeed ee dadka ku nool magaalooyinka, sida adeegyada aasaasiga ah, kaabeyaasha, iyo maamul wanaagga. Sidaa darteed, horumarka magaalooyinka si weyn ayuu ugu xiran yahay kartida iyo waxqabadka dawladaha hoose.
Doorka Dawladaha Hoose ee Horumarinta Magaalooyinka.

1. Qorsheynta Magaalooyinka (Urban Planning) Dawladaha hoose ayaa mas’uul ka ah:
Qorsheynta dhulka iyo isticmaalka dhulka (land use).

2. Dejinta iyo hirgelinta qorshaha guud ee magaalada (master plan)
Xakameynta dhismayaasha iyo fiditaanka aan nidaamka lahayn

Qorsheyn wanaagsan waxay ka hortagtaa ciriiriga, waxayna suurtagelisaa magaalo si nidaamsan u korta.

3. Bixinta Adeegyada Aasaasiga ah Dawladaha hoose waxay bixiyaan ama maamulaan adeegyo muhiim ah sida:

4. Nadaafadda iyo maareynta qashinka
Biyaha iyo fayadhowrka
Waddooyinka gudaha iyo nalalka waddooyinka
Suuqyada, xabaalaha, iyo goobaha dadweynaha
Adeegyo tayo leh ayaa kor u qaada caafimaadka, bilicda, iyo nolol-maalmeedka magaalooyinka.

5. Horumarinta Kaabeyaasha (Infrastructure Development) Iyagoo adeegsanaya dakhliga maxalliga ah iyo deeqaha, dawladaha hoose waxay
Dhisaan oo dayactiraan waddooyin
Horumariyaan xarumaha ganacsiga
Taageeraan kaabeyaasha bulshada (dugsiyo, xarumo caafimaad)
Kaabayaal xooggan waa saldhigga kobaca dhaqaale ee magaalooyinka.

 Dawladaha hoose waxay xoojiyaan sharciga iyo kala dambeynta heer degmo waxay 
La shaqeeyaan hay’adaha amniga waxaanay 
Horumariyaan isla-xisaabtanka iyo daahfurnaanta shaqo 

6. Maamul wanaag wuxuu abuuraa magaalo ammaan ah oo maalgashi soo jiidata.
Kobcinta Dhaqaalaha Magaalooyinka Iyagoo taageeraya ganacsiga maxalliga ah, dawladaha hoose waxay:
Fududeeyaan ruqsadaha ganacsiga
Horumariyaan suuqyada iyo goobaha ganacsiga
Abuurraan jawi u wanaagsan maalgashiga
Tani waxay kordhisaa shaqo-abuurka iyo dakhliga dadka ku nool magaalooyinka.

Ka-qaybgalka bulshada ee go’aan-qaadashada

Bulsho ka qaybqaadata horumarka waxay xaqiijisaa in magaalooyinku noqdaan kuwo waara oo la wada leeyahay.

Dhaqaale xaddidan
Awood-maamul iyo aqoon yari
Qorsheyn la’aan ama fulin daciif ah
Kordhinta degdegga ah ee magaalooyinka (rapid urbanization)

Baydhabo waa magaalo leh taariikh dheer, dad adkaysi badan, iyo kaalmo weyn oo ay ku leedahay midnimada iyo xasilloonida dalka. Dagaalka maanta ka socda halkaas ma aha mid u adeegaya dan guud, mana ahan mid horseedaya horumar, nabad iyo mustaqbal ifaya.

Colaadaha hubeysan ee ka qarxa magaalooyinka waa kuwa ugu horreeya ee saameeya shacabka aan waxba galabsan. Haween, carruur, waayeel iyo dad danyar ah ayaa noqda dhibbanayaasha koowaad. Guryihii lagu noolaa ayaa burbura, ganacsigii yaraaday, isku socodkii iyo noloshii caadiga ahaydna waa istaagtaa. Hanti badan oo dadku ku soo tacbadeen sanado dheer ayaa hal mar ku baaba’da rasaas iyo qarax aan cidna faa’iido u lahayn.

Dagaalka Baydhabo ka socda wuxuu sidoo kale dhaawacayaa rajadii iyo kalsoonidii shacabka ee ku aaddan nabadda iyo wada noolaanshaha. Markasta oo hub la qaato, waxaa dib loo riixayaa fursaddii wada hadal, isfaham iyo xal nabadeed. Taariikhda Soomaaliya waxay na bartay in dagaal uusan waligiis xal waara keenin, balse uu sii huriyo nacayb, kala qoqob iyo dhibaato joogto ah.

Waxaan ugu baaqayaa dhammaan dhinacyada ku lugta leh in ay hubka dhigaan, fursadna siiyaan wada hadal iyo xal nabadeed, si Baydhabo iyo guud ahaan Koonfur Galbeed ay u noqdaan meel nabad, barwaaqo iyo rajo leh.

Makroobiyiin (Macrobians).

Dadka magacan lihi waxay ku noolaan jireen Geeska Afrika sida uu sheegay taariikh yahankii iyo dhul yaqaankii Giriigga ahaa ee Herodutus qarnigii shanaad, marka la eego magacoodu wuxuu u laabanayaa erey macne ahaan ah nolol dheer amma cimrri dheereyaal (Long-lived) sababtuna waa in la sheegay inay dadkani noolaan jireen oo uu cimrigoodu gaadhi jiray boqol sanno iyo dheeraad, meelaha uu Herodutus sheegay inay dadkani degenaayeenna waxa ka mid ah: Gacanka Cadmeed iyo xeebaha bari ee geeska Afrika, waana meelaha ay imika deggen yihiin dadka Soomaalidu. 

Astaamaha uu Herodutus sheegay inay dadkani lahaayeen waxa ka mid ah: Dherer, qurux iyo dad hodan ku ahaa dhaqashada xoolaha iyo kalluumaysiga, waxaana uu sheegay in dhaqankoodu ka duwanaa dhammaan quruumihii kale ee waagaa noolaa.

525 Nebi Ciise ka hor markii uu Kambaysiskii labaad ee Faaris qabsaday Masar wuxuu safiirro qiimeeya dhulka hodanka ah iyo dadka reer Macrobia u diray dhulkaas waxaana sida laga soo xigtay Herodutus la sheegay inuu hadyado waawayn safiirrada ugu sii dhiibay boqorkii Macrobia si uu u aqbalo xukunkiisa maaddaama uu Kambaysis waday dhul ballaadhsi boqortooyo, waxa se' ku gacan saydhay boqorkii Makroobiyiinta oo sheegay inay dadkiisu yihiin geesiyaal aan la xukumi karin islamarkaana aan la cabsi gelin karin.

Markii uu Kambaysis helay jawaabta diidmada ah waxa la sheegaa inuu qaaday weerarro hayeeshee uu ku guuldarraystay sababo la xidhiidha farsamo xumo iyo dadka Makroobiyiinta oo ahaa dad aad u taxaddar badan oo dagaal yaqaan ah Kambaysis-na wuu ka laabtay qorshihiisii ahaa qabsashada dhulkaas.

Haddaba, waxa jira aragtiyo iyo afkaaro xusaya in dadkaa Makroobiyiintu ay ahaayeen Soomaalida hadda waxaana laga dhexaysiiyaa dhul, dhaqan iyo astaamo jidheed, dagaal jacayl iyo sidoo kale cunto dhaqameed, hayeeshee ma jiraan caddaymo lagu kalsoonaan karo oo sheegaya inay dadkaasi ahaayeen Soomaali. Waxa iyana la isku khilaafaa inuu boqorkii faarisiinta ee Kambaysis ku guuldarraystay dagaallo uu la galay dadkan maaddaama uu boqorkani xukumayay boqortooyo aad u awood badnayd xilligaa. La iskuma hayo in deegaankan Soomaalidu degtaa ahaa deegaan ay deggenaayeen dawyow kale balse waxaan hubanti ahayn inay la xidhiidheen Soomaalida.

Xilka laga qaaday Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenkii Arrimaha Bulshada ee Degmada Raage Ceelle, Mudane Abdirahman Ahmed Caroone, ma ahayn arrin ku timid si caadi ah. Waxaa si cad loo arkaa in Hassan Mohamed Hussein Muungaab uu si toos ah uga shaqeeyay xil ka qaadista, isagoo ku marmarsiyoonaya kulammo qaraabo oo la xiriira Cosoble Celi.

Waxaa intaas dheer in Muungaab uu Gobolka Banaadir ka barakiciyay reer gaar ah, isla markaana hadda uu uga sii daba tagay deegaannada Hirshabeelle, isagoo ku hawlan isku day ciribtir iyo cadaadis joogto ah. Tani waa tallaabo muujinaysa nacayb, cuqdad iyo xaasidnimo ka fog hoggaamin iyo caddaalad.

Nasiib darro, muungaab wuxuu inta badan ku mashquulsan yahay dano shaqsiyeed, halkii uu xoogga saari lahaa horumarinta caasimadda. Arrintan waxay si gaar ah u dhibeysaa dhalinyaro badan oo karti leh, kana shaqeynaya danta guud.

Waxaa sii xoogeysanaya dhalinyarada ciilka u qaba cadaalad-darrada iyo hab-dhaqanka Muungaab. Runtii, maalin maalmaha ka mid ah, qof walba waxaa laga jaasin doonaa wixii uu sameeyay, caddaaladduna way iman doontaa, bi’idnillaahi Kariim.

kalsooni darro.
aqoonsi la’aan.

Jiritaan faaruq ah maxaa loola jeedaa?

Jiritaan faaruq ah ma aha faqri dhaqaale oo keliya, ee waa:
fikrad la’aan.
yool la’aan.
aqoon ama xirfad aan la dhisin,
iyo mas’uuliyad shakhsiyadeed oo laga cararay.

Qofkaas wuxuu ka doorbidaa in uu ku faano taariikh dad kale leeyihiin (qabiil, awoowayaal, magac) halkii uu ka dhisi lahaa taariikh u gaar ah.

Maxaa ka dhasha adeegsiga qabiilka?
Bulsho kala qaybsan.
Caddaalad darro iyo eex.
Maskax horumar diidan.
Dhalinyaro ku barbaarta nacayb iyo isbarbardhig joogto ah.

Qabiilku markuu noqdo qalab lagu cabbiro qiimaha qofka, hal-abuurka, aqoonta, iyo anshaxa ayaa hoos u dhacaya.

Qabiilku dhibaato ma yahay?

Maya, qabiilku asal ahaan waa aqoonsi bulsheed iyo shabakad taageero. Dhibaatadu waxay timaaddaa marka:
lagu beddelo shaqsiyadda.
lagu qariyo fashilka.
lagu dulmiyo dadka kale.
laga dhigo il keliya oo sharaf lagu helo.

“Ha iloobin cidda aad ka dhalatay.”

Sanado ayaa dhaafay. Tuuladii quruxda badnayd waxay noqotay meel laga baqo. Ceelkii Nolosha agtiisa lama fariisan jirin, waayo qof kastaa wuxuu ka shaki qabay kan kale.

“Laakiin waa inaan difaacnaa magaceena.”

Waayeelkii ayaa si deggan u eegay, wuxuuna ku yiri:
“Magac dhiig lagu difaaco wuxuu noqdaa magac murugo ku dhisan. Magac shaqo iyo aqoon lagu difaaco ayaa noqda magac sharaf leh.”

Kadib wuxuu u jeestay carruurtii, wuxuuna weydiiyay:

EXCLUSIF] Pape Cheikh Diallo arrêté pour homosexualité

La Brigade de recherches de la compagnie de gendarmerie de Keur Massar a procédé, hier vendredi, à l’arrestation de Pape Cheikh Diallo, présentateur de l’émission Quartier Général, selon des informations exclusives de Seneweb.  L’animateur est impliqué dans un vaste réseau de présumés homosexuels.
De son vrai nom Cheikh Ahmadou Tidiane Diallo, âgé de 44 ans, il a été dénoncé par le banquier Doudou Lamine Dieng après l’arrestation de ce dernier. Celui-ci a confié aux enquêteurs qu’il entretenait une relation de couple avec l’animateur mis en cause.
Lors de son interrogatoire, Pape Cheikh Diallo a reconnu les faits qui lui sont reprochés.
Douze arrestations, dont sept personnes porteuses du VIH
Au total, les gendarmes de la Brigade de recherches de Keur Massar ont arrêté 12 personnes présentées comme homosexuelles, dont 7 porteuses du VIH/sida, selon des sources de Seneweb.
Ces personnes ont été placées en garde à vue pour association de malfaiteurs, actes contre nature avec transmission volontaire du VIH/sida par rapports sexuels non protégés et mise en danger de la vie d’autrui.
Le procureur Saliou Dicko, chef du parquet de Pikine-Guédiawaye, a été informé des faits. L’enquête se poursuit.
La Légion de gendarmerie de Dakar, sous le commandement du colonel Malick Faye, affirme être plus que jamais déterminée à lutter contre la délinquance urbaine et la criminalité sous toutes ses formes.

Xaalada Abaaraha ee Deegaanka Soomaalida (DDS) iyo Doorka Hay’adaha (NGOs).

Deegaanka Soomaalidu (DDS) waxa uu sannado badan la daalaa dhacayay abaaro soo noqnoqday. Waayadan dambe, abaarahani waxay noqdeen kuwo sii bata oo sii xoogaysta, taas oo ay sabab u yihiin isbeddelka cimilada, burburka deegaanka, iyo roobabka oo aan joogto ahayn. Taasi waxay keentay in bulshooyinka xoolo-dhaqatada iyo xoolo-dhaqato beeralayda aha ee gobolka ay la kulmaan dhibaatooyin waaweyn, sida yaraanta cuntada, biyo-la’aanta, dhimashada xoolaha, nafaqo-darro, iyo barakac qasab ah. Saameynta abaaruhu si weyn ayay u wiiqeen xaaladda bulsho iyo mida dhaqaale ee dadka, Maadaama qoysas badani ay si buuxda ugu tiirsan yihiin xoolaha si ay u helaan cunto iyo dakhli, abaarta daba-dheeraata waxay inta badan keentaa khasaaro ballaaran oo dhanka xoolaha ah, hoos u dhac ku yimaadda helitaanka caanaha, iyo awoodda qoysaska iyo la qabsiga dhibaatooyinka oo yaraata, gaar ahaan dadka nugul sida carruurta, haweenka uurka leh iyo kuwa nuujinaya,(pregnant and lactating women) iyagoo wajahaya khataro sare oo nafaqo-darro iyo cudurro isugu jira. Sidoo kale, biyo-yaraantu waxay ku qasabtaa bulshooyinka inay masaafooyin dheer u safraan si ay u helaan biyo, taas oo kordhisa khataraha amniga isla markaana yareysa helitaanka adeegyada muhiimka ah sida waxbarashada iyo daryeelka caafimaadka.

Hay’adaha aan dawliga ahayn (NGOs) waxay door muhiim ah ka ciyaaraan wax ka qabashada saameynta abaaraha ee DDS. Waxay bixiyaan gargaar bini’aadantinimo oo degdeg ah, sida kaalmo cunto, biyo nadiif ah, barnaamijyo nafaqo, iyo adeegyo caafimaad oo aasaasi ah. Iyagoo fulinaya hawlo ay ka mid yihiin gaadiidinta biyaha (water trucking), dayactirka ceelasha, iyo horumarinta ilo-biyoodyada, NGOs-ku waxay gacan ka geystaan hubinta in bulshooyinku helaan biyo nadiif ah xilliyada abaarta daran. Intaa waxaa dheer, marka laga soo tago gargaarka degdegga ah, NGOs-ku waxay si firfircoon uga shaqeeyaan dhismaha adkeysiga muddada dheer ee bulshooyinka(strengthening long-term resilience communities), sioo kale kala-duwanaanshaha ilaha nololeed, taageeridda beeraha u adkeysan kara isbeddelka cimilada (climate-smart agriculture), hagaajinta adeegyada caafimaadka xoolaha, iyo dhiirrigelinta hawlaha dakhli-abuurka. 

Sidoo kale, NGOs-ku waxay maalgelin ku sameeyaan tababarro, nidaamyada digniinta hore, iyo wacyigelinta bulshada si loo xoojiyo diyaar-garowga loona yareeyo khataraha mustaqbalka, Iskaashi dhow oo lala yeesho hay’adaha dawladda, hoggaanka maxalliga ah, iyo maamulka sare ee deegaanka ayaa keenaya Nidaam Casri oo beero qadasho, Caafimaad I.WM. kuwaasoo horseeda horumar waara (sustainable development).

Brik wuxuu sheegay in Israa’iil ay muddo tobanaan sano ah isu beddeshay bulsho “gudaha ka kala go’day,” oo ay ka jiraan “nacayb qoto dheer oo u dhexeeya kooxaha bulshada, midigta iyo bidixda, iyo Yuhuudda iyo Carabta,” kala qaybsanaan uu sheegay inay gaartay dhammaan dhinacyada nolosha.
Isagoo tixraacaya Ra’iisul Wasaare Benjamin Netanyahu, Brik wuxuu sheegay in Israa’iil ay hoggaaminayaan hoggaan “ka hormariya badbaadada siyaasadeed danaha shacabka,” wuxuuna ku tilmaamay “aragti gaaban iyo jihayn la’aan.”

Xog la sii daayay 28-kii Janaayo oo ay soo saartay Xafiiska Tirakoobka Israa’iil ayaa muujisay in haajiridda Israa’iiliyiinta ay kordhay 39% sannadka 2024 marka loo eego sannadkii ka horreeyay.
Brik wuxuu intaas ku daray in adkeysiga Israa’iil uu daciifayo dhammaan waaxyaha, oo ay ku jiraan amniga, dhaqaalaha, waxbarashada, caafimaadka, kaabayaasha, iyo cilmiga.
Wuxuu ku baaqay “in la awood siiyo jiil dhalinyaro ah si ay hoggaanka ula wareegaan oo dalka uga saaraan qalalaasaha hadda jira.”
“Caqabadaha ina horyaalla, laga bilaabo soo celinta amniga waqooyiga (Lubnaan iyo Suuriya) iyo koonfurta (Qaza) ilaa dib u dhiska dhaqaalaha iyo xiriirrada caalamiga ah, waxay u baahan yihiin tamar ay leeyihiin oo keliya kuwa weli horyaalla tobanaan sano oo nolol ah,” ayuu qoray Brik.
