Waa maxay tacasub?

Tacasub waa dareen ama fikir qofka ku kallifa inuu koox ama qof kale ku eedeeyo, ku takooro, ama hooseeysiiyo, iyadoo lagu salaynayo qabiil, diin, deegaan, af, ama aragti siyaasadeed. Tacasubku wuxuu ka dhashaa fikir xaddidan iyo nacayb aan caddaalad ku salaysnayn oo ku saleeysan aqoon yari, wuxuuna bulshada u keenaa kala fogaansho, muran, iyo colaado. Dadka tacsusbka qaba waxay ku adkaystaan in kooxdooda ama fikirkoodu uu ka sarreeyo dadka kale, halka kooxaha kale loo arko kuwo liita ama aan la aqbali karin, taasoo burburinaysa wadajirka iyo horumarka bulsho.

Tacasubku waa cudur bulsho oo carqaladeeya xiriirka dadka iyo horumarka bulshada. Waxa uu keenaa in fursadaha waxbarashada, shaqooyinka, iyo horumarka lagu saleeyo koox gaar ah, taasoo sii xoojinaysa faqriga, cadaalad-darrada, dib u dhaca iyo nacaybka. Taasina waxay bulshada ka dhigtaa mid aan isku duubanayn, isla markaana adkeeyneeysa in la helo nabad iyo isfahan. Waxa uu dhaawacaa aqlaaqda qofka. 

Maxay falsafadu ka tiri tacasubka?

Falsafadu waxay tacasubka u aragtaa fikir xaddidan oo xun oo ka hortaga caddaaladda, garashada, iyo horumarka bulshada. Falsafaddu waxay ku boorisaa in qofku qiimeeyo dadka kale iyadoo lagu salaynayo qiimeeynta dabeecad, aqoon, waaya aragnimo iyo karti, halkii laga eegi lahaa qabiil, asal, ama koox. Tacasubku waxaa lagu tilmaamaa inuu yahay caqabad weyn oo ka hortagta wadajirka iyo horumarka bulshada. Waana mid kamida musiibooyinka ka jira dalkeena.

Quraanku muxuu ka yiri tacasubka?

Quraanka Kariimka ah wuxuu si cad u cambaareeyay tacasubka, isagoo dadka ku boorinaya sinnaan, caddaalad, iyo walaaltinimo. Allaah wuxuu yiri:

﴿يَٰٓأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍۢ وَأُنثَىٰ وَجَعَلۡنَٰكُمْ شُعُوبًۭا وَقَبَآئِلَ لِتَعَارَفُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّ أَكْرَمَكُمْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَتْقَىٰكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌۭ﴾ 

“Dadkaow, runtii waxaan idiin abuuray idin lab iyo dhedig ah, waxaanan idin ka dhigay ummado iyo qabiilo si aad isu garataan. Runtii kuwii idinka ugu sharafka badnaa Eebbe hortiisa waa kuwii ugu takwa furaha badnaa. Runtii Eebbe waa og, waa khabiir.”  

Quraanku wuxuu sidoo kale xusuusinayaa in tacasubku uu keeno nacayb iyo kala fogeyn, halka caddaaladdu ay keento nabad iyo wadajir.

Sidee looga hortagi karaa tacasubka?

Wacyigelin iyo waxbarasho: Dadka oo la baro qiimaha caddaaladda, sinnaan, iyo wadajirka.

Cadaalad iyo sinaan: Fursadaha waxbarashada, shaqooyinka, iyo adeegyada bulshada in qof walba loo simo. Aqoontiisa iyo waaya aragnimadiisa lagu saleeyo.

Qofka in aqoonta iyo aqlaaqda lagu qaato, si dhaqaalahu u kobco, hadaad qof liita qabiil ku qaadato adigana wuu kula harayaa.

Wadamo badan oo Afrika waxay ku qasbanaadeen inay luqadda gumeysiga ku beddelaan afkooda, taasoo keentay in luqadaha hooyo lumiyaan awooddooda. Laakiin Soomaaliya waxay noqotay dalka kaliya ee Afrika oo aan lumin luqaddeeda hooyo.

Maxaa keenay in Soomaaliya ay u adkaysto?
✅ Halgan qaranimo: Bulshada Soomaaliyeed waxay si wadajir ah u difaacay afkooda iyo dhaqankooda. Qabiil kasta iyo gobol kasta ayaa ka qeyb qaatay ilaalinta afka. Tusaale: Intii lagu jiray gumeysiga Talyaaniga iyo Ingiriiska, ururo iyo saxaafad ayaa ka shaqeeyay wacyigelinta iyo baridda afka Soomaaliga.

✅ Qoraalka rasmiga ah ee Af-Soomaaliga (1972): Latin script-ka ayaa fududeeyay in afka la qoro, la barto, lana isticmaalo maalin kasta.
Tusaale: Xitaa dadka miyiga ku nool waxay si fudud looga sahlay waliba miiga looga geeyey macalimiin bara qoraalka afka Somalia, waxayna qoraalka u isticmaali karaan waxbarashada iyo qoraalada maalinlaha ah.

✅ Waxaa qasab laga dhiga in manhajka lagu qoro afka somalia waliba goobaha waxbarashada laga dhiga afka somalia 

✅ Dhaqan iyo hidde dhaqan xooggan: Af-Soomaaligu wuxuu ku dhex jiraa gabayada, sheekooyinka, iyo suugaanta, taasoo kor u qaadaysa ilaalinta iyo gudbinta afka jiilba jiil.
Tusaale: Gabayada hal-abuurka Soomaaliyeed sida kuwa Sayid Maxamed Cabdulle Xasan ayaa afka Soomaaliga xoojiyay oo jiilal badan u gudbiyay.

Maxaa sababay in wadamada kale ay luqadooda lumiyaan?
❌ Gumeysigii ayaa waxbarashada, maamulka, iyo warbaahinta ku dhisay luqad kale.
❌ Jiilba jiil ayaa luqadihii hooyo ka fogaan jiray.
❌ Qoraal la’aan iyo taageero la’aan luqadaha hooyo ayaa jirtay.

In 1991, a dictator fell, and with him Somalia misplaced its law and order. For fifteen years Warlords partitioned Mogadishu like landlords dividing stolen property. Each commanded a militia to terrify a neighborhood. They collected “taxes", collected sons, collected daughters and took Life 

The Americans came briefly,loudly and left abruptly in 1993 with eighteen soldiers dead, the American bodies were  dragged through Mogadishu’s dust. For the next decade, Americans looked away. And yet, in the vacuum, Mogadishu began to stitch together fragments of order. Clan elders and Islamic scholars convened informal Sharia courts. Disputes were arbitrated, Markets reopened. It was not tidy. But after fifteen years under the muzzle of a rifle, that was  peace.

In 2002, George W. Bush occupied the White House. Kenya’s mobile phone revolution was just learning to ring.And in one important event a young Illinois politician named Barack addressed his relatives in his father’s homeland.

By 2006, the scattered Sharia courts unified into a coalition and did what diplomats had failed to do. They confronted the warlords directly and they won. For the first time in fifteen years, Mogadishu exhaled. The airport reopened. Ships docked at the seaport. Residents walked the streets after sunset.

Within the ICU’s broad coalition, on its outermost fringe, lingered a smaller, harder faction...Al-Shabaab“The Youth.” A few hundred fighters at most. Some had trained in Afghanistan. They were marginal and contained. American intelligence assessments at the time suggested that in a nation of millions, perhaps ten or twelve individuals had meaningful ties to Al-Qaeda. After September 11, Washington categorized Somalia as a potential terrorist haven. So the CIA made its choice not to engage the Islamic Courts and not attempt to isolate the radicals or strengthen the moderates. Instead, American operatives flew into private airstrips controlled by the very warlords the ICU had just expelled. Briefcases were opened and money changed hands. The target was suspects linked to the 1998 embassy bombings. These CIA-funded strongmen formalized their partnership under a name so polished "Alliance for the Restoration of Peace and Counter-Terrorism".. The men who had extorted their shops, abducted their sons, and brutalized their daughters were now publicly sponsored by the world’s sole superpower.

In May and June 2006, Mogadishu became a battleground once more. The CIA-backed warlords fought the Islamic Courts in  street battles and they lost badly. The ICU militias including the previously marginal Al-Shabaab faction routed them. The warlords fled the capital in humiliation. And the Union of Islamic Courts controlled most of southern Somalia.
For a brief, delicate moment, Somalia appeared to be standing on its own feet. History, however, was just testing them.

Across the border, Ethiopia watched with old memories and fresh anxiety. Somalia was not just a neighbor. It was a historic rival. The Ogaden Somali-inhabited Ethiopian-controlled. Some ICU leaders, intoxicated by sudden victory, had spoken loudly about reclaiming “lost” Somali lands.

In Addis Ababa, those words sounded like threat. In Washington, they sounded like something else entirely. On Christmas Eve 2006, while much of the world prepared for midnight mass about forty thousand Ethiopian troops crossed into Somalia. They brought tanks,  Heavy artillery, Helicopter and Fighter jets that turned the sky warm.

American Special Operations forces and CIA officers were on the ground, advising Ethiopian commanders. American aircraft and drones provided surveillance and targeting intelligence. American dollars ensured Ethiopian fuel tanks never ran dry.
The war itself was brief. By the end of December, Mogadishu had fallen. ICU fighters dissolved into the population, fled south, or boarded flights into exile. What had taken sixteen years to build collapsed in days.

By New Year’s Day 2007, Ethiopia had installed a fragile, UN-backed Transitional Federal Government in the capital. A former warlord aligned with the new order declared triumphantly:

“The warlord era in Somalia is now over.”

Ethiopians and Somalis carried centuries of grievances. They had fought wars. Ethiopia’s control of the Ogaden home to millions of ethnic Somalis who had endured decades of repression was memory carved into bone.

So when Ethiopian troops began patrolling Mogadishu’s streets, something deeper than politics fractured. It did not matter that the warlords had been predators. What mattered now was that a foreign army the historic enemy occupied the capital.

Protesters flooded the streets. Even members of the newly installed parliament denounced the occupation. National humiliation has a way of clarifying loyalties. And in that fury, Al-Shabaab found oxygen. Before the invasion, they had been a marginal faction, numerically small, ideologically rigid, politically contained.
After the invasion,  They rebranded themselves, their message traveled quickly through mosques.

" We are the defenders of Somalia. We fight the foreign invaders. We are the shield between you and occupation"....it resonated. Foreign fighters from Kenya, Yemen, Pakistan arrived, drawn by the language of jihad. Al-Qaeda’s senior leadership released videos urging Muslims worldwide to support the Somali mujahideen fighting the “Crusader Ethiopians” and their American backers.  

By mid-2007, Mogadishu was at war again. Al-Shabaab adopted tactics refined elsewhere. Suicide bombings, Roadside explosives and  targeted assassinations of government officials. In March 2007, Somalia experienced its first suicide bombing. Ethiopian forces responded with overwhelming force. Artillery pounded entire neighborhoods suspected of sheltering insurgents. Civilians paid the invoice.

Between 2007 and 2008, more than sixteen thousand Somali civilians were killed. Over one million were displaced from their homes most of them spilling across the border into Kenya, carrying grief in plastic bags. Al-Shabaab’s propaganda machine worked methodically. Videos of dead civilians circulated widely. The narrative sharpened..." foreign infidels are massacring Muslims. Resistance as duty and martyrdom as answer."

In January 2009, Ethiopia withdrew. It was Exhausted, bloodied  and defeated all apart from their official communication. They had conquered Mogadishu in days and lost the country in two grinding years. Thousands of Ethiopian soldiers were dead. The occupation had become politically poisonous at home. 

When they pulled out, they Left a fractured landscape, a million refugees, and a population trained to appreciate noise and Al-Shabaab. They were now stronger,  Harder and More deeply rooted than before the first Ethiopian tank crossed the border.

The invasion meant to crush Islamist militancy had engineered Al-Qaeda’s most durable African franchise. From there, Al-Shabaab expanded across nearly all of south-central Somalia. They governed with public executions of spies and floggings for moral infractions. Music was silenced. 

By now the movement fielded between five and eight thousand fighters. Foreign volunteers arrived from Minnesota,London, Lamu, Nairobi’s estates and Europe’s suburbs. Their media wing released recruitment videos in English, Swahili, Arabic. They collected millions through taxation and extortion. They ran courts. They offered rough justice. They tapped into piracy networks along the Indian Ocean. 

And in there in Nairobi, a voice crossed the airwaves... Kenyan intelligence intercepted a communication. The speaker was a senior Al-Shabaab operative. He wanted a security assessment of Nairobi.
He wanted details about Westlands, its size, its population density, its security posture. He wanted to know what it would take to strike there.

Officers listened, transcribed, filed and did nothing.It was the first warning. It would not be the last. For nine years, the seeds lay beneath the soil.

Kenya watched Somalia fracture and absorbed the human overflow. Refugee camps expanded under a merciless northern sun. Kenyan troops joined regional missions. In 2010, bombs exploded in Kampala during the World Cup final, killing seventy-four football fans. The attackers had come from Somalia.

Kenya tightened borders, increased surveillance took note. But in the refugee settlements scattered across the arid north, other currents moved quietly. Kakuma Refugee Camp was dusty, sprawling and crowded. It housed tens of thousands who had fled Somalia’s collapse. Among them were two boys who played football on hard-packed earth.

Mohamed Abdinur Said and Ahmed Hassan Abukar. Teenagers lean quickly. Eyes older than their years. They did not know that one day they would die together in a Nairobi shopping mall. That their bodies would be so ravaged investigators would rely on DNA for identification. That their names would be recited in news bulletins as architects of one of Kenya’s deadliest terror attacks.

Well.October 2011, President Mwai Kibaki addressed the nation. Kenyan troops were moving into Somalia. Operation Linda Nchi had begun. The Kenya Defence Forces would pursue Al-Shabaab militants for kidnappings along the coast, attacks that had begun strangling the tourism industry.

Al-Shabaab framed it as invasion.In January 2012, a video circulated. Abu Zinnirah, Amir of Al-Hijra Al-Shabaab’s Kenyan affiliate spoke calmly from an undisclosed location in Somalia. He quoted the Qur’an  “But if they seek your help in religion, it is your duty to help them.”

Then he fixed his eyes on the camera.

“Kenya,” he said , “is a war zone.”

Three months later, pamphlets and digital files began appearing in Eastleigh’s alleyways, in Majengo’s madrassas, on the phones of young men negotiating with identity. The publication was titled Gaidi Mtaani “Terrorist in the Street.” Written in Kiswahili. Accessible and local.

The lead article was called “Levelling the Scales.” Its author, writing as Abu Usama, urged readers to imagine ....

“Look at how vulnerable Kenya is. We have tourists, shopping malls, bars. Just imagine how we can compromise economy, kill one mzungu and they all run away.”

Abu Usama was Ahmad Iman Ali an engineering graduate of Jomo Kenyatta University of Agriculture and Technology. Kamba and Meru by heritage. Radical by conviction. Founder of Al-Hijra in Majengo. Recruiter of Kenyan youth for training in Somalia and for martyrdom.

That same January,  investigators maintained sources deep inside Al-Shabaab’s command structure confirmed what should have already been clear that  senior Al-Shabaab commanders were in regular contact with associates in Nairobi. They were discussing potential plots and potential targets.

March 30, 2012. Around 8:00 p.m.
A known Al-Shabaab commander named Ibrahim placed a call from Somalia to Nairobi.
He requested a security assessment of the city.
Four days later, he called again.This time, he was precise...Westlands....Its size....Its population....Its security.

waxa la yaab leh in Soomaaliya, oo leh kheyraad dabiici ah oo fara badan, ay weli la daalaa dhaceyso dhibaatooyin iyo saboolnimo. Soomaaliya waxay leedahay kheyraad badan oo aan la isticmaalin sida saliid, gaas, uranium, kalluun, iyo dhul beereed wax soo saar leh. Laakiin dhowr arrimood oo isku xiran ayaa hor istaagay in kheyraadkan uu faa’iido u yeesho shacabka.

1. Dhibaatada Dagaalka Sokeeye iyo Xasillooni La’aanta Siyaasadeed

Tan iyo burburkii dowladdii Siyaad Barre 1991, Soomaaliya waxay la kulantay dagaallo iyo qalalaase. Dumistii dowladda dhexe waxay horseeday dagaallo qabiil iyo mid kooxeed, taasoo keentay in la waayo maamul adag oo awood u leh inuu maareeyo dhaqaalaha dalka.

2. Dagaal Oogayaal iyo Xukunka Maleeshiyaadka

Sagaashamaadkii iyo bilowgii 2000-meeyadii, dagaal oogayaal ayaa kala qabsaday gobollada dalka, iyagoo Soomaaliya ka dhigay goob dagaal. Halkii ay horumarin lahaayeen dalka, kooxahani waxay kheyraadka u adeegsan jireen dano shaqsi ah. Awoodaha shisheeye ayaa sidoo kale gacan ka geystay sii hurinta colaadaha iyagoo taageeraya kooxo kala duwan.

3. Gumeysiga Itoobiya iyo Dano Shisheeye

Itoobiya mar walba waxay ka baqday Soomaaliya oo xoog leh. 2006, Itoobiya waxay qabsatay Soomaaliya iyada oo taageero ka heleysa Maraykanka, si ay ula dagaalanto Midowgii Maxaakiimta Islaamiga (ICU). Balse, dad badan oo Soomaaliyeed waxay arkeen faragelintii Itoobiya sida gumeysi cusub, taasoo dhalisay kacdoon xoog leh, lagana dhaxlay kooxo sida Al-Shabaab.

4. Faafitaanka Wahhabiyada iyo Kooxo Xagjir ah

Kahor dagaalkii sokeeye, Soomaaliya waxay ahayd bulsho leh diin dhexdhexaad ah. Balse, dagaallada iyo faragelinta shisheeye kadib, fikrado xagjir ah ayaa fursad ka helay fowdada. Lacago ka yimid dalalka Khaliijka ayaa beddelay dhaqankii suubanaa ee Soomaalida. Kooxo sida Al-Shabaab waxay ka faa’iidaysteen saboolnimada iyo amni-darrada si ay u helaan dagaalyahano, taasoo sii xumeysay xasillooni la’aanta dalka.

5. Boobka Kheyraadka Soomaaliya iyo Saameynta Shisheeye

Dowlado iyo shirkado ajnabi ah ayaa ka faa’iidaysta fawdada Soomaaliya. Waxaa dalka si sharci darro ah uga kalluumaysta maraakiib shisheeye, waxaa la daadiyaa qashinka sunta ah, waxaana la bililiqaystaa kheyraadka dabiiciga ah. Awoodaha caalamiga ah qaarkood waxay doorbidaan Soomaaliya oo daciif ah, si ay si sahlan uga faa’iidaystaan.

6. Dowlad La’aan iyo Burburka Kaabayaasha Dhaqaalaha

Sanado dagaal ah ayaa burburiyay kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha sida jidadka, iskuullada, iyo isbitaallada. Dowlad dhexe oo adag la’aanteed, aad bay u adag tahay in dib loo dhiso hay’adaha muhiimka u ah horumarka.

7. Musuqmaasuq iyo Qabyaalad

Xitaa meelaha nabadda leh, musuqmaasuqa iyo eexda qabiilka ayaa hor istaagay horumarka. Halkii diiradda la saari lahaa horumarinta qaranka, siyaasiyiinta badankooda waxay u shaqeeyaan qabiilkooda ama dano gaar ah.

Ma jirta Rajo?

Haa. Inkastoo dhibaatooyin jiraan Soomaalidu waa dad adkeysan leh. Meelo badan sida Somaliland iyo Puntland waxay heleen xasillooni. Soomaalida qurbaha ku nool ayaa sidoo kale door muhiim ah ka ciyaarta dhaqaalaha, iyagoo diraya lacag si ay ehelkooda uga taageeraan. Dadaallo lagu dhisayo dowladnimo iyo maalgashi shisheeye ayaa socda, balse waxay u baahan yihiin aragti dheer oo ka madax bannaan faragelin shisheeye.

Haddii Soomaaliya rabto inay ka faa’iidaysato kheyraadkeeda oo ay nolosha dadkeeda hagaajiso, waa in ay hesho hogaamin adag, midnimo qaran, iyo difaac dhab ah oo ay ka hesho kheyraadkeeda si aan looga faa’iidaysan. Xasillooni iyo isku filnaansho ayaa muhiim ah

Abaarta ba’an ee ka jirta dalkeena hooyo ee Soomaaliya maanta ma aha oo keliya dhibaato dabiici ah, balse waa xaalad bani’aadamnimo oo si qoto dheer u taabanaysa nolosha, dhaqaalaha, iyo mustaqbalka bulshada. Roobabkii oo yaraaday, biyo la’aan baahsan, iyo cunto yari ayaa sababay in kumannaan qoys ay waayaan noloshoodii caadiga ahayd. Dad badan ayaa ku qasbanaaday inay ka barakacaan deegaanadoodii, halka xoolihii ay ku tiirsanaayeen dadku ay si xawli ah u dabar go’ayaan.

Xaaladdan adag waxay khatar weyn ku tahay badbaadada carruurta, haweenka, waayeelka, iyo dadka nugul. Nafaqo darradu waxay sii kordhinaysaa cudurrada, saboolnimada, iyo burburka nololeed ee bulshada. Haddii aan si wadajir ah loo qaadin tallaabooyin degdeg ah, waxaa jirta khatar ah in dhibaatadu isu beddesho macluul baahsan oo saamayn doonta jiilal badan.

Doorka Dowladda iyo Hoggaanka Dalka
Dowladdu waa tiirka ugu weyn ee ilaalinta nolosha shacabka. Waxaa lama huraan ah in la qaado tallaabooyin degdeg ah oo ay ka mid yihiin

👉🏿In la kordhiyo gurmadka bani’aadamnimo ee degdegga ah, gaar ahaan bixinta biyo, raashin, iyo adeegyo caafimaad.

👉🏿In la dhiso ceelal, barkado, iyo nidaamyo keyd biyo si looga hortago biyo yari soo noqnoqda.

👉🏿In la xoojiyo qorshayaasha ka hortagga abaaraha iyo ilaalinta deegaanka.

👉🏿 In la mideeyo dadaallada dowladda, hay’adaha samafalka, iyo bulshada si loo gaaro dadka ugu nugul.

Badbaadinta shacabka waa waajib qaran oo mudnaan gaar ah leh, waana tallaabo dhisaysa kalsoonida iyo midnimada bulshada.

Mas’uuliyadda Ganacsatada iyo Hay’adaha Dhaqaalaha
Ganacsatadu waxay door muhiim ah ku leeyihiin taageeridda bulshada. Xilliyada dhibaatada, ganacsigu ma aha oo keliya faa’iido raadis, balse waa masuuliyad bulsho 

👉 ka qayb qaadashada gurmadka deg deg ah ee saamaynta abaarta iyo khataraha xaaladaha adag.

👉 Ka qeyb qaadashada bixinta raashin, biyo, iyo adeegyo muhiim ah.

👉 Taageeridda qoysaska tabaaleysan iyo dadka barakacay iyo danyarta guud.

👉 Maalgelinta mashaariic horumarineed oo yareeya ku tiirsanaanta roobka.

👉Muujinta isku duubni iyo garab istaag bulsho, taas oo xoojinaysa kalsoonida iyo wada noolaanshaha.

Hantida dhabta ah waxay qiimo leedahay marka lagu badbaadiyo naf iyo nolol.

Doorka Qurba-joogta Soomaaliyeed
Qurba-joogtu waxay mar walba laf dhabarta u ahayd gurmadka shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Xaaladdan adag waxay u baahan tahay in kaalintaas la sii xoojiyo

👉🏿 Kordhinta kaalmooyinka samafal iyo taageerada qoysaska dhibban.
 
👉🏿Mideynta dadaallada gurmadka si ay u gaaraan dadka ugu nugul.

👉🏿 Taageeridda mashaariic waara sida ceelasha biyaha, horumarinta beeraha, iyo waxbarashada.

👉🏿 Ka shaqeynta wacyigelinta iyo isku xirka hay’adaha gargaarka caalamiga ah.
Taageerada qurba-joogtu waa tiir muhiim ah oo badbaadin kara nolosha kumannaan qof.

Waajibaadka Dadka Hantida Leh iyo Bulshada Guud
Hantidu waa imtixaan iyo masuuliyad. Waxaa jira dad badan oo maanta la daalaa dhacaya gaajo, harraad, iyo nolol adag. Samafalka iyo gacan qabashada dadka tabaaleysan waa waajib diini ah iyo mid bani’aadamnimo

👉 Ka qeyb qaadashada sadaqooyinka, zakada, iyo kaalmooyinka samafalka.
👉 Garab istaagga qoysaska nugul iyo dadka barakacay.
👉 Dhiirrigelinta isku duubni iyo wadajir bulsho.
👉 Ka shaqeynta ilaalinta deegaanka iyo khayraadka dabiiciga ah.
Bulsho is garab istaagta ayaa awood u leh inay ka gudubto dhibaato kasta.

Qorshaha Mustaqbalka iyo Ka Hortagga Abaarta Si looga hortago in dhibaatooyinkan ay noqdaan kuwo soo noqnoqda, waxaa muhiim ah in la hirgeliyo qorshayaal waara:

👉🏿 Horumarinta beeraha u adkeysan kara abaaraha.

👉🏿 Adeegsiga farsamooyin casri ah oo lagu keydiyo biyaha roobka.

👉🏿 Wacyigelin bulshada lagu barayo ilaalinta deegaanka.

👉🏿 Maalgelinta cilmi-baaris iyo qorshayaal horumarineed oo ku saabsan la qabsiga isbeddelka cimilada.

Ka hortagga abaartu waa maalgashi mustaqbal oo badbaadin kara jiilasha soo socda.

Gunaanad xaaladda abaarta ka jirta Soomaaliya waa digniin u baahan feejignaan, naxariis, iyo ficil degdeg ah. Dowladda, ganacsatada, qurba-joogta, dadka hantida leh, iyo bulshada guud ahaan waa inay si mideysan uga shaqeeyaan badbaadinta nolosha dadka iyo duunyada. Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya waa dal ku dhisan taariikh, halgan iyo rajo wadajir ah. Midnimada qaranku ma aha eray lagu qurxiyo khudbadaha, balse waa tiirka ugu weyn ee dowladnimo waarta. Sidaas awgeed, waxaa lagama maarmaan ah in midnimada laga dhigo dhaqan, mas’uuliyad la wada qaado, iyo mabda’ hagaya dhammaan falalka siyaasadeed iyo kuwa bulsho.

Jacaylka dalka laguma cabbiro hadal iyo hal-ku-dheg keliya; waxa lagu muujiyaa habdhaqanka maalinlaha ah ee siyaasadda, sida loo maareeyo khilaafaadka, iyo sida muwaadiniintu isu ixtiraamaan iyaga oo ka tirsan Jamhuuriyad mideysan. Ixtiraamka qaranku wuxuu ka bilaabmaa ixtiraamka hay’adihiisa dastuuriga ah, xataa marka go’aamadoodu aysan la jaanqaadin danaha qof ama koox gaar ah. Danaha qaranku waa inay mar walba ka sarreeyaan dano gobol, qabiil, ama shakhsiyadeed.

Waxaa la joogaa waqtigii laga gudbi lahaa siyaasad ku dhisan kala-qaybin iyo kicin dareenno bulsho. Taariikhdeenna ayaa si cad u muujisay qiimaha kala-daadashada, amni-darro soo noqnoqota, barakac, jiilal fursado ka luntay, iyo horumar hakaday. Ma jirto waddaniyad dhab ah oo la sheegan karo iyadoo la hurinayo hadallo aan laga fiirsan, falal kicinaya colaad, ama diidmo tanaasul oo dhaawacaysa dowladnimada lafteeda.

Midnimada qaranku waxay u baahan tahay biseyl siyaasadeed, dulqaad iyo wada-hadal ku saleysan sharci iyo dastuur. আজ প্রায় এক সপ্তাহ হলো মেঘার এইস.এস.সি এক্সাম শেষ হয়েছে। মোটামুটি ভালোই এক্সাম দিয়েছে। অবশ্য এতে আদ্রিয়ান এর পরিশ্রম ছিলো প্রচুর। খুনসুটি সংসারে অনেক গুলো মাস চোখের পলকেই কেটে গেলো। আজ আদ্রিয়ান এর জন্মদিন। সেই উপলক্ষে মেঘা আদ্রিয়ান এর পছন্দের রেড ভেলভেট কেক তৈরি করছে তাও নিজ হাতে। সাথে দাদিমাও আছে হেল্প করার জন্য। কিন্তু মেঘা কোনো মতেই দাদিমা কে হেল্প করতে দিচ্ছে না। সে নাকি একাই সব করবে। কেক যখন তৈরি হলো তখন তা ডিপে রেখে রান্নার কাজে মনোযোগী হলো। মেঘা  মাছের স্টু অর্ধ রান্নার মাঝে যখন কড়াই এর ঢাকনা খুললো সাথে সাথে মাছের ঘ্রাণ টা তার নাসিকা রন্দ্রে গিয়ে পেট গুলিয়ে বমি চলে আসলো। সাথে সাথে মুখে হাত দিয়ে বেসিনে গিয়ে বমি করে দিলো। কিছুক্ষন বমি করে মুখ মুছে পিছনে ফিরে দেখল কেউ আছে কিনা। পুরো কিচেন খালি থাকায় সস্থির নিশ্বাস ফেললো। দাদিমা এতোক্ষণ এখানে থেকে হাপিয়ে উঠে ছিলো। তাই নিজের ঘরে গিয়ে আপাতত রেস্ট নিচ্ছে। মেঘা তাড়াতাড়ি মাছের স্টু তৈরি করলো টিস্যু নাকের মধ্যে ঢুকিয়েই। এরপর ঘড়ির মধ্যে দেখলো আদ্রিয়ান এর আসতে তেমন সময় আর বাকি নেই। তাই তাড়াতাড়ি কাজ শেষ করে গোসল করতে রুমে গেলো। শরীর ঘামে একদম নাজেহাল অবস্থা। আজ মেঘা আদ্রিয়ান এর মন মতো সাজবে। যা দেখে আদ্রিয়ান হয়তো ভেবেই লজ্জায় মুখ রক্তিম হয়ে উঠলো। হঠাৎ করে কিছু মনে পড়াতে তাড়াতাড়ি ওয়াশ রুম থেকে বের হয়ে ফোন নিয়ে আদ্রিয়ান কে একটা মেসেজ দিলো। এরপর খুশি খুশিই আবার ওয়াশরুমে ঢুকলো। সময় মতো সব কিছু হলেই হলো। কিছুদিন আগেই আদ্রিয়ান মেঘা কে ফোন কিনে দেই। আর এই ফোন পেয়ে মেঘা প্রচন্ড খুশি হয়। কারণ তার আগের ফোন টা আদ্রিয়ান তাকে ফেরত তো দেই নি। সাথে কোনো ফোন ব্যাবহারও করতে দেইনি। যার পরপ্রেক্ষিতে নতুন ফোন পেয়ে সে ভীষণ খুশি।

 আদ্রিয়ান মাত্রই বাড়ির সামনে এসেছে। ড্রাইভার যখন আদ্রিয়ান কে ডেকে বললো যে তারা পৌঁছে গেছে। তখন আদ্রিয়ান ফোন থেকে চোখ সরিয়ে বাইরে তাকিয়ে দেখলো তারা চলে এসেছে। এরপর ফোনের দিকে তাকিয়ে দেখলো মেঘার একটি ছবি যেটা সে এতোক্ষণ ধরে দেখছিল। মেঘার মেসেজ সে কিছুক্ষন আগেই দেখে। সেখানে আদ্রিয়ান কে জরুরি ভাবে ডাকা হয়েছে। ইম্পর্ট্যান্ট একটা মিটিং ছিলো যেটা ক্যান্সেল করে তাড়াতাড়ি চলে এসেছে। গাড়ির দরজা একজন গার্ড এসে খুলে দেই। আদ্রিয়ান বের হয়ে তাড়াতাড়ি বাড়ির ভেতরে ঢুকে। এখন রাতের প্রায় নয়টা। বাড়িতে ঢুকে দেখে বাড়িটা কেমন নিরব হয়ে আছে। সে অন্য দিকে না তাকিয়ে সোজা নিজের রুমে চলে গেল। এরপর যখন রুমে ঢুকলো তখন দেখল রুম পুরোটা খালি। চারপাশে খুঁজেও যখন মেঘার কোনো হদিস পেলো না তখন কপাল কুচকালো। হঠাৎ করে ড্রেসিং টেবিলের মিররের মধ্যে কিছু একটা লাগানো দেখল। সামনে গিয়ে পেপার টা নিয়ে দেখলো মেঘার হাতের কিছু লেখা

আদ্রিয়ান মেঘার এরূপ লেখা দেখে মুচকি হাসলো। দিন দিন মেঘা আদ্রিয়ান কে যেভাবে আসক্ত করছে। এতে মনে হয় আদ্রিয়ান একদিন মেঘার মধ্যেই বিলীন হয়ে যাবে। মেয়েটা দিন দিন তার প্রতি এমন ভাবেই আসক্ত হচ্ছে যে আদ্রিয়ান এতে খুশি হওয়ার বদলে প্রচন্ড অবাক হচ্ছে। মেয়েটা মনে হয় আদ্রিয়ানের অঙ্গে অঙ্গে একদম মিশে বিলীন হয়ে গেছে। আর এর থেকে ছাড়া পাওয়া প্রচুর কঠিন। সে ছাড়া পেতেও চাইনা। মিশে থাকতে চাই আজীবন। এরপর পত্রটি নিজের কোটের পকেটে রেখে ওয়াসরুমে গেলো গোসল করে তৈরি হতে।

বার মিনিটের মধ্যে তাড়াতাড়ি তৈরি হয়ে নিলো। এরপর ছাদে যাওয়ার উদ্দেশ্য বের হলো। সিড়িতে খুব সুন্দর করে দিয়া বাতি জ্বালানো। প্রত্যেক দিয়ার চারিপাশে গোলাপের পাপড়ি ছড়ানো। সেসব দিয়া  থেকে খুব সুন্দর একটা সুগন্ধ ভেসে বেড়াচ্ছে চারিপাশে। ওইসব দেখতে দেখতেই আদ্রিয়ান ছাদে পৌঁছে গেলো। ছাদে পৌঁছাতেই দেখলো ছাদ টা কালো সাদা সংমিশ্রণে সাজানো। এরপর সামনে এগিয়ে দেখলো ছাদে তেমন কেউ নেই। হঠাৎ করে কিছুর আওয়াজ হলো সাইডে তাকিয়ে দেখলো একটি বড় পর্দা যাতে দৃশ্যমান হচ্ছে আদ্রিয়ান এর কিছু ছবি। যখন ছবি গুলো দৃশ্যমান হচ্ছিলো তখন স্লো মোশনে মিউজিক অন করা হলো। সাথে মাইক নিয়ে কেউ পর্দার পিছনে  দাড়ালো।

মেঘার গান এতোক্ষণ মুগ্ধ হয়ে আদ্রিয়ান শুনছিলো। আর গানের তালে তালে পর্দায় আদ্রিয়ান এর পরিবার আর মেঘার সাথে তোলা অনেক ছবি প্রকাশ পেয়েছে। সাথে ছিলো কিছু সুন্দর সুন্দর মোমেন্ট এর ছবি। এরপর মেঘা গান শেষ করে আদ্রিয়ান এর কাছাকাছি আসলো। মেঘা আজ আদ্রিয়ান এর সাথে মিলিয়ে কালো ঝরঝেটের শাড়ি পড়েছে। সাথে চুল গুলো সুন্দর করে খোঁপা করা। আর হালকা মুখে প্রসাধনী দিয়ে সাজ। এতেই যেনো খুবই সুন্দর লাগছে তাকে। আদ্রিয়ানো আজ মেঘার সাথে মিলিয়ে পাঞ্জাবি পড়েছে। এসব মেঘাই পছন্দ করে আনিয়েছে। মেঘা আদ্রিয়ান এর দিকে মুগ্ধ দৃষ্টিতে তাকিয়ে আদ্রিয়ান কে একটু নিচু হতে বললো। আদ্রিয়ানো মেঘার কথা মতো নিচু হলে মেঘা আদ্রিয়ানের কানে স্লো ভয়েসে

"শুভ জন্মদিন আমার প্রিয় প্রেমিক পুরুষ"

মেঘার এরূপ উইশে আদ্রিয়ান এর মন হঠাৎ করেই পুলকিত হলো। মেঘা আদ্রিয়ান এর মাথার দুই পাশে হাত দিয়ে মেঘার দিকে একটু নিচু করলো। এরপর একটু উপর হয়ে আদ্রিয়ানের কপালে উষ্ণ ঠোঁটের স্নিগ্ধ পরশ দিলো। আদ্রিয়ান চোখ বন্ধ করে প্রেয়সীর পরশ উপভোগ করলো। এরপর আদ্রিয়ান যখন চোখ খুলে তখন দেখে মেঘা সামনে দাড়িয়ে মুচকি হেসে আকাশে তাকাতে বলছে। আদ্রিয়ান যখন আকাশের দিকে তাকালো তখন অনেক বাজি আকাশে মনোরোম ভাবে ঝলকাতে লাগলো। আর যখন সেগুলো এক সাথে মিলিত হলো তখন সেখানে কিছু ইংলিশ ওয়ার্ড দৃশ্যমান হলো। যখন সব গুলো ওয়ার্ড স্পষ্ট হলো তখন সেখানে "হ্যাপি বার্থডে ডিয়ার হাসব্যান্ড" লিখা গুলো দৃশ্যমান হলো। আদ্রিয়ান অবাক নয়নে সব কিছু দেখছে। এরপর হঠাৎ করেই ছাদে বাজি ফোটানোর মতো আওয়াজ হলো। আওয়াজ অনুসরণ করতে গেলে দেখতে পেলো সবাই একসাথে মিলিত হয়ে আদ্রিয়ান কে বার্থডে উইশ করছে। এরপর একে একে সবার সাথে মিলিত হয়ে মেঘার বানানো কেক কাটলো আদ্রিয়ান। বাবা মা মারা যাওয়ার পর থেকে আদ্রিয়ান কখনও নিজের জন্মদিন সেলিব্রেট করেনি। যদি বাড়ির কেউ সেলিব্রেট করতে চাইতো তখন আদ্রিয়ান এক ধমক দিয়ে সবাই কে বারণ করে দিতো। এরপর থেকে আর কখনো কেউ সাহস করেনি জন্মদিনের আয়োজন করার।

আর এইসব কিছু মেঘা শুনেছে দাদীমার থেকে। তাইতো সে জিদ ধরেছিলো যে এইবার আদ্রিয়ান এর জন্মদিন সে নিজে আয়োজন করবে। বকা দিলে দিবে তাতে কি। এসব এখন তার জন্য কিছুই না। এই কয়েক মাসে বকার উপরই ছিলো। কিন্তু তবুও আদ্রিয়ান কে এখনও যতেষ্ট ভয় পাই। তবে আজ যদি কিছু বলেও ভয় পাবে না সে। পেলেও ভিতরে ভিতরে রাখবে বাইরে প্রকাশ করবেই না। কিন্তু সবাই কে অবাক করে দিয়ে আদ্রিয়ান সবার সাথে সাভাবিক ভাবে সেলিব্রেশন করছে। তার মানে মেঘার কাজে রাগ করেনি। এসব ভাবছিলো আর সবার জন্য কোল্ড ড্রিঙ্কস সাজাচ্ছিলো। আদ্রিয়ান আপাততো ছাদের কর্নারে গিয়ে নিশির হাসব্যান্ড এর সাথে কথা বলছে। কিন্তু তার চোখ সব সময় মেঘার দিকেই ফলো করছে। মেঘার দিকে তাকিয়ে দেখলো মেঘার চোখ মুখ কেমন ক্লান্ত ক্লান্ত লাগছে। তাই আদ্রিয়ান যখন মেঘার কাছে যেতে নিবে তখন তার একটা কল আসে। কল টা গুরত্বপূর্ণ দেখে মেঘার দিকে না গিয়ে অন্য দিকে গিয়ে কথা বলতে লাগলো।  

এইদিকে মেঘা আদ্রিয়ান কে জুস দিতে এসে দেখে আদ্রিয়ান কোনো দিকে নেই তাই সবদিকে খুঁজেও যখন খুঁজে পেলো না তখন দেখলো আদ্রিয়ান গাছের সাইডে দাড়িয়ে ফোনে কথা বলছে। হয়তো কোনো ইম্পর্ট্যান্ট কোনো কল এসেছে। তাই সে আর সেই দিকে না গিয়ে নিশি আর তন্নীর সাথে আড্ডায় যোগ দিলো। সাথে দাদিমাও ছিলো। রাত তখন বারোটা একে একে সবাই ঘুমানোর জন্য নিচে নামতে লাগলো। মেঘাও যখন ছাদের দরজার দিকে যাবে তখনই একটা হাত তাকে টেনে দেওয়ালের কাছে মিশিয়ে নিলো। হঠাৎ এমন হওয়াতে মেঘা খুব ভয় পেলো। কিন্তু ব্যাক্তিটি কে তা বুঝতে বেশিক্ষণ সময় লাগলো না। কিন্তু হঠাৎ এভাবে টেনে নেওয়ার কি হলো। এই লোকটা একটু বেশি বেশি করে। মেঘা চোখ খুলে সামনে তাকিয়ে দেখলো আদ্রিয়ান মোহনীয় দৃষ্টিতে তার দিকে তাকিয়ে আছে। এই তাকানোতে মেঘার হৃদপিণ্ডে কেমন একটা অনুভুতি হতে লাগলো। আদ্রিয়ানের এই দৃষ্টিতে বেশিক্ষণ তাকিয়ে থাকতে পারে না। তাই মেঘা দৃষ্টি নিচের দিকে করে নিলো। আদ্রিয়ান মেঘার সরল দৃষ্টি গুলো উপভোগ করলো। এরপর মেঘার থুতনিতে ধরে নিজের দিকে ফিরিয়ে 

"নিজেকে এখন পৃথিবীর সর্বোচ্চ সুখী ব্যাক্তি মনে হয় , স্নিগ্ধপরী। জীবনের এতো গুলো বসন্ত নিলাসাই কেটেছে। কিন্তু যখন থেকে তুমিময় বসন্ত প্রকট হয়েছো। তখন থেকে প্রত্যেক সায়াহ্নের প্রহর গুলো তাল মিলিয়ে তুমিমই বসন্ত ছড়িয়ে পড়ছে ধীরে ধীরে। কি এমন আছে তোমার মধ্যে বলোতো? যেই বসন্তের ছোঁয়া গভীর থেকে গভীরে যাচ্ছে?"

আদ্রিয়ানের এরূপ কথাতে মেঘার চোখে অশ্রু চলে আসলো। আদ্রিয়ান তাকে এতোটা স্পেশাল করছে প্রতি মুহূর্তে যে মাঝে মাঝে মনে হয় মেঘার ভালোবাসা কম পড়ছে আদ্রিয়ান এর জন্য। আরো বেশি কিছু দিতে চাই সে আদ্রিয়ান কে। সে সর্বোচ্চ দেওয়ার চেষ্টা করেও কিন্তু তবুও মনে হয় কোনো কিছু কমতি রয়ে গেছে। 

"আদ্র একটা কথা জিজ্ঞেস করবো?"

মেঘার কথাই আদ্রিয়ান মাথা নাড়িয়ে সম্মতি দিলো

"এতো কেনো ভালোবাসেন আমায়? কেনো এতো আসক্ত হলেন আমার প্রতি? আমি যে এতোটা সুখ পাওয়ার যোগ্য না! কেনো এতো বেকুল আপনি আমার প্রতি? বলুন আদ্র?"

মেঘা আদ্রিয়ান এর গালে হাত দিয়ে অশ্রুযুক্ত চোখে উক্ত প্রশ্ন গুলো করলো। আদ্রিয়ান মেঘার এরূপ কথাই মুচকি হেসে বৃদ্ধা আঙ্গুল দিয়ে অশ্রু গুলো মুছে দিলো। এরপর মেঘার চোখের পাতায় শুষ্ক ঠোঁটের ছোঁয়া দিলো। 

"এই প্রশ্ন গুলোর বিশ্লেষণ দেওয়া যে বড্ড কঠিন স্নিগ্ধপরী। ভালোবাসা যে প্রকাশের বিষয় না। ভালোবাসি বললেই তো আর ভালোবাসা হয়না তাইনা? তাই কখনোই এসব প্রকাশ করে ভালোবাসা কে নিচু করবো না। কিন্তু প্রতিটি কর্ম কাণ্ডে বোঝাবো যে কতটা গভীর এই ভালোবাসার অনুভূতি গুলো। যতো দিন যাবে তার গভীরতা ধীরে ধীরে বাড়বে। বাড়বে তোমার প্রতি আমার আশক্তিময় ভালোবাসা। কিন্তু প্রকাশ্যে নয়। আর তোমাকে পাওয়া হচ্ছে আমার শ্রেষ্ঠতম সুখ। যা আমি প্রতিটি ক্ষণে ক্ষণে অন্তরালে মিশে যাচ্ছি। তাই নিজেকে কখনো মূল্যহীন ভাববে না। কারণ তুমি পুরোটাই একটা মানুষের জন্য খুবই মূল্যবান। আর সে মানুষটা হলো তোমার অর্ধাঙ্গ। তাই কখনো নিজেকে গুরুত্বহীন ভাববে না।"

আদ্রিয়ান এর এরূপ কথা শুনে মেঘা আদ্রিয়ান কে শক্ত করে জড়িয়ে ধরলো। আদ্রিয়ানো মেঘাকে নিজের বাহুডোরে আবদ্ধ করলো। 

"আজ কিন্তু আমার বার্থডে গিফট হিসেবে তোমাকে নিজের সাথে মিশিয়ে নিতে চাই। দেবে কি অনুমতি আমায়? নতুন করে আবার তোমাকে ভালোবাসার। তোমার নেশার ছোঁয়ায় আলিঙ্গন করতে দেবে কি আমায় জান?"

মেঘা খুবই লজ্জা পেলো এসব কথা শুনে তাই আদ্রিয়ান এর বুকে হালকা একটা কামড় দিলো। আর এতেই আদ্রিয়ান মেঘার সম্মতি পেলো। আদ্রিয়ানো আর দেরি করলো না মেঘাকে কোলে নিয়ে নিলো। এরপর ছাদ থেকে নেমে নিজেদের কক্ষে ফিরে গেলো।

AL- KAFIRUN - THE IGNORANT THOUGHTS  

Al-Kafirun in Quranic context simply means the  thoughts mindset which covers / hide the truth. The word Kafir does not describe any particular person who does not believe in Allah; it is a characteristic of satanic thoughts such as ego and vanity. Man is a product of his own thoughts and the theme of the entire Quran is how to evolve / convert our bad thoughts into good thoughts. Ibless is described as Kafir and arrogant in Quran - 2:34. Iblees is not any physical character but a specific character of our own self / thought that hides or cover facts.

Kafir - Mushrik - Munafiq - Fasiq - Mufasidun - Mukazabin - Momin - Muslim, Yahood, Nasara are distinct thoughts / ideologies / mindsets or different layers of our own level of self / nafs / senses / thoughts - We have to nurture some and some we have to kill or delete or educate in the line with our System of Consciousness. They are not persons belonging to particular communities but moral principles,  mindsets that govern a person's behaviour or the conducting of an activity a system of ideas and ideals, especially one which forms the basis f our character.

The word Al-Kafir signifies that mindset which refuses to acknowledge or digest / recognise a particular theory, belief, creed- a skeptical - not accepting a particular belief - manifesting unbelief, rejecting some idea or belief. This happens because the knowledge is covered by ego and ignorance. In that case we all are Kafirs and this Surah is an advice to all of us.

In short this surah states that what I do is none of your business, if it suits your thoughts, you follow my way or you follow what suits you. There is no compulsion in Deen (2:256). So there should be no debates and arguments beyond a certain limit. It tends to create a demarcation of beliefs and how one must hold back oneself from enforcing their views and opinions. Though the basic meaning of Kafir is - one who covers, conceals a thing or denies the facts or dis-acknowledges it, ungrateful and ignorant. The general conception of the word Kafir is derogatory to "non-muslims" thanks to the traditional thinkers. In this surah Al of Kafir is describing a specific character present in all.

"Islam" or Peace/Security is not an ism, as  generally believed. The traditional thinkers have divided mankind into two classes 

                              1. Believers in "Islamic ideology", they are called Muslims.

                              2. Non believers in "Islamic ideology", they are called Kafirs.

But the fact is otherwise. The message of the book Quran is for the entire mankind and its main subject of discussion is how to achieve PEACE/SECURITY/SOUNDNESS for self. Just like when, man cannot survive without the basic necessities like air, water, and food, in the same way man cannot survive without peace/security. So Peace/Security (ISLAM) is not somebody’s ancestral property that can be classified into two main groups, then again further sub-divided into many smaller groups each claiming to be the sole heir of the property called "Islam" or Peace. Peace/Safety is a basic need of everyone and it is the topmost priority for everyone. Peace, Shanti, Shalom, Salam are not somebodies monopoly but everybody's requirement. 

The teachings of the book Quran are not divisive, but some sections of people make an impression that they are the sole teachers/possesser of the message of Peace/Security. And only their version of understanding of the message is correct.  Thereby branding others who don't subscribe  to their understanding, as "The Kafirs" [The ignorant]. 

The meaning of Muslim is, one who is at peace with self or one surrenders to peace (salam). If one is safe and peaceful then only he can cater to the peace and security of others. Those who are not peaceful are called mischief mongers (الْمُفْسِدُونَ). Although Muslim, Mufasidun are all nature of thoughts.

There are only 3 important words in this surah, which should be understood in the right perspective. They are Kafir, ibadah and Deen.

Meanings:

الْكَافِرُونَ = They are the thoughts that covers the wise knowledge, don't believe, reject, concealed, cover, dis-acknowledge, infidelity, ignorant

أَعْبُدُ - تَعْبُدُونَ - عَابِدٌ -  The word Ibadah is used in different derivatives in this surah, which means to serve, worship, adore, revere, regard - Ibadah actually means to serve whole-heartedly or with reverence/obeisance etc

 دِينِ = Became obedient, borrowed, submissive, life enslaved in debts, served, followed, governed, managed, possessed, owned it, authority over it, inherent law, under obligation, obedience, habituated, accustomed, indebted in debt, religion, code of life, way, etc - Madeena is one of the derivative of Deen, which means city or place under an authority.

بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

Interpretation:

 قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ

(1) Say O you that masked/covered / satanic mindsets 

 لَا أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ

(2) I serve not which you serve 

 وَلَا أَنتُمْ عَابِدُونَ مَا أَعْبُدُ

(3) And nor will you serve that which I serve

 وَلَا أَنَا عَابِدٌ مَّا عَبَدتُّمْ

(4) And I shall not serve that which you are serving

 وَلَا أَنتُمْ عَابِدُونَ مَا أَعْبُدُ

(5) And nor will you serve that which I serve

 لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِيَ دِينِ

(6) To you your way of life (obedience), and to me my way way of life (obedience).

THE SIMPLE MESSAGE OF THE SURAH:

Our own thoughts mindset which hides the truth are precisely addressed that I am not going to follow your ignorance. Here no physical "non-believer" is addressed as generally perceived but the message is to our own ignorant thoughts which are present in all of us that are being addressed.

FURTHER ELABORATION OF KAFIR:

Kafirun - Refuse to accept because of lack of knowledge.

For example just like some people still believe that the earth is flat – They refuse to accept evidences and proofs presented to them by the highest authority on that subject. Such thoughts are ignorant [KAFIR] because they are based on blind belief and not on research. The belief or the ego or in religious term Satan refuses to accept the facts as the ignorant thoughts are arrogant too, dominating and not letting the new thoughts to enter in the system. Similarly if thoughts suits me, not necessary that it would suit all and that all should be forced to accept it. If the thoughts rejects or refuses to accept an explanation in this case the thought is a kafir because it rejects your explanation. Kafir is just a word having simple meaning like any other word but non-Arabs have made it look like an abuse. The basic meaning of Kafara is to hide, veiled, dis-acknowledged, denied, concealed, covered, etc. The word Kafir has nothing to do with not believing in "God".  

EXPLAINING DEEN:

Here it is very important to understand the meaning of Deen. The correct essence of the meaning of this word will help us in understanding Deen throughout the Quran. Usually when the word Deen is mentioned, Islam comes to mind. Although the word Deen does not represent only "Islam".. Deen is an extremely subtle word which needs to be understood in the right perspective. The meaning of Deen, varies from context to context but without change in the essence of the root word. Here Deen does not mean religion or ideology. Here Deen signifies that we are ruled by certain belief which we subscribe to, and we are under its influence hence we are obedient and submissive to it. An example of obedience (Deen) is, when someone is under a pressure of debt, and from that obligation of the creditor it is difficult to come out. And he has to obey / oblige each and every condition of the creditor. His way of life is dictated by the creditor and he has to submit to the creditor. This is the essence of Deen. 

Madeena a derivative of Deen, means a state under authority or state of submission. A debtor is also under the obligation or under the control of creditor's terms and conditions; such a condition is also referred to as Deen. That's why in the beginning of the Quran itself, the respectable author clarified the relation of Man and Rabb, in verse four - Maliki Yaumi Deen means Owner of the borrower's moments. Here Rabb is the Owner or Giver and we are the borrower.

Mankind are the debtors of Rabbul Aalameen

The respected author of the book Quran wants us to know that our real master is the Knowledgeable Rabb and what we obey or submit to, is our Deen and it is we who are the subscribers of our Deen. We only serve to please our own Consciousness [Rabb} There is no compulsion on us to heed a certain Deen. It is our life, so select your Deen wisely. As the Master will always be our own Magnificent Rabb and you will always be His servant. In fact we don't realize we serve our Rabb [Mind / Consciousness] only.

Message of the Surah:

Specific emphasis is given to the haters/rejectors of any ideology or doctrine or person.  

For instance what Mr. A – feels is right, it’s not necessary that Mr. B- would also feel the same and so he cannot be forced to feel in that manner. If there is any type of enforcement then it would lead to dispute and that would promote an unhealthy atmosphere which is not ISLAM (peace) but ignorance (Kufur). Killing each other in the name of ism is not at all recommended even if the denier rejects your ideology or doctrine or you.

What we accept or in obedience of it, is our way of spending our life and that is our Deen.

Obedience or Deen are not permanent features, but keeps on changing according to the situations.

What we accept today, tomorrow we can reject it or what we reject today, tomorrow we can accept it. 

What we don't accept/obey or what we deny/reject is termed as Kafir. Nothing unholy about it.

The main lesson of this surah is tolerance and secularism. Live and let Live."

📖 Penjelasan Perbedaan antara Kāfir (كافر) dan Non-Muslim

1️⃣ Kāfir (كافر)
🔎 Secara Bahasa (Lughah)
Kata كَافِر (kāfir) berasal dari akar kata:
كَفَرَ – يَكْفُرُ – كُفْرًا
kafara – yakfuru – kufran
Artinya: menutup, menutupi sesuatu.
Dalam bahasa Arab klasik, petani disebut:
كَافِرٌ
karena ia menutup benih dengan tanah.
📌 Jadi secara bahasa, kafir berarti orang yang menutup.
📖 Secara Istilah dalam Al-Qur’an
Dalam konteks Al-Qur’an, kufur bukan sekadar “tidak beriman”, tetapi:
إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَأَنْذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنْذِرْهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
Innal-ladzīna kafarū sawā’un ‘alaihim a-andzartahum am lam tundzirhum lā yu’minūn
(QS. Al-Baqarah: 6)

Maknanya: orang yang menolak dengan sadar, meski telah jelas baginya.

Al-Qur’an juga menjelaskan makna “menutup hati”:
خَتَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ
Khatamallāhu ‘alā qulūbihim
“Allah telah mengunci hati mereka.” (QS. Al-Baqarah: 7)
📌 Maka dalam pengertian teologis klasik:
Kāfir adalah orang yang:
Mengetahui kebenaran namun menolaknya
Menutup diri karena kesombongan atau kebencian
Secara aktif memusuhi dan menentang
Contoh historisnya adalah sebagian pembesar Quraisy yang tahu kejujuran Nabi ﷺ tetapi tetap menolak.

2️⃣ Non-Muslim
Istilah ini bukan istilah Al-Qur’an, tetapi istilah sosial modern.

Secara bahasa:
مُسْلِم (muslim) = orang yang berserah diri kepada Allah
Maka non-Muslim = orang yang tidak memeluk Islam.

Namun dalam Al-Qur’an, ada pengelompokan yang lebih rinci, misalnya:

📖 Ahlul Kitab
إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَالَّذِينَ هَادُوا وَالنَّصَارَىٰ...
Innal-ladzīna āmanū walladzīna hādū wan-naṣārā…
(QS. Al-Baqarah: 62)

Menunjukkan bahwa ada kelompok berbeda yang tidak diperlakukan secara seragam.
📖 Prinsip Keadilan Ilahi
وَمَا كُنَّا مُعَذِّبِينَ حَتَّىٰ نَبْعَثَ رَسُولًا
Wa mā kunnā mu‘adzdzibīna ḥattā nab‘atsa rasūlā (QS. Al-Isrā’: 15)

Artinya: Allah tidak mengazab sebelum sampai risalah secara jelas.

Ini menjadi dasar bahwa pertanggungjawaban tergantung pada pengetahuan dan kesempatan yang sampai kepada seseorang.

Turjumaaddii Al Faghi

Hindiga waxaan la jaanqaaday markuu af hindiga ahaa. Waa markuu Shahrukh Khan kii markan dambe aduunka qabsaday uu khaayin yar ka ahaa. In af aadan fahmaynin filim dhan aad ku daawataa waxay korisaa garaadka fahma luqadda aan hadalka ahayn iyo scenery gana akhriyi kara. Filim dhan baad calal qiyaasi sheekadiisa ula soconaysaa. Waxaa la yaab leh in dadkan turjuma laftoodu aanay hindiga u aqoonin sida ay u turjunayaan. Markan dambe ee aan fahmay in filimada qaarkood ay Turjumi jireen aanay Telugu ama Malayam ahaayeen. 

Buuga iyo filimadaba waa la turjumaa. Waan daawaday filimo af kale laga soo turjumay oo ingiriisi laga dhigay ama Carabi. Waligayse ma arag turjumid ka heer sarraysa midda kooxdan Alfaghi. Markaf daawanayso waxaad u baahanaysaa cid mar walba ku xusuusisa in filimku markii hore luqad kale ahaa sida intay u dhex galeen ay iyagii iskaga dhigeen. 

Filim kasta oo macaan oo la turjumay oo aan kooxdan ahayn afkuu doono ha sheegtee waxaa ka maqan wax badan. Sababta waxaan u malaynayaa. 

1) Is lahaanshiyaha hadalka iyo dareenka; filimada luqadaha kale lagu turjumay waxaad ka dareemeysaa in ereyada uun la badalay balse shucuurtii qofka hadlayay iyo dhaqaaqii uu sameynayay aan hadalka la waafajin. Waa sidii shaah aad sonkortii biyihii iyo shaahii aad midba mar afka galisay oo aan laysku karin. 

2) xulashada dadka; qof walba waxaa u hadlayay qof u eeg hadalkiisa. Xataa qaarkood baa ka hadlayaa si dhab ah ugu eeg yahayba qofka uu I hadlayo. Ajakis maallinyii iigu horaysay ee aan arko Isciilciil ninkii ay ula baxeen baan xusuustay. 

3) Nuxur Nuxur ku badal; turjumaada tooska ah ee erey erey ku badalaadu waxay hallaysaa macnaha. Nuxurka laga hadlayo intay fahmaan ayay ereyo ku haboon oo dhaqankeenii wata galinayeen. Atoore heesaya ayaa hees Soomali ah lagu badalayaa. Maahmaahyaha u badab ee reer koonfurka badidooda filimada hindiga ah baan ka bartay.

Haddiii tartarn la galiyo filimadii adduunka la rurjumay kooxdan alfaghi number one waxay ku noqonaysaa heerka sare iyo dedaalka ay galiyeen. Wax la mid ah Hollywood na dhehoo waan waayay.  Bal Dooli iyo siduu Amamdi ama Johnny Leever u codeeyey ka waran. 

Talooyin aan u quray qolo warbaahinta ah waxaa ka mid ahaa "hiigso balse ha humaagaynin". Atooreyaasha Hindida ah waxaan ragga taageeri jiray saddex nin;

The Chinese Year of the Horse begins on Tuesday, February 17, 2026. President #XiJinping has frequently used adages, idioms and metaphors about horses, reflecting his views on governance and philosophy. #StoriesaboutXi

On June 9, 2014, Xi addressed the opening ceremony of the 17th Congress of the Chinese Academy of Sciences and the 12th Congress of the Chinese Academy of Engineering in #Beijing. He stressed that scientific and technological innovation has no finish line.

Xi quoted Xun Zi, a renowned Chinese philosopher who lived more than 2,000 years ago: "If a gallant steed leaps only once, it can cover a distance of no more than 10 steps. If an inferior horse travels for 10 days, it can go a long way on perseverance."

Scientific and technological competition, Xi said, is like short track speed skating. When we speed up, others do too. Those who can skate faster and sustain a high speed longer will ultimately win. He called on scientists and engineers to shoulder their responsibilities, overtake competitors and identify the right direction, then remain committed to it. They should have the courage and confidence to break new ground, overcome difficulties and strive for excellence, and boldly pursue world-leading scientific and technological achievements.

Hotel California. The Gods Must Be Crazy.
Two Things You Recognise. One Story You Were Never Meant to Hear.

Right, so I need to tell you about a man called Johannes Conga. Nobody else is going to, and that’s sort of the whole point.
Southern Africa, 1979. There’s a large military base called Omega, sitting in the central Caprivi Strip, a narrow corridor of bush and floodplain wedged between Angola, Zambia, and Botswana. About sixty kilometres to the west, on the banks of the Okavango, one of the great wild rivers of the African continent, sits a smaller outpost called Bagani, a farm on the river’s edge. Hot doesn’t describe it. The air smells of iron dust and dry grass and woodsmoke.

A young Bushman soldier, small, wiry, perpetually grinning, finds a tape recorder on a senior officer’s radio at Bagani. He presses play. The well known “Eagles” band come through the speaker. “Hotel California.” He rewinds it. Plays it again. And again. He loves it.
Now, here’s where the story gets properly human. Before “Hotel California,” some of the mischievous soldiers on base had already taught Johannes that the English way to greet people was to say “I love you.” He believed them. Completely. He said it to everyone. Officers, medics, other Bushmen, and it caused absolute chaos when he started cheerfully greeting every woman on the base with “I love you” as though he was saying good morning. 

The troopers, probably crying with laughter, eventually told him that “Hotel California” was a much better way to say hello. So he switched. And from that moment on, he said it to everyone. First thing in the morning. Last thing before patrol. He shouted it from his bicycle, this old bicycle he rode around Omega like it was a Bentley, waving at people who waved back and shouted it too. He was the guy everyone knew. Not because he was loud or foolish, but because he was genuinely, relentlessly happy, which is a remarkable thing to be when you’re living in a military camp in the African bush surrounded by people who want everyone in it dead.
He was gone within months. Killed during a patrol in southern Zambia. His section was ambushed. Two young officers, Second Lieutenant N. Coetzee and Second Lieutenant G. van Niekerk, were caught without cover and couldn’t take effective command of the situation. Johannes did what soldiers who love their own do. He drew fire upon himself, deliberately, to get both officers out of the killing ground and to safety. He died in the process. In the immediate follow-up, eight SWAPO fighters were killed. 

A soldier called Ziggy Hentze was there, tried to save Johannes, and carries the full account of what happened that day. South Africa awarded Johannes the Honoris Crux, the country’s highest bravery decoration, posthumously. Private Johannes Conga. Service number 34863. 31 Battalion. The Bushman Battalion. He was probably in his early twenties, but I can’t tell you exactly, because nobody recorded his birth. That was normal for the San. The oldest people on the African continent, their ancestors’ handprints still visible on cave walls from tens of thousands of years before anyone else arrived in southern Africa, and the modern world never bothered writing down when Johannes arrived in it.

A note on names. When the SABC broadcast a dramatised version of Johannes’s story in 1986, and when Ian Uys published the first edition of Bushmen Soldiers, different names were used for the officers involved. This was deliberate. Men were still operating in the field. Their identities were protected. The names Venter and Kotze that appear in some accounts were cover names. The men Johannes saved were Coetzee and Van Niekerk.

Most people outside South Africa have never heard of Johannes Conga. Most have never heard of 31 Battalion. Very few knew about the Bushman soldiers at all. Some were Vasekelas, former Flechas who had fought alongside the Portuguese in Angola before Portugal’s empire collapsed. Others were Barakwenas, the Water Bushmen from the Caprivi and northern Botswana. The base and its soldiers were the result of a secret project called Project Alpha, built from nothing by Commandant Delville Linford. Its sister unit, 32 Battalion, grew from a parallel effort called Project Bravo under Commandant Jan Breytenbach. Both units fought in Operation Savannah in 1975 as Battle Groups Alpha and Bravo. None of this was public knowledge at the time. Most of it still isn’t.

Most people have no idea that for over two decades, from the mid-1960s to 1989, southern Africa was one of the most intense battlegrounds of the Cold War. You probably know about Vietnam. Everyone does. Vietnam consumed the Western media so completely that almost no broadcasting bandwidth was left for what was happening at the southern end of Africa at exactly the same time, where soldiers of every race were fighting and dying together against the same communist machine, backed by the same Soviet Union, armed with the same weapons.
 The difference is that in southern Africa, the Western press didn’t just ignore the war. They actively framed the people fighting it as the villains.
Here’s what they left out. When Portugal’s African empire collapsed in 1975, Angola didn’t become free. It became a Soviet client state. Cuba, on Moscow’s orders, deployed 36,000 combat troops. The Soviets shipped in billions worth of tanks, fighter jets, anti-aircraft batteries, the full industrial output of a superpower behind a Marxist government parked right on the border of South West Africa, today’s Namibia. 

Soviet-trained guerrillas launched cross-border raids from Angolan bases. The pattern was identical to every other place Moscow had set up shop in Africa: Ethiopia, Mozambique, you name it. And everywhere communism arrived on the continent, it destroyed indigenous ways of living. Collective farms replaced family land. Traditional leadership was dismantled. Communities that had governed themselves for centuries were absorbed into party structures and stripped of everything that made them who they were. People across southern Africa could see it happening in real time, right across the border.

This is why Johannes Conga fought. Not for some abstraction. For his home. For his people. For the right of his community to keep living the way their ancestors had lived for thousands of years. The San had watched it happen to relatives and neighbours in Angola. They knew what was coming if nobody held the line. So did the Afrikaners, the Afrikaans-speaking white South Africans descended from Dutch, German, and French settlers. So did the Ovambo and Kavango troops serving in other units. Everyone in that fight was protecting something specific and personal. Their families. Their land. Their way of life. The white national servicemen, most of them barely out of school, were fighting so that communities back home, all of them, could continue to exist as they were. Meanwhile, people in comfortable offices in Washington and London and Stockholm, people who would never face the consequences, decided the whole thing was illegitimate. It’s easy to be moral when you’re not the one the tanks are pointed at.

Johannes’s people, the San, sometimes called the Bushmen, are the original inhabitants of southern Africa. Afrikaners always acknowledged this. It was never contested, never revised, never politically inconvenient enough to rewrite. You want to know what Afrikaners actually thought about the San?

In 1980 an Afrikaner filmmaker called Jamie Uys made a film about them. The Gods Must Be Crazy. You might remember it. It became the highest-grossing foreign film in American box office history at the time. Built entirely around the warmth, intelligence, and dignity of the San. Made by an Afrikaner. About a people Afrikaners respected.

The Soviet-aligned cultural establishment attacked it immediately, dismissed it as patronising, because a film showing Afrikaners portraying indigenous Africans with genuine humanity shattered something the propaganda machine needed intact: the assumption that Afrikaners were incapable of seeing black people as fully human. Sound familiar? The same technique is used today. Anyone who challenges the approved narrative gets labelled racist, far-right, supremacist, and the actual evidence gets buried under the noise. The mechanics haven’t changed since Moscow perfected them. Only the platforms have.

The San were master trackers in a way that’s genuinely hard to explain if you haven’t seen it. They could read footprints days old, interpret bent grass and insect activity and shifts in animal behaviour to reconstruct exactly who had passed through a piece of ground, how many, carrying what, moving how fast. This wasn’t a trick. It was millennia of accumulated knowledge, passed down through persistence hunting, compressed into a sensory awareness that no satellite or drone on earth can replicate.

The guerrilla commander on the other side of the war admitted publicly that the Bushman trackers were the single greatest obstacle his forces faced along the entire border. The South African military understood what they had. The philosophy at Omega was explicit: don’t try to Westernise these men, make them better at what they already are. Combine ancient tracking science with modern infantry tactics. The result was one of the most effective light infantry units of the entire Cold War.

Omega itself tells you something about the relationships the outside world was never supposed to see. By 1981 this base in the middle of the African bush housed 850 Bushman soldiers, 900 of their wives and partners, and 1,500 of their children, living alongside their white South African officers. There was a military hospital treating 500 patients a month. Schools for the children. A church. And around the perimeter, in the evenings, the Bushmen still danced their traditional dances by firelight, the ancient healing rituals continuing as they had for thousands of years, right next to the armoury and the radio tower.

Colonel Delville Linford, the man who built 31 Battalion from nothing under Project Alpha, wrote years later about the bond. The loyalty and trust of men who fought shoulder to shoulder and died shoulder to shoulder. When officers fell in combat, the Bushmen carried their bodies for miles through hostile bush. Would not leave them behind. When Johannes drew fire on himself so Coetzee and Van Niekerk could get out of that ambush alive, that wasn’t an order anyone gave him. That was a man protecting people he considered family. Hotel California. Good morning.

In 1986, South Africa’s national broadcaster, the SABC, produced a television series about many of these men. Each episode dramatised the true story of a recipient of the Honoris Crux. One of them told the story of Johannes Conga. Think about that for a second. A state broadcaster, in the country the entire Western world had been told was the most racist on earth, commissioned and broadcast a television drama honouring a Bushman soldier. They gave him a name. A personality. They showed white officers grieving his death. They broadcast it to millions of viewers. The Christian Science Monitor verified the same.

Racists don’t make television dramas about their heroes, give them medals, and broadcast it to millions. But they did. The Globalist “Anti-Apartheid” Communist Propaganda Machine just kept it from you. It would hurt their narrative. They only fed a socially engineered perception to the world, and withheld the stories like that of Johannes Conga.

And Johannes wasn’t alone. He was part of a pattern that runs through centuries of southern African history, a pattern so consistent and so thoroughly documented that it took an industrial-scale propaganda effort to bury it. The Voortrekkers, the Afrikaner pioneers who crossed the Drakensberg Mountains in the 1830s, didn’t travel alone. When the British Empire burned Boer farms during the Anglo-Boer War of 1899 to 1902 and herded women and children into concentration camps, they rounded up the black farmworkers too. Fourteen thousand black South Africans died in those British camps, because the Empire feared their loyalty to the Boers. Let that settle.

Further on, in Angola, 32 Battalion, Project Bravo’s legacy, black Angolan soldiers fighting alongside white South Africans against Cuban and Soviet forces, proved so effective that when the war ended, the apartheid government granted them South African citizenship and gave them a town called Pomfret, complete with houses, schools, churches. When the new democratic government took power after 1994, they cut Pomfret’s electricity, restricted its water to once a week, and tried to demolish the place.

For over two decades, soldiers of every colour held the line against communist expansion across southern Africa while the rest of the world either didn’t know or didn’t care. When that wall finally broke in 1994, the toxicity poured through. The Soviet-trained ANC leadership brought with it the ideology, the corruption, the systematic gutting of every institution that had kept the country running. The blueprint the West will adopt.

The South Africa that was handed over in 1994 had a functioning power grid, an independent judiciary, and the most advanced economy on the continent. Thirty years later? Rolling blackouts. Collapsed infrastructure. A state so hollowed out by ideology and theft that the descendants of the very soldiers who fought for it are living in poverty.

The families of Johannes Conga’s comrades live today at a place called Platfontein, outside the city of Kimberley. Seven thousand people. Water once a week if they’re lucky. The building that used to be their clinic is now a rubbish dump. Their community radio station, X-K FM, broadcasts in the San languages of !Xun and Khwe, trying to keep them alive. The government that was supposed to free everyone has never visited. Not once.

The propaganda template used against South Africa in the 1970s and ’80s didn’t retire when the Cold War ended. It just moved. The same technique of reducing complex realities to a single damning label, of erasing every inconvenient human story that complicates the approved narrative, of shouting “racist” until the audience stops asking questions, you can see it everywhere today. Different targets. Same playbook. The mechanics Moscow perfected during the Cold War are now standard practice in Western media, academia, and foreign policy. If you’ve ever watched a story get flattened into a slogan and felt something was missing, this is what was missing. People like Johannes Conga. Relationships like the ones at Omega.

Remember their names. The media wanted you to forget them because they didn’t fit the story being sold. Afrikaners didn’t forget them. Brothers.

Dabcan, cid kasta xukunka ha joogtee waxaad mar walba arkaysaa bulshada dalkaasi cadowga koowaad u ah in lagula kacayo (1) xadhig dhallinyaro, (2) xadhig haween, (3) xadhig haldoor, iyo (4) eedeymo madhan oo qaran-dumis ah.

3. Go’doomin Dhaqaale Iyo Bulsho: Marka Dawladuhu Bulsho u arkaan cadow muhiim ah, waxay ka joojiyaan adeegga shaqo-abuurka & dhaqdhaqaaqa ganacsiga, waxaynna bulshadaa saartaa cunaqabateyn, xayiraad safar, iyo ka maanicidda jagooyin dawladeed oo macne iyo metelaad bulsheed yeelan Kara. 

4. Adeegsi Xoog: Dawladuhu bulshada ugu qoran cadowga muhiimka ah, waxay u adeegsadaan xoog, dil iyo cabsi galin joogteysan, iyadoo la adeegsanayo ciidamada booliiska ama millatariga dalka. Iyadoo mararka la curiyo rabahado iyo dagaallo, si loo unko fursad barakicineed, deegaameyn, xabsi galin, iyo dhul-ballaadhsi. Waxaana la samaystaa qaar iyaga ka soo jeeda oo muddo kooban la quweeyo kaddibna xabsiyada ku gura intooda mudnaanta leh iyo inta leh aragti gobaysan oo ka duwan taliska dadkooda ku haya nugleynta siyaasadeed iyo bahdilka hoggaamineed (Isku darka dhaqanka iyo siyaasadda). 

5. Meeleynta Dadka Liita Iyo Fogaynta Haldoorka: Dawladuhu bulshada ay u arkaan cadowga koowaad waxa ay xilka ugu dhiibaan kuwooga liita ee aaminsan diinta raashinka, islamarkaana u darban ku kicidda cayda iyo canjareynta dadkooda, aynna suurtagal tahay in cayda tolkood ay warbaahinta la soo fadhiistaan. Dhinaca kalena waxaa la hawl-galinayaa dad ka soo jeeda cidda xukunka haysa oo cidda ku suntan cadowga muhiimka ah cay, eedeyn iyo hanjabaad dusha ka saaraysa, si dadkowga kale loogu muujiyo inta duulkaasi yahay la hayste dullaysan oo aaan juuq odhan karin. 

6. Kala Qaybin Bulsheed Iyo Isku Dir Qabiil: Marka kasta oo ay dawladuhu la fal galayaan bulshooyinka ay u arkaan cadowgooda muhiimka ah, waxay ku sameeyaan kala qaybin, iyo isku dir, salka ku haysa (1) ammaan been ah, (2) taariikh been ah, (3) Kala sarreysiin madhan, (4) dan qumin maalmeed, iyo (5) kala laandheereysiin joogto ah.

7. Wadahadal ama dib-u-heshiisiin (xaalado gaar ah): Marka dawladuhu gumaynayaan cidda ay u arkaan cadowgooda koowaad waxay la galaan wadahadal iyo dib u heshiisiin dhalan-teeg ah. Waana labo aragtiyood oo ku aroorsan falsafadda dawladnimada. Ugu danbeyntii, waxaa laga yabaa farqiga u dhaxeeya dawladaha digtaytarka ah iyo kuwa dimuqraadiga ahi in uu ku malgo oo aad hoosaasintooda  kala qabow ku hanfato. Tusaale ahaan (1) hawl-fulinta nidaamyada dawaldaha dimuqraadiga ahi badanaa waxay ku xaddidan yihiin Dastuur iyo maxkamado fulinaya ajande shaadh dawladeed huwan balse hoosta ka jallaafeysan,iyo (2) nidaamyada kali-taliska ah oo iyagu u nugul hirgelinta cabudhin xooggan oo la wada dareemi karo. Diinosoorrada… sida ay qaar sheegaan waa makhluuqyo ku noolaa dhulka malaayiin sano ka hor inta aanu bini’aadamku imaan‼️

Caddeynta ay sheegayaan waa lafaha hadhaaga ah ee ay saynisyahannadu heleen, ka dibna filimada shisheeye ayaa sameeyay sawirro iyo qaabab ay ku tilmaameen inay ahaayeen makhluuqyo aad u waaweyn oo dhaadheer iyo waxyaabo kale oo la mid ah. Marka filimadaasi faafeen, fikradduna way ku faaftay dunida oo dhan, waxayna noqotay arrin dadku u qaateen mid la hubo‼️ Taas macnaheedu waa in la yiraahdo waxaa jiray makhluuqyo la oran jiray diinosaarrada oo ka horreeyay bini’aadamka kuna noolaa dhulka‼️

Sidoo kale waxaa loo sheegay in batroolku ka samaysmo harraaga xayawaanno dhulka hoostiisa ku aasnaa, cadaadis iyo kulayl awgoodna isu beddela batrool, taasoo la sheegayo inay qaadato malaayiin sano‼️

Laakiin marka la akhriyo cilmi-baarisyo badan oo ka hadlaya dabiicadda iyo dhulka, laguna laabto Qur’aanka Kariimka ah iyo kutubta salafka, lama helayo daliil cad oo xaqiijinaya arrimahan la sheegay‼️

Sidoo kale lama helin raad ay ka tageen Finiiqiyiintii ama ilbaxnimo hore oo ka hadlaysa diinosoorrada, taasoo ka dhigan in annagu nahay ilbaxnimada kaliya ee arrintan og‼️

Culimada qaarkood way ku kala aragti duwan yihiin da’da bini’aadamka ee dhulka, balse si kastaba ha ahaatee da’da bini’aadamka lama dhaafin 10 kun oo sano. Marka loo noqdo kutubta salafka, waxaa jira riwaayado badan oo ka hadlaya bilowgii abuurka iyo Aadan (cs) oo ah aabbaha aadanaha.

Waxaa laga wariyey Rasuulka (NNKH) in Nabi Aadan (cs) dhererkiisu ahaa 60 dhudhun, hal dhudhun-na uu yahay 50 sentimitir, sidaas darteed dhererkiisu qiyaastii wuxuu ahaa 30 mitir.

Xadiis saxiix ah ayuu Nabigu (NNKH) ku yiri:
“Alle wuxuu abuuray Aadan (cs) isagoo dhererkiisu yahay lixdan dhudhun. Markii la abuuray ayuu ku yiri: u tag malaa’igtaas oo salaan, dhegayso sida ay kuu soo jawaabaan, waayo taas ayaa noqon doonta salaanta farcankaaga. Markaasuu yiri: Asalaamu calaykum. Waxay yiraahdeen: Asalaamu calayka waraxmatullaah, waxayna ku dareen ‘waraxmatullaah’…”

Sidaas darteed Nabi Aadan CS dhererkiisu wuxuu ahaa 30 mitir. Waxaana la ogyahay in Alle wax walba ku abuuro miisaan iyo isu dheellitir.

👈 Haddii maanta faraska uusan ka dheeraan 2.5 mitir (sida faraska Yurub—Dutch ama ingiriiska), dhererka bini’aadamkuna uusan dhaafin 2 mitir iyo wax yar, taasi waa isu dheellitir.

Marka xilligii Aadan (cs), waxaa hubaal ah in farasku uusan la mid ahayn kan maanta, balse uu ka dheeraa, sidoo kale wan ama ido ma ahayn sida maanta, balse way ka waaweynaayeen si ay ugu habboonaadaan dadka waaweyn. Maadaama Alle xoolaha u abuuray inay u adeegaan bini’aadamka, waa inay ku habboonaadaan dhererkooda‼️

✅✅ Sidaas darteed lafaha waaweyn ee maanta la helo waa lafaha xayawaannadii ku noolaa waqtiyadii hore, kuwaas oo ah awoowayaashii xayawaannada maanta jira.

Waqti ka dib, dhererka bini’aadamka wuu yaraaday jiilba jiil, cimriguna wuu gaabtay, sidoo kale xayawaannaduna way yaraadeen si ay ugu habboonaadaan bini’aadamka maanta. Suurtagal ma aha in faras ku noolaa xilligii Nabi Aadan oo 33 mitir ahaa uu weli sidaas ahaado, iyadoo bini’aadamka maanta uusan dhaafin 2 mitir iyo wax yar‼️

Tani waa xaqiiqda koowaad: ma jiro wax la yiraahdo diinosoorrada, balse waa lafaha xayawaannadii hore ee la noolaa Nabi Aadan iyo farcankiisii.

Ninku wuxuu u dhega nuglaaday xaaskiisa, wuxuuna hooyadii geeyay meel cidlo ah oo duur ah, halkaas oo uu kaga tagay.

Malagii wuxuu yiri: “Kheyr ha noqoto.”
Subaxdii, meeshii cidla ahayd waxay isu beddeshay doog iyo xoolo badan – geel, lo’ iyo ari – rizqi uu Alle siiyay sabirkeeda iyo tawakkalkeeda.
Ninkii markuu arkay mucjisadaas, wuu qoomameeyay, hooyadiina guriga ayuu ku soo celiyay isagoo wata rizqigii Alle siiyay.
Laakiin xaaskiisii waxay ku tiri:
“Hooyadayna sidaas oo kale u gee!”
Markii hooyadeed la geeyay isla meeshii, habeenkii malagii ayaa yimid. Iyadu waxay tiri:
“Waa shar! Waa bahallo i cunaya!”
Malagii wuxuu yiri:
“Shar ha noqoto.”
Wax yar kadib bahal ayaa cunay.
Subaxdii markii la ogaaday wixii dhacay, gabadhii waxay u murugootay hooyadeed ilaa ay iyaduna murugo u dhimatay.

Why Are People More Interested in Buying Eco-Friendly Products?

We are currently going through a transition period where consumer behavior has fundamentally changed. In the past, people looked at the price tag first when buying a product. But now, they evaluate the product’s environmental impact. As a digital strategist and market analyst, when I observe global purchase patterns and data trends, I clearly see that the demand for eco-friendly products is no longer a niche market. It is now dominating the mainstream retail industry. The psychological driver behind this shift is called “Status Signaling.” Customers now see using eco-friendly products as a symbol of a modern and educated lifestyle. When someone uses a bamboo toothbrush or a jute bag, they are subconsciously sending a message to society that they are a conscious and responsible citizen. This desire to earn “social currency” is pushing people toward eco-friendly options.

From a business perspective, this becomes even more interesting. Many traditional business owners believe eco-friendly products cost more to produce, which reduces profit margins. But the reality is that customers are willing to pay a premium for sustainable products. In economics, this is called “Willingness to Pay.” A global Nielsen survey shows that about 66% of customers are willing to spend extra on environmentally friendly products, and the percentage is even higher among millennials. This means being eco-friendly is now a powerful value proposition for brands. It gives brands a unique identity in competitive markets and protects them from price wars. In addition, the “eco-anxiety” people feel about climate change and global warming also influences purchase decisions. When customers buy green products, they feel mental satisfaction and experience a guilt-free feeling. This emotional connection plays a major role in building brand loyalty.

In modern marketing strategy, “Conscious Consumerism” has become a major factor. Especially Gen Z, who will drive the future economy, evaluates a brand’s carbon footprint and ethical practices before making a purchase. They want to build relationships with brands that care about both the planet and people. However, one major challenge here is “Greenwashing.” Many companies falsely promote their products as environmentally friendly. But in the digital age, customers are smarter and demand transparency. From my experience, brands that are honest about their sustainability journey and transparent about their supply chain earn long-term customer support. Trust has become the most valuable currency in today’s market. When you can genuinely contribute to the environment and communicate it through authentic storytelling, customer acquisition becomes much easier.

At the end of the day, selling eco-friendly products is not just about selling a product. It is about selling a vision. Businesses that want to build future-proof brands must integrate sustainability into their core business strategy. Because customers today are not just consumers. They are change-makers. They vote with every purchase for the kind of world they want to live in. Those who understand this psychological and economic shift and adapt accordingly will become the market leaders of tomorrow.
